"In exchange for my help with your studies, you must stay let me stay at your house until summer vacation."

After a while, my grades are improving and I'm beginning to enjoy living with Tsukasa. I know that “it's not cheating if you're not in love with them,” but…

209100.description:
"You wanna get married?"

I'm Ito, and my boyfriend Daisuke suddenly proposed to me! We've been together for 8 years and have been living together for 3; finally, it's my turn to walk down the aisle! But it didn't take long for the excitement to wane and my worries to set in. He doesn't rinse the dishes no matter how many times I tell him, he leaves his dirty clothes on the floor, and he's ALWAYS on his phone. Did I mention we never have sex, too? Will I truly be happy marrying him like this? It's hard for me to say what's on my mind to him, but I don't have the energy to start a relationship from scratch with someone new. With these thoughts swirling in my mind, Dai and I go on a long-awaited date and find ourselves at a mysterious shop called Cafe Untye. I drink the tea that's chosen for me and the words, "I don't want to get married!", pop out of me?! What the...?! My mouth just moved on its own...?!

Cafe Untye is a peculiar place one can reach only when a "tie" leads you there. This title is a collection of enchanting stories intricately woven through the bonds of individuals who visit the cafe.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

The last thing he remembers is being pursued by security police while fleeing a murder scene, then passing out from a tranquilizer. But he never would have expected to get such a bizarre request from this scarlet-eyed redhead girl calling herself "Phi"... Malice, a man who uses brutal methods to settle grudge after grudge for his various clients, hesitating not even to kill, was the one chosen by Phi, a phoenix descended to Earth from the heavens. Chosen for being the boorish murderer most suited to effectively teach her the hideousness of mankind. In other words, showing pure-hearted Phi how ugly people can be until she comes to hate them is the path to saving the world... Or so he's told.

Now, as the captain of Yeomyeong High, he must rally his teammates to glory and carve out his own future in the world of basketball, free from the dark past that once threatened to take everything from him.

title.english: The Oppressed Saint and Her Loyal Duke
title.native: 虐げられ聖女と一途公爵 仮初め婚のはずが、溺愛されています
title.romaji: Shiitagerare Seijo to Ichizu Koushaku: Kari Hajime Kon no Hazu ga, Dekiai Sarete Imasu

title.native: 괴이현상 하나

209105.description:
5-year-old Eiry Ortezo may look adorable, but she’s a taekwondo prodigy with flawless manners and a heart full of courage. Her peaceful life is turned upside down when a mysterious voice declares her the savior of the North, a land consumed by demonic energy. Determined to fulfill her destiny, Eiry journeys to meet the father she’s never known and thaw the heart he sealed away long ago. Can this little lady bring warmth back to the frozen North, or will darkness inevitably swallow it whole?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Dutiful Kid Who Saved the Villainous Family

title.english: A Proper Lady's Guide to Raising Villains
title.native: K-유교 어린이가 악당 가족을 구함

209106.description:
The story centers on Seto Akane, an office worker who is personally asked by the company president to become the secretary of his son, the company's managing director. Akane accepts the job out of gratitude to the president for paying for repairs to her family home, which was partially destroyed in an accident. However, the managing director is arrogant, foul-mouthed, and selfish, and doesn't do much of his job. Akane is astonished, but one day she sees the managing director brilliantly resolve a problem within the company, and she changes her mind and decides that working as his secretary might not be such a bad idea...

The story depicts the relationship between the handsome, skilled, and cynical heir of a wealthy family and the reliable Akane.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 拗らせ御曹司は懐かない
モブ侍女に転生したので虐殺皇帝をまっとうに育てたら執着溺愛されました
title.romaji: Mob Jijo ni Tensei Shitanode Gyakusatsu Koutei wo Mattou ni Sodatetara Shuuchaku Dekiai saremashita

209108.description:
This unrequited love is too good to be true!! A slapstick romantic comedy about a lazy goddess president and a foul-mouthed, capable secretary!

Kirara is the beautiful, capable president of a cosmetics company, known as the "goddess president." At first glance, she appears perfect, but in reality, she's clumsy and lazy. She has a crush on her childhood friend and secretary, Toudou, and acts perfect in order to be with him. On the other hand, Toudou, who is usually cold towards Kirara, is actually...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 藤堂秘書は今日も塩対応
title.romaji: Toudou Hisho wa Kyou mo Shio Taiou

title.native: 殺人鬼を逃すな
堕悪魔ルシェルの禁断の誘惑
title.romaji: Daaku ma Lucille no Kindan no Yuuwaku

209111.description:
Errand service owner Wu Hyeon-Do never expected his first love to walk back into his life, especially not like this. Seong Su arrives clutching a flyer for a suspicious cult, claiming his dead son might still be alive. Reeling from the sudden mention of a child he never knew about, Hyeon-Do assumes Seong Su must have moved on and built a family after he left the island. But the truth is far more shocking than he could have realized...

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 신세계에게

209112.description:
He came for an education, but he’s staying for the teacher. After learning his intended mentor has passed away, imperial interpreter Byeon Seungjun convinces the scholar's exceptionally talented disciple, Yeo An, to take him on as a student. Their contract is supposed to be purely academic, but Seungjun can’t keep his eyes off his innocent new mistress. Trapped in close quarters day after day, the line between student and lover begins to blur. Yeo An might be the one teaching the lessons, but Seungjun is about to introduce his pure-hearted teacher to a passionate world of pleasure she never knew existed.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 바다 건너 말
キリンの首はなぜ長い
title.romaji: Kirin no Kubi wa Naze Nagai

title.native: 時間割の外

209115.description:
Aki is a pastery chef in the making, living with the rather flighty Yuu who is hiding away from her family. It isn't until Yuu receives a call from her mother informing her that she is coming to get her does she panic. Snatching Aki up in a whirlwind of confusion dying to run away Aki convinces the frantic Yuu to meet with her mother. Yet Aki can't help but wonder what Yuu-chan's family does for a living, and why Yuu is so keen on running away.

Note: Published in Comic Yuri Hime 2007-03
synonyms: スパイシースウィーツ

title.native: Spicy Sweets
ましろくんの補講アトリエ

209118.description:
Bom Yun is a shy and overworked high school ethics teacher who’s assigned to the most avoided class at Shinsu High School. The cause of its reputation is Jae-Gyu Seon, a confrontational guardian who terrifies the faculty. Yet as Bom gets to know him, she discovers a devoted uncle with an unexpectedly tender heart. Though Bom tries to keep her distance when Jae-Gyu openly pursues her, she soon finds herself hopelessly falling for this quirky but charming giant of a man.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.native: 스프링 피버
あのさ、槙さん
君と桜の花束を
title.romaji: Kimi to Sakura no Hanataba wo

209121.description: In the year 20XX, the Vtuber culture that was all the rage in Japan has also become a big hit in the demon world. Demons use avatars to hide their real identities, and while streaming in the human world, they steal the ‘souls’ from their subscribers bit by bit. Tsukishiro Aruca is a total newbie among these demon Vtubers… and she has only reached double-digit subscribers. But, her dream is to become a great demon Vtuber!

title.native: でびちゅーばー！！～月城アルカはVtuberで魔王を目指す！～
title.romaji: Devituber!!: Tsukishiro Arca wa Vtuber de Maou wo Mezasu!

title.native: 泣き虫ハルちゃんの初恋

209123.description:
Iris, the head of the Regrett family, is on the verge of ruin. Se planned to fire all his servants, give up her title and territory, and become a commoner. However, her former butler, concerned about her, brings up a marriage proposal to become the 10th concubine of King Hybern, also known as "His Dragon Majesty"! I had planned to grow herbs in the herb garden and live a carefree life with my little dragon, so there's no way I could become a queen!!! A love comedy about the negotiations between a poor young lady and her doting emperor.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title.english: I Refuse to Be His Consort! The Dragon Emperor Is Infatuated With His Tenth Consort
title.native: 竜陛下のお妃はお断りしたい！～竜陛下は10番目の側妃を溺愛中～
title.romaji: Ryuu Heika no Okisaki wa Okotowari Shitai!: Ryuu Heika wa 10-Banme no Sobahi wo Dekiai-chuu

title.native: 高嶺の高野さん

209125.description:
[What is the connection between a figure skating idol and a mysterious fairy?]

Mickey is the most popular girl on her high school figure skating team. She has been asked out on a date by Grey—a notorious playboy—but she remains skeptical. As Mickey agonizes over the decision, a fairy suddenly appears before her and offers a prophecy: "Grey isn't such a bad match after all!"

A massive hit from the 1980s Ribon magazine! A romantic love comedy series.

(Source: Shueisha, translated and edited)

Notes:
-Volume 1 contains the one-shots "Hoshi no Tobira wo Knock shite (星の扉をノックして)" and "Kinpouge (きんぽうげ)".
-Volume 2 contains the one-shot "Shuumatsu (週末)".

title.native: Mickey

209126.description: Note: Published in Ultra Jump 2026 February issue.

title.native: おかえりるうちゃん

209127.description:
Suizan Shirafuji is a painter known for his unconventional memorial portraits. One day, a man comes to him requesting a memorial portrait depicting his father "suffering." What could drive a man to ask that his own father be remembered with an expression of anguish…?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 遺影屋

209128.description:
A man and woman are swept up in the romantic atmosphere of the gorgeous party they're attending. Surrendering themselves to the mood, their lips almost touch when... they quickly break away in panic. The two of them are actually undercover officers, and the key to the success of the operation is the moment they share a kiss...! A secret mission like never before is about to begin!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 突入作戦:キスガナイト
フォーカス・オン・ユー

209130.description:
"I wouldn't mind trying it with you, senpai."

Hatsumi, a third-year substitute on the baseball team, flinches everytime at the slightly excessive skinship from Hinaki, a second-year regular. One day, however, Hatsumi witnesses Hinaki kissing another member of the club and begins to feel unsettled.

A sensitive BL between a senior who is always an substitute and a junior who is a regular.

(Source: East Press, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 初見先輩は補欠

209131.description:
With his brash personality and muscular physique, and his fierce presence fighting against his country's foes, Salyu is known as the “Winter Bear of Tidros." Until one day when he finds himself engaged a young lady whose betrothal was broken off in a neighboring country!

Starting with a kiss on the forehead, he is confused by this unfamiliar woman. Her smile makes his heart race, and a glimpse of her cleavage leaves him all flustered. What are these "strange feelings" in his heart, as his imagination runs wild?

(Source: Pash Books, translated)

title.native: 隣国から来た嫁が可愛すぎてどうしよう。: 冬熊と呼ばれる俺が相手で本当にいいのか!?
title.romaji: Ringoku kara Kita Yome ga Kawaisugite Doushiyou.: Fuyuguma to Yobareru Ore ga Aite de Hontouni Ii no ka!?

209133.description:
A trio of otaku friends, all different ages and with different tastes in genres. They get together again today, hitting up a bar they've been eyeing, and maybe even having a sleepover...?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 呑めたらいいね

209134.description:
Okado, a small bakery on the edge of the shopping district, was left to Masumi by her grandfather, a skilled baker. With her beloved store facing turmoil, a self-proclaimed "butler" appears before her!? This man promises to grant her every wish if she becomes his master. What will become of the reversed master-servant relationship between them...?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 執事のご主人様
夢みる神様と千年の呪い
title.romaji: Yumemiru Kamisama to Chitose no Noroi

209136.description:
Hanabusa Hikaru has regrets about quitting her dream job as an actress. To help her unique and somewhat problematic family, she starts a real estate agency with her former manager, who is hoping to become a groom...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 花が咲く頃 お婿にどうぞ。
title.romaji: Hana ga Sakukoro wo Muko ni Douzo.

209137.description:
After being dumped by her boyfriend and hitting rock bottom, Momoka, a thirty-something office worker, becomes addicted to an otome game called "Kamiroma," where you fall in love with a god. Her favorite character, Shiro-sama, cheers her up, but the app suddenly shuts down! Still, Momoka's love for Shiro-sama continues, and she begins collecting stuffed toys. One day, when she kisses a stuffed toy, Shiro-sama appears in human form, and her favorite character falls in love with her!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: シロさまはぬいぐるみのままでいてくれない～ぬい活OL、神さまに溺愛される～
title.romaji: Shiro-sama wa Nuigurumi no Mama de Ite Kurenai: Nuikatsu OL, Kamisama ni Dekiai sareru

209138.description:
Iori was a huge fan of the underground male idol Saku. After he suddenly disappeared, she couldn't forget him and spent her days visiting the store. There, she met Kyouya, the owner of the underground male idol agency. Just as things were starting to get better between her and Kyouya, Saku's ghost appears...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: ハッピーエンドの神様

209139.description:
When her mother's illness takes a turn for the worse, Lilitia meets her father, the Marquis Castion. With no one else to turn to, she agrees to join the House of Castion and become their political tool in exchange for her mother's medical treatment. But as if relinquishing her freedom weren't enough, the duke's son and her new fiancé Jacob absolutely detests commoners. Years later, Lilitia continues to suffer his torment. Under Jacob's instructions, she must now act the bully towards the baron's daughter at the academy, all to deter suspicion away from their secret relationship, One evening, as Lilitia recovers from her torturous day, a strange, handsome man bursts into her home. Enter Ultio, the thief causing a stir in the kingdom for delivering justice to its corrupt aristocrats. Before he makes his escape, the kind-hearted Lilitia notices his injury and offers to mend his wound. What she didn't expect, was how he proposes to return the favor: Help her end her doomed engagement to Jacob! With the mysterious gentleman thief's aid, perhaps freedom (and romance) for our "villainess" in distress is just around the corner!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Luckless Girl Forced into Villainy Happily Wishes to End Her Engagement
title.native: 悪女に仕立て上げられた薄幸令嬢の幸せな婚約破棄
title.romaji: Akujo ni Shitate Agerareta Hakkou Reijou no Shiawase na Konyaku Haki

209140.description:
Suddenly one day, the marquess's daughter Lobelia realizes that she's inside the world of "The Eternal Cage," an adult dating sim she played in her previous life. What's more is that she's the villain of the story, while her dear sister Lily is the protagonist! However, "this time," Lobelia vows not to bully but protect her sister, especially from any "compromising circumstances." Thus begins Lobelia's struggle against fate, and the beautiful yet lusty men it throws her and her sister's way!

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: She Is a Villainess in an Age-Restricted Otome Game, but Her Staunch Knight Is Too Good to Cause Any R-Rated Events

title.english: She Is a Villainess in an Age-Restricted Otome Game, but Her Staunch Knight Is Too Good to Cause Any R-Rated Events
title.native: 年齢制限付き乙女ゲーの悪役令嬢ですが、堅物騎士様が優秀過ぎてRイベントが一切おきない
title.romaji: Nenrei Seigentsuki Otome Game no Akuyaku Reijou desu ga, Katabutsu Kishi-sama ga Yuushuu Sugite R Event ga Issai Okinai

209141.description:
"There's no such thing as sincere love..." Mianna Caroline was raised strictly as a light mage user from a young age. After her mother passed away, her father remarried and adored her stepsister, ignoring Mianna. Then, to make matters worse, her fiancé broke off their engagement, saying he wanted to marry her stepsister instead. Mianna always believed that living honestly would be rewarded, but this betrayal makes her fall into using "dark magic" that humans aren't supposed to have access to. But in the next moment, she wakes up to find herself returned to the day she was born! Then, God tells her, "I'll give you a second chance." With a fresh start, Mianna's journey to find love and heal her heart begins again...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I Lived an Honest Life Only to Have My Fiancé Betray Me, So in My New Life I'll Live as the Villainess
title.native: 清楚誠実に生きていたら婚約者に裏切られたので、やり直しの世界では悪役令嬢として生きます
title.romaji: Seiso Seijitsu ni Ikite Itara Konyakusha ni Uragirareta node, Yarinaoshi no Sekai de wa Akuyaku Reijou to shite Ikimasu

synonyms: Mofumofu & Mukumuku and Drifting Life in Another World

title.native: もふもふとむくむくと異世界漂流生活 ~おいしいごはん、かみさま、かぞく付き~
title.romaji: Mofumofu to Mukumuku to Isekai Hyouryuu Seikatsu: Oishii Gohan, Kami-sama, Kazoku Tsuki

title.native: 陽がのぼり菜の花は咲く
title.romaji: Hi ga Nobori Nanohana wa Saku

209144.description: Note: Published in Comic Yuri Hime Vol.7

title.english: Princess Sakura in the Flurry of Flowers
title.native: 桜姫花吹雪

209145.description:
Fuyuko grew up as the only daughter of the head of the small-to-medium-sized company Hyuga Suisan. One day, it is discovered that she is actually the daughter of the head of the large Toyama Group, and she is told to return to her family home and find a husband for the sake of the family. At first, Fuyuko ignores the harassment, but it becomes life-threatening...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 冬子の婿取り

209146.description:
Tani Yohana is a government-sanctioned brothel. Among the many courtesans who live there, the highest-ranking women are known as "Kyosei." Their bewitching story begins now...

Gama, a young girl born into extreme poverty, was sold to the brothel. Because of her beauty, she was sexually abused by her stepfather and lost the ability to speak. The first person she opened up to was Nangou, a teacher hired by the brothel. Under Nangou's tutelage, Gama displays her literary talent and grows into a beautiful girl, but the teacher has a hidden past!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 傾城～花魁ものがたり～

209147.description:
1. 30 Debut (30デビュー )
2. Sono Ude no Naka wa Kitto Amai (その腕の中はきっと甘い)
3. Koko ni Oide (ここにおいで)
4. Itsuka Aoku Tokete Iku (いつか青くとけていく)

title.native: 30デビュー

209148.description:
Pleasure, jealousy, vanity... I'm still not the "adult" I longed for back then. I'm not fit to be an adult like this! An omnibus of awkward love stories woven by complicated adults!

Chisaki, who was raised by toxic parents, has been looking for a partner for six years. She wanted someone reliable and serious, but this time she spends the night with a younger, flirtatious guy she meets at a dating event. At 30, she shouldn't be in this kind of relationship, but will she still find herself falling for a dangerous romance...?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 大人失格

209149.description:
BIZ FLY is a shared office where people and companies from a variety of industries come together. Tomomi has no interest in real men. Kae keeps her true feelings to herself. Nanase is devastated after her boyfriend dumped her. Miri wants to live a stable life.

Different lifestyles and work styles mean different attitudes toward love...?! This is a series of engaging short stories featuring women who strive for love and work!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 恋は翼

209150.description:
One day, divorced single father Motoi finds out that Ren, the handsome ace at his company, is a new single father. As he helps out with Ren's struggling parenting, they gradually become irreplaceable, more than friends, but less than family... The only people they can rely on are each other.

A heartwarming parenting bromance!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: パパとダディ

209151.description:
A frustrated office lady in her 30s is constantly pursued by a devilish younger colleague...?

Ako Otsuki has been missing out on opportunities and is frustrated that she is still a virgin at 29. On her 30th birthday, a man she had a crush on invites her out, and as soon as she loses her virginity, he uses her and dumps her, sending her into a tailspin...

"I'm never having sex again." So Ako decided.

But then, her junior at work, Nitta, confesses his feelings to her, saying, "Let's go out on that condition," and even though she can't quite believe it, he keeps coming after her...!? Ako's awkward and sweet office romance, which barely involves sex, begins!!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 清くふしだらな僕ら

209152.description:
"Hats," "Psyche," and "Nakku" are three guys who broadcast videos in the role of handsome men to protect the temple where Harada, also known as Hats, is acting as the head priest. Although it's a life advice channel, the only people who come in are for love advice. Nakajima, also known as "Nakku," is actually an ordinary office worker with poor communication skills and a virgin... What's more, the person he's interested in has a crush on a married man...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 金曜午後９時恋ちゅーばー

209153.description:
A desperate kidnapper, a billionaire heiress, and a vacation that goes hilariously off-script. When driver-in-disguise Hyeon-ho abducts K-Group heiress Ju-yeon, he expects terror, tears, and a massive ransom. Instead, he gets a shameless seduction from a woman who thinks his dangerous edge is incredibly hot. Mistaking her intense lust for psychological dependency, Hyeon-ho gives into a night of absolute passion. Too bad for him, his guilt wakes up before she does. The second he tries to surrender to the police, Ju-yeon reveals her true colors. He thought he took her captive, but she’s the one who’s never letting him go.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 스톡홀름 홀리데이

209154.description:
Min-Hyeok is a dessert influencer who always finishes his day by ordering a comforting, fiery-hot bowl of kimchijjim. On a night with heavy rain, delivery complications present Min-Hyeok with an unexpected opportunity when the owner of his favorite kimchijjim spot offers to drive the food over himself. Hooked by the owner's surprisingly charming voice, Min-Hyeok hatches a plan to lure this mysterious, helpful man right into his apartment. Will this rainy night be a recipe for a steamy romance, or will the spice come back to bite Min-Hyeok?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: Can I Give the Boss a Rating?

title.english: Can I Rate Your Body, Too?
title.native: 사장님에게 별점 줘도 되나요?
동하의 사정

209156.description:
Na-Hyeon joins a dawn swim class to conquer her water phobia—and crushes hard on her hot instructor, Jae-Hwan. She shuts it down fast. No point eyeing a tree she can't climb. But what if that tree wants to be climbed? Before she knows it, Jae-Hwan is insisting she take responsibility for taking his virginity!

(Source: Manta)

title.native: 수영 레슨 일지
錆びついた剣

209158.description:
Gran is a young man who works as a lowly delivery guy in a world where magic is commonplace. However, hidden among the cargo he’s tasked with transporting is... a princess?! An escape story filled with intrigue and romance begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: Magical Escapes！

209159.description:
The story place between the first and second seasons. Fate is having some strange dreams product of the long exposure to magical girls anime and for being apart of her girl for too long.

Note: Published in Comp Ace Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha type Special Edition 2011-01

title.native: 魔法少女フェイタルフェイト
Witchtime Teatime
回春りらくぜーしょん
ボディがガラ空き
きっずすてーしょん
ウェアウルフ ～白銀の怪物とそばかすの僕～
title.romaji: Werewolf: Hakugin no Kaibutsu to Sobakasu no Boku

209165.description: A knight informs his best friend's lover that he died in battle. "He asked me to take care of you," the knight tells him, and so they start living together. But the two of them share a secret that could change everything.

title.native: ふたりの騎士
美少女戦士ユートピュア

209167.description:
Jung-Seo reunites with Hyo-Sin, the boy he once admired in high school, only for a drunken accident to leave Hyo-Sin with a broken nose and under Jung-Seo’s roof. As they begin living together, Jung-Seo realizes Hyo-Sin is nothing like the person he once idolized… and decides to help him find the courage to chase his dream again.

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: ロックスター・ネバー・ダイ

title.native: 락스타 네버 다이

209168.description:
"Why do I have to be the one to 'put it in'?" Shun Mizuo has always got a smile on his face. He's popular amongst his coworkers and he's good at his job... but he's useless in the bedroom. One day, heartbroken after discovering his girlfriend cheating on him, he drinks himself into a stupor and reveals his "situation down there" to Amachi, his beautiful-yet-frosty coworker. What happens when, suddenly, Amachi says that she feels that this moment with Mizuo must be fate?! An office romance between two people both hopeless in the bedroom!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 抜き差しならない二人

209169.description:
With the proposal, "Let's make a baby". High school student Kotori is roped up into a fake relationship with Sei, the head of the wealthy Takamiya family. Even though Kotori's traumatic past makes her uneasy with other people, she can't escape this situation, but Kotori isn't the only one with secrets. Being forced to visit Sei every day, actually shows he's keeping some of his own! As the Takamiya family aims to continue its lineage, Kotori's gradually getting caught up in their schemes. Clumsy, but also straightforward, this story follows a lonely girl and a troubled nobleman's son's love story.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Takamiya Family and the False Fiancée
title.native: 鷹宮家と偽りの婚約者

209170.description:
Hey, what will you dye today? My cat has become a Nekomata. This is the story of a dyeing shop run by a non-human spirit called Nekomata in a house on the outskirts of town!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title.native: ねこまた印の染物屋さん

209171.description:
Former high priestess Stella was banished from the front lines of the dungeon crusade by a new priestess, whose false accusations cost Stella not only her job, but also her engagement. One year later, Stella, who has become an adventurer, saves Reinhardt, a demihuman whose original form is that of a blue dragon. The two of them decide to pair up and begin to enjoy their days adventuring together.

However, in another part of the land, the dungeon crusaders who had cast Stella out are facing trouble. Though they thought their conquest would soon be finished, for some reason, it's been over a year and the end is nowhere in sight... A former high priestess and a young man with a precious secret begin their journey here!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: わたし、聖女じゃありませんから
태자 교육

209173.description:
Doyeonhyang, a utopia where gods and androids coexist. Everything in Doyeonhyang is sustained by human souls. A world where everything is managed under perfect order. The only android with self-awareness, Hong Yu-Seon, gradually feels a sense of dissonance and begins to crack the system of Doyeonhyang...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 도원향

209174.description:
God, I only asked for mercy—why resurrect me?

“Any final words?”

“...God, have mercy.”

I was betrayed by those I trusted and ultimately beheaded. But with the divine decree, the world turned upside down.

Evil runs rampant; I send you the resurrected. Stand firm against them.

God. I asked you to have mercy on them, not to resurrect me. Can't you just let them perish?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: Don't Look for the Resurrected Villainess

title.native: 부활한 악녀를 찾지 마세요

209175.description:
Thinking back on past relationships makes me want to kick the covers off like a crappy ex! If only we could know the outcome of a relationship beforehand, we could skip the jerks and easily find someone destined for us, right? We'll solve that curiosity for you.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Would You Like to Hold My Hand?

209176.description:
Despite being the top student at Adventurer Academy, Alto Reis chose to work as an employee of the Adventurer's Guild rather than as an adventurer due to certain family circumstances. However, after being expelled from the guild for unreasonable reasons, he and his old friends embark on a shocking life-changing story...!?

(Source: Mag Comi, translated)

title.native: 追放されたギルド職員は、世界最強の召喚士@COMIC
title.romaji: Tsuihousareta Guild Shokuin wa, Sekai Saikyou no Shoukanshi@COMIC

A man named Tachibana comes to fortune teller Nobara, wanting her to tell his fortune about his cheating wife. Nobara uses her fortune-telling skills to uncover the timing of the wife's trysts and the identity of the other man, but...?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

209184.description:
Commit a sin, and a "bug" attaches to you!

Misao is a young boy who can see the "bugs" that attach themselves to people who have committed sins.
Small bugs for minor sins, large bugs for grave sins...

Through these bugs, Misao is able to measure the weight of a person's sins. However, he gradually begins to see bugs that defy these rules, and at the same time, strange incidents start occurring around him...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: わるいむし

209185.description: A story about the boring and trivial daily life of a company employee wife and an animator husband.

title.native: はぴねすゆれない

209186.description:
Wasurerare Hime is the story of Anne Antoine, a girl who leaves no trace in anyone's memory. In Fuzan-Croix, a port town striving to rebuild after a great disaster, Laurent lives with his ailing wife Marie. Into their home comes a young girl by the name of Anne Antoine. Her route onward having been blocked, she is taken in for a while as a maid. However...

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

title.native: 忘れられ姫

209187.description:
A wizard from the Divine Realm who has mastered magic and proposed a new magical theory. Just before his death, he uses reincarnation magic and is reincarnated 500 years into the future! He starts a new life as a farm boy named Lucien, but he finds himself in a world where the common sense of his previous life no longer applies and magical technology has declined...!?

(Source: Mag Comi, translated)

title.native: 神域の魔法使い～神に愛された落第生は魔法学院へ通う～
title.romaji: Shiniki no Mahoutsukai: Kami ni Aisareta Rakudaisei wa Mahou Gakuin e Kayou

209188.description:
Mizunoke are monsters and spirits that appear at the water's edge. While many have been driven out with the advent of modern civilization, they can still be found within this town of Uroko. One day, a young girl named Kichi appears like a storm before Sayo, an employee of the Mizunoke Extermination Center. Though Kichi claims to be searching for her missing brother, there seems to be something more at work...

(Source: MANGA Plus)
synonyms: Mizu no Kai - Suiiki Kaii Kidan Imayō

title.english: Mizunoke: A Modern Tale of Mysterious Water Dwellers
title.native: 水ノ怪-水域怪異奇譚今様-

209189.description:
Rio, who lives an honest life but keeps getting unlucky, finds herself homeless after an accident... That's when her colleague, Miyao, whom she has a crush on, suggests they live together. Just the two of them...!? She's overjoyed, but then she finds out there's actually another guy there!?

She's constantly being tossed around, but their life together as a trio is full of excitement!! A chaotic love triangle for all the girls who want happiness!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 3LDK猫と虎つき。

209190.description:
Tachibana, a former child actress who was forbidden from dating, retires from the entertainment industry with the desire to "have sex with a handsome guy!" and gets a job at a regular company. Her mentor, Ago, is handsome, doesn't treat Tachibana like a celebrity, and is the perfect partner for her first time! Tachibana tries to win over the strict man, but...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: だから私とやましいことしてください！
title.romaji: Dakara Watashi to Yamashii Koto Shite Kudasai!

209191.description:
Despite her alluring charm and reputation as a "bewitching angel," Yori is actually a virgin. However, her appearance often leads her into romantic entanglements...

Yori has a crush on her boss, Ujiie, who always helps her out. He asks her to pretend to be his girlfriend so he can decline the arranged marriage of the managing director's daughter, and she agrees. However, everyone in the company now thinks they're dating...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: フェロモン偽装案件

209192.description:
Short stories focusing on the women lurking in everyday life—miserly women, casual sex partners, office tyrants... Women have battles they can't afford to lose, such as jealousy and envy!? A thrilling story that delves into the true nature of women!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: セックスフレンドの女

209193.description:
Three brothers—Yuito, Haruto, and Yuuma—lost their mother in a traffic accident and were taken in by their father (who lived apart from her), spending their days enduring unreasonable violence. Just when they were on the verge of despair, given no proper meals and having no relatives to rely on—they were caught in a landslide and all three were reincarnated together into an isekai. A passing adventurer, Thomas, protected the three who had collapsed by the roadside, and together with his wife Olivia, who runs the eatery "Olive Tree," they welcomed the three as a "new family"... A warm isekai slow life spun by the beloved three brothers begins!

(Source: Earth Star Entertainment, translated)
synonyms: May Tomorrow Be Another Good Day: A new family was born in another world - Three brothers' heartwarming food diary

title.native: 明日もいい日でありますように。～異世界で新しい家族ができました～三兄弟のほっこりご飯日記
title.romaji: Ashita mo Ii Hi de Arimasu You ni.: Isekai de Atarashii Kazoku ga Dekimashita - 3 Kyoudai no Hokkori Gohan Nikki

209194.description:
Renka, a surgeon, breaks up with her boyfriend of eight years after he cheats on her. While vowing never to fall in love again, she ends up having a physical relationship with Izumi, a popular nurse at her workplace, under the influence of alcohol. Renka becomes friends with benefits with Izumi, who sweetly seduces her. Their sex heals her tired mind and body after surgery…!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 白衣の天使・和泉くんは女医を落とすまで諦めない
title.romaji: Hakui no Tenshi Izumi-kun wa Joi wo Otosu made Akiramenai

209195.description:
Mei, a fujoshi in her mid-30s who works a regular job while creating fan fiction doujinshi, marries Minato, who is 10 years younger than her. Minato isn't an otaku, but he works hard every day for the sake of his beloved Mei.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 腐女子、理解のある彼くんと結婚した。
title.romaji: Fujoshi, Rikai no Aru Kare-kun to Kekkon shita.

209196.description:
Miharu, heartbroken after being dumped by her boyfriend and struggling at work, finds a boy in a school uniform collapsed in front of her house on her way home. Unable to ignore Izumi, who begs her not to tell anyone, she lets him in...

A love story with a girl who's secretly kind but lonely, and who ends up being manipulated and obsessed over by a high school boy!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 少年は私を独りじめしたがる
title.romaji: Shounen wa Watashi wo Hitoriji Meshita Garu

title.native: 金と乙女と恋と純情
title.romaji: Kane to Otome to Koi to Junjou

209198.description:
Seo-Ah, who had always been fascinated by love triangles since childhood, often imagines as an adult, “Would it feel good with three people?” Reality is she's been single for ages, only comforting herself. Then suddenly, two men appear before her—Woo-Kyung and Do-Yun!

Could Seo-Ah finally fulfill her childhood dream of a relationship with three?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.native: 트리플 파트너

209199.description:
Do-Yun and Ju-An met in a liberal arts class and miraculously became lovers. But Ju-An was a masochist, what some call a “brat.” Do-Yun, a vanilla (non-BDSM) who knew little about BDSM, began studying BDSM because he wanted to continue his relationship with Ju-An.

So what is their stimulating daily life like now that they've reached their one-year anniversary?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.native: 브랫은 키우지 마세요!

209200.description:
Summoned back to his family's estate on his twentieth birthday as the official heir, Patrick expects a warm homecoming. Instead, he finds an eerily quiet mansion—and a dark trap waiting for him. Awakened in the middle of the night by a mysterious kiss, Patrick opens his eyes to find Aebel Morton, a picture-perfect gentleman hiding dangerous motives. Before Patrick can even react, he is imprisoned within the mansion walls. Who is this flawless stranger, and why has he locked Patrick away in his own home?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 폴백룸

209201.description: After the human Kyle blunders into an elven forest and is taken prisoner, the elf Lenifille sees a chance to fulfill her dream of seeing the outside world and helps him escape. Thus begins the pair's long and often comedic journey across the realm, over the course of which they are swept up into matters larger and more serious than they could have

title.native: レニフィルの冒険

209202.description:
There is an occupation called the "special technical staff." It is a secret job, which is to have sex with idols for Odaiba TV. But if they ejaculate inside the vagina while on duty, the penalty of vasectomy is awaiting. Takuro Tsuyuzaki with a greatest sexual desire passed the employment examination performed for the first time in 30 years!

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: つゆダク

209203.description:
1914. Birmingham, England. War is on the horizon.
Monica, a witch, soars through the smoky skies astride a mechanical broomstick. As the conflict that will come to be known as the First World War engulfs the world, witches find themselves swept up in its chaos: manipulated, exploited, and fighting to survive on their own terms.

(Source: Harta, translated)
synonyms: The Comet Above, the Trenches Below

title.native: 塹壕のほうき星

209204.description:
"What do you mean he's a virgin again?!" After being a couple for years and years, Risa and Touya are finally going to tie the knot--but he seems to be hiding something... and she's got cold feet!

Suddenly, Risa finds herself zapped back to her college days...with a chance to relive all those awkward, romantic, and above all, HOT nights all over again! Will Touya's charming inexperience win over Risa's jaded heart a second time, or will it take more than the passion of youth to save this love in crisis? A bittersweet page-turner that'll keep you coming back for more!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: アオハルRe:プレイ～欲望駄々モレ幼馴染と焦れキュンとろ甘初えっち～
title.romaji: Aoharu Re:Play: Yokubou Dada More Osananajimi to Jire Kyun Toro Ama Hatsu Ecchi

title.native: 魔法少女にゃなりたくない！！
よろず付喪相談所

209208.description:
When I woke up, I had reincarnated into the world of a game I played in my past life. And what's more, as a monster that's hostile to humanity! It couldn't be helped, so I just lived quietly so humans wouldn't find me, but...

The heroine, Noa, who was my oshi in my past life, had collapsed near my home!!

After I protected and nursed her, my oshi gave me the name "Rei", so I decided to follow and protect Noa as my oshi for life. I meet other characters from the game too, and I'm watching over Noa's growth, but... the real Noa seems to be the type who's a bit clingy and has a... "heavy" love?

This is the story of me, reincarnated as a monster, somehow overcoming hardships together with my beloved oshi.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: I Reincarnated as a Monster in a Game World, and Picked Up the Heroine Who Was My Oshi in My Previous Life

title.native: ゲーム世界で魔物に転生してしまった俺、前世で推しだったヒロインを拾ってしまう
title.romaji: Game Sekai de Mamono ni Tensei shiteshimatta Ore, Zense de Oshi datta Heroine wo Hirotteshimau

209210.description:
No decent woman would put out an ad for a boyfriend! I can't let some harlot near my little brother! In place of his brother, Greg decides to meet a woman who placed a singles ad, with the intention of turning this "Coffee Girl" down. But the Coffee Girl he meets is exceedingly beautiful. Why would she have put out a singles ad? And Lana, a coffee shop owner, is suddenly kissed by a man who's supposed to be applying as her potential roommate. The first of three romances revolving around magazines!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: すてきなコーヒーガール

209211.description:
Two couples living in a certain apartment building, rumored to be the "ideal couples," have a secret. It's a swap marriage—a fake marriage between two same-sex couples. A "lavender marriage" allowing you to live freely with the person you love, should have nothing but advantages, but...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 結婚のカタチ～スワップ婚～

1. Kokonotsu no Yuujou (ここのつの友情)
2. George no Nichiyoubi (ジョージの日曜日)
3. Andrea (アンドレア)
4. Kaiwa (会話)

title.native: ここのつの友情
天使のセレナーデ

synonyms: ディア デュイット

title.native: Dia duit

209216.description:
Xu Yuan is transmigrated into the world of the game Cang Yuan, only to find himself the third son of the villainous final boss?! And to make things worse, he’s being hunted by Ran Qingmo, the lady disciple of the Sword Sect’s leader! Being pursued with deadly intentions by his favorite character, Xu Yuan must find a way to rewrite the villain’s doomed fate!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Immortal Fairy, Please Listen to My Explanation

title.native: 仙子請聽我解釋

209217.description:
Towa Kujou, an illustrator who was secluded in the mountains for her hobby of solo camping, discovers upon her descent that the world has been overrun by zombies. The story depicts Towa gathering leftover food and enjoying gourmet meals in this post-apocalyptic world.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 終末ゾンビキャンプ

209220.description:
Humans are prone to sin. Thus, the gravest sinners are drawn from the earth to live out a sentence of divinity, eternal life, and atonement in a gloomy paradise where desserts are the only consolation. Ursula is brought to paradise against her will to serve as the record keeper. She must now venture through the fragmented memories of the other gods and record the stories of their mortal past.

The sinners who enter paradise are wiped of their memories. Hence, the recordkeeper must find and record the stories of the gods who spend their immortal days repenting their sins on earth. Ursula enters rooms of their memories and discovers their sins and how they end up in paradise. The encyclopedia is Ursula’s record of the lives, deaths, and stories of gods and their mortal past.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

title.english: Paradise of Sinners: An Encyclopedia of Gods
title.native: 세계신대백과

209222.description:
She’s not the innocent, naive heroine; she’s not the stunning but brainless second female lead; she’s not even the heroine’s devoted best friend, the third female lead… She’s the only daughter of the domineering CEO and his pampered wife—and she’s the one “ball” in the “running away with the ball” scenario. What? You think that sounds good?

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: When I Transmigrated Into the Overbearing CEO's Wife's Only Daughter
When I Became the Only Daughter of the Boss's Wife

title.native: 当我穿成霸总娇妻的独生女
title.romaji: Dang Wo Chuan Cheng Bazong Jiaoqi de Dushengnü

209223.description:
Born into modern society, Shuichi was nothing more than an ordinary high school student. After losing his father, he struggled desperately to protect his mother and younger sister, but he faced brutal bullying at school and ultimately lost his life in an unexpected accident. However, when he woke up, he had been reborn as Lucas Ryan, a noble boy in another world! It seems Lucas had once incurred the wrath of the God of Magic, lost his life, and was denied the gift of magic. Shuichi inhabits Lucas’s body with his own soul and, at the same time, receives the blessing of the God of Martial Arts, Mars! However, in this world, magicians are revered, while martial artists are looked down upon. A life of being despised by those around him, even after being reborn—he’s not having any of that! As Lucas, Shuichi masters the martial arts and seizes glory with his fists.

(Source: Piccoma, translated)
synonyms: I Became a Genius at the Academy in a World Where Magic Reigns Supreme

title.native: 魔法至上の世界でアカデミーの天才になっていた
title.romaji: Mahou Shijou no Sekai de Academy no Tensai ni Natte Ita

209225.description:
After a failed marriage, this gangster boss will just here to enjoy life with his new bride... who never signed up for any of it.

(Source: Lalatoon)

title.native: 젊고 어린 남편

209226.description:
Sammy Dayn has been appointed as an inspector to find the traitors of the empress. But does it have something to do with her father?

(Source: Lalatoon)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: Fate in the Mirror: Throne of Flowers

title.native: 镜花缘之百花王朝
title.romaji: Jinghua Yuan Zhi Bai Hua Wangchao

209227.description:
Ren-nei Hanemiya is a self-proclaimed ladies' man. With his dazzling looks and flirting abilities, there should be no woman able to resist his charms... so why hasn't he been able to find a girlfriend yet!? At his wit's end, Ren-ei pops into a host club, where he believes he could work and up his chances of finding a pretty lady to court, especially after learning that all the hosts are gay. Following his sudden interview, Ren-ei is hired on the spot by the host club's young looking manager, Makoto Izumida, who also offers to share a room with him for the time being. Will Ren-ei successfully find a girlfriend at his new job? Or will he discover something about himself that he never knew was there?

(Source: MangaPlanet)

title.native: WARM COFFEE

209228.description:
This content is The Boyz: Creaker Entertainment's brand webtoon, a school romance presented by author Park Tae-joon.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 우리반 아이돌

synonyms: There Are No Rules in the Bedroom!

title.english: There Are No Rules In Bed
title.native: ベッド上は無法地帯につき
title.romaji: Bed Jou wa Muhou Chitai ni Tsuki

209230.description:
Yuri lived an ordinary life with his parents and grandfather until a blinding light reset the world. Everyone returned to the physical age of nineteen, death vanished, and society collapsed overnight. In the chaos, Yuri’s grandfather disappeared without a trace. As violence becomes consequence-free and justice turns personal, Yuri enters Chicken Blood, a lawless battleground where revenge and secrets collide. In a world where no one can die, Yuri risks everything to uncover what happened to the only person he cannot afford to lose.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.native: 19-NINETEEN

209231.description:
A hidden paradise that doesn’t appear on maps or satellite images: "Rainbow Island”

Rainbow, the blue hero who protects this island, Kim Sun-Yi, an ordinary hula girl who savors simple, peaceful happiness, and Aurora, the hero of the dazzling and beautiful Soul City.

A story of love and growth woven by these three very different characters.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: RAINBOW

synonyms: 死に戻り公女の質屋へようこそ
The Young Lady Only Accepts Authentics

title.native: 공녀님은 진짜만 취급합니다

209233.description:
Special Forces soldier Jin Quan is betrayed during a mission and becomes a living target for guided missiles. When he regains consciousness, he finds himself as a destitute man collapsed on the streets of the Lower City—a slum where the world’s lowest class of humans gather, living as cannon fodder in the mines. At this critical moment of life and death, Jin Quan awakens to the class of Demon Swordsman, and the radiation from the dirty bomb explosion in his past life becomes his innate talent. In this world, Jin Quan will engage in a fierce battle against the Chosen Ones.

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)
synonyms: Hé Bào Dāo Fǎ, Wǒ Yīdāo Yīgè
一刀必殺　俺は廃都を斬っていく

title.native: 核爆刀法，我一刀一个
title.romaji: He Bao Dao Fa, Wo Yi Dao Yige

209234.description:
Su Bai uses the “Clock of All Things” to enhance his skills and forge equipment, breaking records in the global tower-climbing competition. As he grows stronger through battle, he experiences class advancements, first-kill rivalries, and inter-racial wars. By clearing dungeons on each floor of the tower, he builds a powerful system and gradually unlocks abilities such as Time Manipulation and Necromancy to confront the higher races! Su Bai is the embodiment of both the Hero and the Demon King!

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)
synonyms: 最強神ゲーマー、再び999階層ダンジョンをクリアさせていただきます
All People Scramble for the Tower: I Cleared 999 Floors in Advance
Quán Mín Qiǎng Tǎ: Wǒ Tíqián Tōngguān 999 Céng

title.native: 全民抢塔：我提前通关999层
title.romaji: Quanmin Qiang Ta: Wo Tiqian Tongguan 999 Ceng

209235.description:
College student Rin Beppu loses his home when his apartment burns down. He's then persuaded by a real estate agent to move into a suspicious property, only to discover it's inhabited by a vampire…

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: チョコぷり～吸血鬼との約束～
title.romaji: Choco Puri: Kyuuketsuki to no Yakusoku

209236.description:
Humanity has been defeated. Merchants who betray their own kind, hunters who side with the monsters—they trample over the corpses of countless humans to reap staggering profits. Monsters from another dimension are consuming our world like a raging inferno. Until Zuo Chi arrived. You were so happy to invade Earth—why are you crying now?

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Wǒ Sǐ Hòu, Huàshēn Wǔdào Tiānmó
武者転生〜異世界で魔獣狩り〜
After I Die, I Transform Into a Martial Arts Demon

title.romaji: Wo Sihou, Huashen Wu Dao Tianmo

209237.description:
To pay off his debts, he dresses as a woman, only to accidentally cross paths with a gang’s top hitman—and, through a series of misunderstandings, ends up becoming his partner. Forced to live together, this unlikely pair finds themselves caught in a tug-of-war between lies and growing feelings…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.native: 谎月

209238.description:
Miori, who grew up in the countryside, has a childhood friend named Ayaka. Since they were little, Miori has been constantly bullied by Ayaka, but she can't defy Ayaka, who is the daughter of a prefectural assembly member... Time passes, and Miori, now 26, begins a life-changing revenge, using every means possible: taking over her in-laws' house, honey traps, and direct confrontations!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 最低なあの子に捧ぐこの復讐
title.romaji: Saitei na Ano Ko ni Sasagu Kono Fukushuu

209239.description:
In the school’s gym equipment room, the transfer student pinned the female lead against the wall in a patch of sunlight, playing with the tip of her fluffy ear as she smiled lightly.

“If you move another inch, the whole school will know that the top student’s ears turn redder than a cat in heat.”

“You can do whatever you want… as long as you keep my ‘secret.’”

Yet the crux of this “secret” seemed to hold a deeper meaning…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.native: 别摸我耳朵

synonyms: I'm sure It's because I have feelings for Her

title.native: きっと、彼女が好きだから

209241.description:
A salaryman who is reincarnated into an alternate fantasy world as Rain, after sacrificing himself to save a child. He is saved, however, by two famous beauties who are the most feared across the land. Rain's school life begins even as he already leveling up with the cheat skills of both sword and sorcery.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 最強の剣聖と賢者のもとに転生した俺は無自覚無双する
title.romaji: Saikyou no Kensei to Kenja no Moto ni Tensei Shita Ore wa Mujikaku Musou Suru

title.native: 欺诈腺体

209243.description:
Even a troubled young lady can find happiness! A comic anthology depicting young ladies who, for various reasons, are branded as villainesses, but end up living a life of doting love!!

209253.description:
"You possess true skill. Your environment was simply holding you back."

Alto, a young appraiser who was forced to work like a slave in the aristocracy-driven Kingdom of Dramd, has his life turned upside down when he is scouted by Beralt, a soldier from the enemy nation, the Glaus Empire. In this completely meritocratic country, Alto's off-the-charts appraisal talent is discovered, and he's suddenly nominated to be an executive candidate in the military! Immediately after joining, Alto has great expectations placed on him by the military executives, a group of powerful individuals. Yet, the people he chooses to ally with are only hopeless dropouts facing desperate situations...

This is an exhilarating rise-to-power fantasy where Alto uncovers the hidden talents of his comrades and carves out a new destiny!

Charles Dexter Ward hasn't seemed himself since travelling to strange lands and keeping stranger company, all in the pursuit of information on a notorious ancestor, Joseph Curwen. Rumored alchemist and practitioner of the occult, Curwen died violently, and Charles became obsessed with finding his unmarked grave. Performing bizarre experiments and chants inside his room, Charles claims to have rediscovered secret knowledge his ancestor possessed that could revolutionize the world. When his erratic and dangerous behavior at last gets him committed to an insane asylum, Charles seemingly escapes…and only his family physician, Dr. Willett, suspecting a hideous truth, now has the courage to pursue the strange case of Charles Dexter Ward!

(Source: Dark Horse Comics)

209255.description:
"Memories anchor me to the past, but dreams carry me to the future."

Seeking to connect with her roots, Xiaoming leaves her familiar life in Japan and crosses the ocean to attend university in Taiwan, her late father's homeland. But navigating a foreign country completely alone proves harder than she imagined. Struggling just to find a place to live before the semester starts, a disheartened Xiaoming wanders into Treasure Hill, a historic and tranquil settlement quietly breathing in the heart of Taipei.

Hidden within its winding alleys is "Hyakunichi Coffee," a quiet coffee shop steeped in an intriguing urban legend: it is said to solve the deepest troubles of anyone who walks through its doors. Run by the enigmatic owner, Meng, the cafe is more than just a place to rest: it operates as a secret "Dream Laboratory" that delves into the fragments of people's memories.

"Why does my father keep speaking to me in my dreams?"

Guided by the memories of the Chestnut Tiger, a fragile butterfly known to migrate 2,000 kilometers across the sea, Xiaoming embarks on a surreal journey through "Memory Palaces," transcending the boundaries of time and space.

Once you start reading, you can't stop. A long-awaited first collection of works from a rising storyteller.

Included works:
1. Fukusou Juuko (複層住戸, Multi-story Dwelling)
"#StrangePhenomenaInMyHouse This morning, coffee was made without me noticing." Unexplained phenomena occur one after another in a maisonette apartment. Is it a paranormal phenomenon, or a crime...? The layers of foreshadowing make it impossible to keep up with the predictions.

2. Tenjou Ura ni Dare ka ga Iru (天井裏に誰かがいる, Someone is in the Attic)
An elderly woman who had been complaining about the presence of "someone" entering from the attic suddenly disappears. Her SNS continues to be updated even after her disappearance, but the source of the posts is nowhere to be found. A police officer pursuing an account known as a "ghost" stumbles into "the other side"...

3. Kaijuu wo Kaibou Suru (怪獣を解剖する, Dissecting Monsters)
The number of giant monster corpses washing ashore is increasing year by year. What is happening in the world behind this? Dissecting, collecting specimens, investigating their ecology and cause of death... Your intellectual curiosity will be stimulated by a monster scientist who uses "intelligence" to fight against a terror beyond human comprehension.

Left alone in a world where dark affinity is shunned he comes across Rococo, a little girl who also has dark affinity powers. He decides to take her under his wing and together they start their own party to show the world what dark affinity classes are really capable of!

"I... want to be like you!" Solon, a magic swordsman who was banished from the Knights (party), is told this by Philia, a lonely princess who is semi-imprisoned. At the request of his mentor, Solon becomes the girl's tutor and begins to impart magic and knowledge to her, who has lived her life admiring him—but on the very first day, a plot to assassinate Philia erupts!? In order to protect the innocent girl, he ends up living and sleeping with her. On top of that, his childhood friend, the Knight Commander, shows up at the palace, and he is pursued by a cunning personal maid, and so his days become more lively in many ways...? A swordsman who was banished because of his omnipotence and a princess who harbors a secret about her birth. When office worker Naoya Sakura gets home from work one day, he finds a handsome college student he doesn't recognize waiting outside his door. The stranger turns out to be his cousin Haruto, whom Naoya used to dote on when they were kids, and before he knows it, the two end up living together. With delicious home-cooked meals and heavenly massages, Naoya is more than happy with Haruto's attentive care. But little by little, Haruto’s “taking care of him” starts to escalate…… ♥

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

Seven-year-old Otoka remembered his past life memories as a Japanese Salaryman after helping two chicks of a monster resembling a chicken called Niwatorisu in the forest. However, the reality was his family was poor and large. There was no room to raise the chicks entrusted to him by the parent Niwatorisu. Three years passed after overcoming his family's opposition. The chicks grew into splendid female Niwatorisus and began to lay precious eggs. Then, this time, his siblings started targeting those eggs...!? "I'm leaving this house already!" Ten-year-old Otoka carries out a midnight flight together with the Mofumofu strongest Niwatorisus he named Shiro-chan and Kuro-chan. In this way, a free-spirited Isekai journey begins with the cute and these strongest fluffy heroines!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

While on an outing to an amusement park with his family to celebrate his daughter’s middle school graduation, Shingo Asahina encounters a mysterious man covered in blood being pursued by some unsavory characters. On the spur of the moment, he gets on the Ferris wheel with the wounded man to shelter him. When questioned, the man simply says “In 30 minutes, this amusement park will turn into hell on Earth,” and explains that in order to prevent disaster, he needs to “borrow” Shingo’s body…

Back in high school, Eiko was betrayed by her only friend, Fujino, over a romantic misunderstanding. Deeply hurt, she resolved to start fresh at the university she entered and keep a low profile. There, she reunited with Nanao, a classmate from long ago. Nanao had a crush on Kaji, a guy in the same club—even though they were both guys. Drawing on her past experience, Eiko bluntly tells him that it’s a hopeless romance. To her surprise, Nanao asks her for advice.

“I need someone to help me. For now, I want to develop my butt for Kaji’s sake.”

Eiko initially refuses, but as she comes to understand Nanao’s pure feelings, she agrees to help with the “butt development.” Gradually, feelings begin to sprout within Eiko. …Is this curiosity? Friendship? Or perhaps…

While living with the talented Nero and Silver, she was unable to gain confidence. Then, an invitation for the entrance examination of the prestigious Veolia School of Witchcraft arrived. This is a story about the two rising stars on a classic magical fantasy about talent!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

209356.description:
I found myself reincarnated as the villain in a game called “Kaleido Lily Academy.” The villain in question—Ix Vandille, the heir of the Count’s family—was a typical scumbag. Hated by many, he was condemned and killed in every scenario set in the academy. At this rate, I would die as soon as I entered the academy.

However, my bad reputation knew no bounds, and it was too late to reform myself now. Therefore…

“That’s it! If I become stronger than the protagonists and show them my power, they won’t dare to oppose me…!”

To avoid being killed by the protagonists, I must become stronger than them. If I display my power, they won’t think of making a move against me. And if they do, I will just defeat them. With this resolve, Ix spent the three years before the academy began training desperately.

“…Master, your strength is unmatched by anyone your age now.” “Hahaha! This is all due to my perseverance!”

Ix became stronger than the protagonists. And soon, he began to show his strength to the protagonists, the heroine princess, noble daughters, and saintesses… but for some reason, he started being regarded as a hero.

Midori is a cool and confident independent woman. Her best friend, Aira, is the type who will do anything she can for the one she loves. Together, they're two women who live as they see fit. Despite their tender hearts and profound patience, both have endured miserable marriages to terrible husbands. Suffering infidelity and all manners of maltreatment, their love for their husbands has grown cold.

When their husbands drive them to their breaking point, Midori and Aira take matters into their own hands and purge their husbands from their lives. These wives are not to be trifled with. They're ready to give their husbands twice the payback they deserve. A ruthless, invigorating drama about divorce is about to begin!

She spent three years trying to earn his love before deciding that holding on was merely a selfish dream. Now, she must protect her unborn child from a marriage that was never meant to be. Or was it? As Ji-Hyeok faces the crushing void left by the divorce, his own family moves to sabotage his position at the company. Between corporate traps and a secret that could change everything, what is in store for this star-crossed couple?

A city tuned for both man and machine. Lodge, a young repairman, hunted down the 'Irregulars'—wanted machines that had broken free from the city—stealing and collecting their parts. Then, an SOS arrived from Irregular machine girls. Lodge's encounter with these machine girls sets time in motion...!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

The Sumida East High School basketball team achieves a dramatic victory in the Inter-High School Championships. While the first-year students shine, third-year student Nakano, dropped from the starting lineup just before the tournament, has mixed feelings...

Mayama had been climbing the career ladder at the company's head office, until he got caught up in an internal dispute and was suddenly transferred to a branch office. His new boss, Nakatani, seemed like a plain, unremarkable man who had only become section chief through years of service rather than talent. One day, looking to unwind, Mayama visits a gay bar where an acquaintance works, only to unexpectedly run into Nakatani. It turns out he keeps the fact that he's gay a secret at work, and at the bar he's completely different from his usual office self, looking confident and strikingly handsome...!?

209388.description:
For as long as he can remember, Yun Jeong-Wu has been the backbone of his struggling family, working tirelessly to support a younger brother plagued by chronic illness. During those long, grueling years, Jeong-Wu happened upon a newspaper feature about a prodigious young Baduk player named Cha Ji-Han. Perhaps it was because Ji-Han shared his brother’s age, or because the athlete had successfully overcome his own past health struggles, but Jeong-Wu found himself projecting his brother’s image onto the boy, eventually becoming his most devoted fan.

Years later, Jeong-Wu has secured a position as the youngest staff member at a professional photography studio. It is there that he finally comes face-to-face with his idol, who has now expanded his career into modeling. The professional reunion takes a dark, bewildering turn that night. After a staff dinner, a drowsy Jeong-Wu retreats to his bedroom, only to be jolted awake by the sensation of wandering hands. Terrified, he stares into the darkness at the intruder. "Ch-Cha Ji-Han?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 포커싱

209389.description:
"You, who feel more distant from me than anyone else, are the only person I want to understand better."

Kasumi and Kei have been friends since they were just little kids. Kei always watched over Kasumi as she would innocently run into any situation with a smile. In their last year of high school, on Kasumi's 18th birthday, she declares that she wants to go with Kei to the love hotel in their town as a birthday gift?! Ever since her confusion on what happens there was settled, the two haven't been able to talk to each other. However, that begins to change after the two find their way to the same university.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Determined that this would be her last attempt, Jae-Hui resolved to confess her feelings for the tenth time. But once again, the answer she received was...

“I’m sorry... I want to focus on baseball.”

Today marked the end of Jae-Hui’s 13-year-long unrequited love.

“Alright, I’m going to forget him completely and start seeing someone else!”

With that resolve, she decided to have a one-night stand...

209393.description:
Freshly uniformed and ready for justice, rookie cop Jeong Taejun envisioned a thrilling life of high-stakes arrests and heroic fame. Reality, however, drops him in a peaceful countryside town where the biggest threat is stray livestock. Eager to prove himself, Taejun spots a suspicious figure crouching in a field and leaps at the chance to make his first big bust. He promptly handcuffs Yeon Jiwu, only to discover that he isn't a thief, but a local just tending to his own crops. Mortified by his blunder, Taejun tries to make amends, but spending time around the charming local might get his heart handcuffed for real.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A hundred years ago, Seo-Ri, a nine-tailed fox, was exiled alone to Gokdo for the crime of harming humans. One day, Parang, the crown prince of Yongseong, washed ashore on Gokdo with deep wounds. Drawn to his tenderness, Seo-Ri shared both body and heart with him. However, Parang intends to use Seo-Ri, Muryeong adopted son, to capture Muryeong, the tiger demon who has thrown the kingdom into chaos.

“All I have is this fine body of mine. How could you possibly accept it willingly?”

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

“In Joseon, people spend half the year hunting tigers and the other half attending funerals for those killed by tigers.”

In Joseon, the land of tigers, a tiger-hunting unit called the “Chakho-gapsa” is on the rise! Song Seol, a tenacious underdog who has been second place for years and runs relentlessly toward his goal, Kang Yun-Jo, the training academy's perennial top student, blessed with exceptional athletic talent. A sports romance unfolds as these two men with completely different personalities meet at the “Tiger Hunter Training Academy” and become roommates.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

The clinic’s impressive clientele includes famous K-pop star, JD, who’s ordered the memory-erasing elixir after a tough breakup. An avid fan of JD’s, Yeon-Jin’s mind races with questions. Who was JD’s ex? Why does he want his memories erased? Will the medicine actually work?
