title.native: こんちくしょうブルース

209405.description: Today, Itsumi becomes a college student, but all she owns are her sailor uniform and pajamas. She's a college student, but she has no clothes. And no money. Elegant Daikanyama, edgy Shinjuku, plain Ochanomizu, what about Itsumi...? College students who dedicate their lives to designer brands cut back on books, movies, and meals to be fashionable. This is a story about the earnest daily lives of girls like Itsumi who don't belong in that fashionable world.

title.native: おんなのこたち倶楽部

209406.description:
Anise spends her days working to support the baron, her father, for her family is on the verge of collapse due to bankruptcy. Right as she convinces herself she'll have work 'til she's dead, she suddenly receives a marriage proposal from Julius, a beautiful young man from a family of dukes. Anise is perplexed by this sudden turn of events, but she soon realizes that Julius' goal is a marriage blanc, or a marriage without love. Julius, who has no interest in the opposite sex, desires a wife who is not attached to him nor restricts what he can and cannot do. Anise, however, has a certain condition that she proposes to Julius before the two marry...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Greatest Marriage Blanc Downtrodden Mistress Becomes a New Wife and Maid at the Same Time
title.native: 白い結婚、最高です。〜虐げられた令嬢、新妻とメイドを兼任中〜
title.romaji: Shiroi Kekkon, Saikou desu. - Shiitagerareta Reijou, Niizuma to Maid wo Kenin-chuu

209407.description:
Princess Hisui married Shuo Yao, the 10-year-old third prince of a neighboring country. She attempted to escape but was trapped in a mysterious temple. After a night of escape, she finds herself ten years in the future! What's more, Shuo Yao is older, has become emperor, and declares he will take Hisui as his consort!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 華耀後宮の花嫁 時を越えたら、溺愛陛下!?
title.romaji: Kayou Koukyuu no Hanayome Toki wo Koetara, Dekiai Heika!?

209408.description:
Upon first glance, high school freshman, Luna Tsukigase, seems like your average school girl. The truth is, though, that she used to be a delinquent! Luna, reformed, dreams of becoming a model!! However, her road to success is steep... Until she somehow gets the sometimes-sweet, sometimes-sour school hottie, Itsuki, to lend her a hand?! Luna and Itsuki's pure love story will remind you of what it feels like to fall in love. Your heart will certainly skip a beat!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 恋するランウェイ

209409.description:
One day, Tori a 4 year old who lives in the poor countryside, is visited by a beautiful noblewoman who tells her that she is a descendant of the Middleton family, a family of counts. Tori is suddenly brought to the Earl's house, where she is treated roughly by the cold-hearted Earl and his older brothers. However, Tori wins them over with the cuteness of her youth...! Before long, Leonardo, the first prince of a neighboring country, asks her to marry him, saying that he is the man of her dreams...!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I Realized I Reincarnated as a Girl with Problems when I Ran Into Drama
title.native: 訳あり幼女、転生したことに気づいたのは、修羅場に遭遇した時。
title.romaji: Wakeari Youjo, Tensei shita Koto ni Kizuita no wa, Shuraban ni Sougu shita Toki.

209410.description:
"This isn't a dream—we're talking about you staying with me for three months starting today." Shirai Hatsuka, a high school student who's been avoiding romance since her childhood friend's heartbreak, spends her days finding solace in her admiration for Yanase Ori, a classmate who's incredibly popular at school for his mysterious and cool personality. Then, while her parents are away on a business trip abroad, Hatsuka is sent to stay with an acquaintance. When she wakes up the day after moving in, she finds Ori sleeping beside her...!? And then Ori gently touches Hatsuka, who has jumped up in surprise, saying, "Good morning, Shirai-san"—. Her unexpected cohabitation with her idol begins...!?

(Source: Starts Publishing, translated)

title.native: 推しがとなりで寝てまして

synonyms: I've tamed a spider monster, so I'm going to try my best at sowing with spider silk!

title.native: 私、蜘蛛なモンスターをテイムしたので、スパイダーシルクで裁縫を頑張ります!
title.romaji: Watashi, Kumo na Monster wo Tame Shita node, Spider Silk de Saihou wo Ganbarimasu!

title.native: なつめとなつめ more Perfume

209413.description:
Liliana has been reincarnated as the "villainess" in the world of the otome game "Lady Rose of Salvation." Her unwavering love draws the "main heroine," another reincarnated person, into the story, leading it in an unexpected direction!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: レディローズは平民になりたい 悪役令嬢リリアナの場合
title.romaji: Lady Rose wa Heimin ni Naritai Akuyaku Reijou Liliana no Baai

title.native: 冥府の花嫁 地獄の沙汰も嫁次第
title.romaji: Meifu no Hanayome Jigoku no Sata mo Yome Shidai

209415.description:
Fiona is reincarnated as a supporting character in an otome game where her stepbrother, Clovis, is tormented and brutally murdered. She intends to cherish Clovis to avoid his death, but before long, her feelings turn into love. Only the "heroine," the saint, can save him from becoming the Demon King... Fiona tries to hide her feelings, but is it too late for Clovis, who has received so much love?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ラスボス令息に殺される義姉ですが、彼を好きになってしまいました。
title.romaji: Last Boss Reisoku ni Korosareru Gishi desu ga, Kare wo Suki ni Natte Shimaimashita.

209416.description:
Corporate receptionist Fumino Nakatani is allergic to handsome men. After her ex-boyfriend's betrayal traumatized her, glaring at handsome men became a reflex. She still loves them and wants to fix her reflex, but she doesn't know how-until she meets Jin Tokiwa, the hottest guy she's ever seen, and the president of the parent company that owns Fumino's workplace. However, Jin has a problem of his own. Every time he makes eye contact with a woman, he gets sick! Yet somehow, he can handle Fumino's glares, so he asks her to help him cure his fear of women. She agrees and joins his administrative team, but then he asks her to live with him! When Jin gives her a list of things he needs to learn to do with women, she realizes her task is much more complicated than she thought.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: All chapters were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.

title.native: イケメンだから愛せない

209417.description:
College student Kaho has been smitten with up-and-coming novelist Tomoki, who is also her adoptive brother, for as long as she can remember. But, not wanting to ruin her existing relationship with him, she kept her feelings hidden and moved out to live alone. However, due to an unexpected mishap, she ends up moving back in with Tomoki at home - and realizes being at his side as a "sister" isn't enough. Kaho has just reaffirmed her love, but then it turns out another person is already staying at the house! And not only does this Atsufumi notice how she feels about Tomoki, but his condition to keep her secret is: "be my girlfriend"?! Adoptive siblings + the brother's friend - it's an evergrowing chain of unrequited love in this housemate love triangle!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: ハニーハニーホーム

209418.description:
On that day when the witches burned the kingdom to the ground, Abel, a boy who had lived a poor but happy life, lost his family and was about to be killed himself — when Noah, a beautiful witch scorned by others as “Anonymous," saved his life.

Nine years later, Abel, now nineteen, has survived with single-minded determination. As he faces mortal danger in the wilderness, Noah — still looking as youthful as she did that day— appears before him once more.

(Source: Lanove Bunko, translated)

Note: Winner of the 20th Kodansha Lanove Bunko Newcomer Award.

title.native: 世界を焼いた魔女が笑う
title.romaji: Sekai o Yaita Majou ga Warau

209419.description:
Driven by poverty, Xu En’en and Lin Jingzhou were forced to participate in a variety show titled “Who Is The Real Billionaire?” Their mission was to pretend to be a wealthy couple on the show in order to win a million in cash. From then on, the two embarked on a game of celebrity masquerade!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: 落魄夫妻在综艺里当豪门爆红全网

title.native: 伪装名流

209420.description:
After helping a woman who fainted on the street, I discovered that her daughters are the popular and beautiful twin girls in my class — Yuzuki and Haruka Kotobuki! Before I knew it, both of them seem to have developed feelings for me…? A sweet school harem romantic comedy with two unattainable beauties begins with a simple act of kindness!

(Source: Comic Growl, translated)
synonyms: For Saving an Elderly Collapsed Woman, I Got to Date Her Beautiful Twin Daughters

title.native: 倒れた婦人を救ったご褒美は、娘の美人双子とのお付き合いでした。
title.romaji: Taoreta Fujin wo Sukutta go Houbi wa, Musume no Bijin Futago to no Otsukiai Deshita.

title.native: 毒を喰らわばサクラまで

209422.description:
To help support her family, Yoshino works a second job as Mona, a hostess at a cosplay café, on weekends. One day, her cold-hearted boss, Tsukishima—whom she can’t stand—shows up at the café with a client…!? However, he doesn’t recognize Yoshino (aka Mona), who looks like a completely different person thanks to her cosplay and makeup. But after an incident throws them together, Tsukishima begins frequenting the café to see Mona—

(Source: UNext, translated)

title.native: 月山主任は別の私に恋してる
title.romaji: Tsukiyama Shunin wa Betsu no Watashi ni Koishiteru

209423.description:
"We want you to make people believe this war is just. We don't care what the means are." Eight university students have made it through the employment exam at the giant advertising agency "Den-Odo." The final selection challenge they are given is a game in which they must compete to see if they can lead the citizens of a fictional nation to war through advertising! What will be the outcome, and what is the true purpose of this selection?! The unpredictable game developments and shocking ending will make readers question the essence of advertising and what democracy means in the internet age!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: プロパガンダゲーム

209424.description:
King Yuri is bound by tradition to marry the Saint, so fiancée Edeline accepts life as a mere "figurehead queen." Until the Saint appears as a scared five-year-old named Ai. Adopting the child, Yuri and Edeline forge an unexpected family whose love may become the kingdom's greatest power.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: He Said, "I Can't Love You" Because the Saint Was Coming, So I Became a Figurehead Queen... But the Saint Was Just Five, So I Went All-In on Parenting!!
title.native: 聖女が来るから「君を愛することはない」と言われたのでお飾り王妃に徹していたら、聖女が5歳だったので全力で愛します!!
title.romaji: Seijo ga Kuru kara "Kimi wo Ai Suru Koto wa Nai" to Iwareta no de Okazari Ouhi Tettei Shiteitara, Seijo ga 5-sai Datta Node Zenryoku de Aishimasu!!

209425.description:
On our wedding night in bed, I suddenly realized—I was in a novel I'd read in my past life, and I was Liliana, the wicked wife who tormented the protagonist and was eventually divorced by her husband—!! If things continued like this, my ruin was inevitable! I had to somehow avoid becoming a wicked wife...! I didn't love my husband, but I would divorce him peacefully and amicably! But my husband, who I thought was cold and ruthless, seemed strange...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 捨てられるはずの悪妻なのに冷徹侯爵様に溺愛されています
title.romaji: Suterareru Hazu no Akusai na noni Reitetsu Koushaku-sama ni Dekiai sarete Imasu

209426.description:
Celestia, a young lady from a noble family, hears a prophecy from her stepsister, who calls herself the "heroine." "Your engagement will be broken off, and your father will abandon you. In the end, you will go to a convent." To avoid the future of ruin that is unwillingly becoming reality, Celestia becomes an apprentice to her grandfather, a great military leader in the frontier! She resolves to live strongly as a soldier!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 婚約破棄され捨てられるらしいので、軍人令嬢はじめます
title.romaji: Konyaku Haki sare Suterare Rurashii node, Gunjin Reijou Hajimemasu

209427.description:
Himeka Tenma, a sixth-grader in the Amatsu Little League baseball team, is suddenly transported to Mount Kurama during a baseball game in Kyoto. There, he finds Mikazuki, a Kukuri (a yokai user), battling a Karasu Tengu with a giant snake. The Karasu Tengu is eventually bound by the snake, and Tenma is told by Mikazuki, "Don't see, don't hear, don't know about everything that happened here," before he leaves. That night, Mikazuki appears at the inn where Tenma and his friends are staying . He had forgotten a talisman of Fudo Myoo when he met Tenma earlier that day. At that moment, a celestial star appears outside.

(Source: Wikipedia, translated)

title.native: あやかし天馬

209428.description:
Orin Edwards, famed as "The Sage" for training generations of exceptional talent, finally grows fed up with the academy principal's abuse of power and resigns after many long years of service. For his second life, he chooses to settle on a mysterious place known as the "Island that Calls Disaster," where he begins a quiet homesteading lifestyle. Together with his former pupil Patricia, Orin starts exploring the island, encountering its native inhabitants and even uncovering an uncanny shipwreck—gradually drawing closer to the island's hidden truth. Meanwhile, rumors of Orin's resignation reach his former students who now stand at the core of the nation, praised as the "Golden Generation." One after another, they rush to gather around him...! Thus begins the leisurely island life of the resigned sage!

(Source: Alpha Manga)

title.english: A Resigned Sage Longs to Homestead...Leisurely
title.native: 引退賢者はのんびり開拓生活をおくりたい
title.romaji: Intai Kenja wa Nonbiri Kaitaku Seikatsu wo Okuritai

title.native: インキュバスくんは満腹を知らない

209430.description:
Himeno is self-conscious about his high-pitched voice. Drawn to the voice of the club president, he ends up joining the broadcasting club, but he just can't seem to bring himself to reveal his real voice...

A coming-of-age story about true-to-life teenagers!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: ひめごえ
なまら! サキュってベア
此処木九太の目に障る
title.romaji: Kokonegi Kyuuta no Me ni Sawaru

209433.description: The thighs of the girl sitting next to Kuonji, a healthy high school boy, have captured his heart and won't let go. A certain accident brings him into contact with this seemingly unattainable girl, and Kuonji's dull high school life takes a dramatic turn—!!?

title.native: 隣の太ももさん

209434.description:
Princess Mira of the Casparia Empire married into the enemy kingdom of Edelgard, enduring all kinds of mistreatment in the name of peace. However, her hopes were dashed when her homeland was destroyed and she was ordered to divorce. On the day of their separation, just as she was about to return the wedding ring to her husband, Prince Klaus—a man who never loved her—she somehow time-leaped back to their wedding day!?

As she searches for a way to save her homeland once again, she uncovers many unknown sides of her husband!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 敵国で冷遇された皇女様は夫の愛に気づかない
title.romaji: Tekikoku de Reiguu sareta Koujo-sama wa Otto no Ai ni Kizukanai

209435.description:
Kaburagi Rin is suddenly caught up in a saint summoning and transported to another world. Since there are already two saints in the castle, Rin decides to become independent and starts working at a diner on the outskirts of town. However, the food in this world is simply awful. While the manager says, "Effect is more important than taste!", Rin, who wants to eat delicious food, begins to struggle to improve the diner. Gradually, her cooking begins to influence those around her...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: まきこまれ料理番の異世界ごはん
明日、バドミントンしよ
部下の喘ぎを想像するな-after-
title.romaji: Buka no Aegi wo Souzousuru na - after

title.native: 家政夫クマの月野さん

209439.description:
1. Pillow Talk (ピロートーク)
2. Shinju no Kubikazari (真珠の首飾り)
3. Kuro ka Shiro ka (黒か白か)
4. Renai Dairinin (恋愛代理人)
5. Hanakui (花喰い)
6. Christmas ga Kotoshi mo Yattekuru (クリスマスが今年もやってくる)

title.native: 花喰い
年下彼氏溺愛日記

209441.description:
Daisuke is a highly educated, high-earning, and good-looking salaryman. His girlfriend, Ayaka, joins the company as a new employee. To protect Ayaka's career and his own life, this office romance must be kept a secret at all costs. But as their secret relationship deepens, their suppressed reason and desires are on the verge of exploding...!? Daisuke, whose life seems to be going smoothly, also has a certain secret... What will become of the love between these two who are burdened with worries and conflicts they cannot tell anyone about? A realistic and sometimes thrilling office romance story of the Reiwa era begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: ワークスイートバランス
恋ばっかりじゃ生きてけません。

209443.description:
1. Renai Senryaku ka (恋愛戦略家)
2. Kimi ni Dake Himitsu (キミにだけ秘密)
3. Futari Kurashi (ふたり暮らし)
4. Kare no Suki na Hito (彼の好きなヒト)

title.native: 恋愛戦略家

209444.description:
Shiori, an unremarkable, perfectly ordinary office lady, has a secret life at night: she's a popular palm reader!? She started this side job for reasons unknown, keeping it a secret from everyone. But of all people, the last person she wanted to find out has discovered it! Matsudaira Ken, a "scumbag general" who's competent at work but a womanizer. He's taken a liking to Shiori, and she's forced to serve him as his slave—!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: その男、運命につき

209445.description:
Mikage Ranran's profession is a super assistant. Although she enjoys the absolute trust of popular manga artist Ifuu Tango, she struggles every day, unable to give up her dream of becoming a manga artist herself. Will she be able to debut as a manga artist, or will she just continue to drift along as a "professional" assistant...? She's on the verge of giving up, but she can keep going because of her boyfriend, editor Watari Tenpei. But then, an unwanted intruder appears, trying to interfere in their relationship!? ...Wait, is that Mr. Tango!?

What will become of Ranran's love life and career...?

(Source: Shogkukan, translated)

title.native: アンダーヒーロー

209446.description:
In the modern world, "otherworldly dungeons" suddenly appear. Dungeon exploration streams by glamorous streamers have become incredibly popular, and dungeons are now the world's biggest form of entertainment. Meanwhile, Yamaoka Eita lives a life of corporate slavery, completely detached from this world. His only pleasure is playing with his pet, a slime monster from the dungeon. However, the floor Eita and the slime were playing on is an uncharted level, barely accessible even to top streamers—!?

(Source: Ultra Jump, translated)
synonyms: Shachiku tamer, I'm unconsciously unmatched thanks to my cute slime.

title.native: 社畜テイマー、可愛いスライムのおかげで無自覚なまま無双する～うっかり国内トップの配信に映り込んで最強がバレました～
title.romaji: Shachiku Tamer, Kawaii Slime no Okage de Mujikaku na Mama Musou Suru: Ukkari Kokunai Toppu no Haishin ni Utsuri Konde Saikyou ga Baremashita

209447.description:
Haruna Hara, a 32-year-old woman working at her mother's marriage agency, is still single.

"I'll take anyone, but I'm looking for a man who's a graduate of one of the top six universities, earns over 8 million yen a year, has a driver's license, is over 175cm tall, no fat or bald guys, and is good at housework." → Yep, single status guaranteed! ...She hides these thoughts from her heart as she works day after day, and it's no wonder she's lost all desire to get married.

Although she puts on a brave face, she actually once pledged to marry someone. It was her first love at 17... but it ended in a long-distance relationship. So she thought she never believed in love again! But one day, Asuna unexpectedly reunites with her "first love," Hinata...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes three extra chapters.

title.native: あなたは愛を信じますか?
title.romaji: Anata wa Ai wo Shinjimasu ka?

209448.description:
"Shion was murdered. And I lost half of myself..."

Shion and Kuon are twin sisters. One day, Shion, who was an idol, suddenly commits suicide. However, Kuon instinctively feels that Shion was "murdered," and infiltrates the entertainment industry as an "extra" to find the real killer. With the help of Ryuuto, a young actor who was Shion's lover, she investigates the truth, and the dark side of the entertainment industry is revealed one after another. Along with the mysterious keyword "Black Onyx," a certain "drug" is involved. And the relationship between Ryuuto and Kuon also gradually changes...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: エキストラ・ガール
仮面女子の憂鬱

209450.description:
At forty, Jeong Han-Seong finally begins the college life he’s dreamed of, enrolling as a nontraditional student after years in the corporate world. Mistaken for a professor by his much younger classmates, he struggles to find his place, until a helpful senior, Baek Cheong-Bin, steps in. With Cheong-Bin’s guidance, campus life starts to feel less overwhelming… but there’s something about the way this senior looks at him that feels anything but ordinary.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: おじさん！早く大学に来てください！
Monsieur, je vous attends à la fac
Ajusshi! When Are You Coming to College?

title.native: 아저씨! 대학 언제 오세요?

209451.description:
A friend I became close to through our shared love of our favorite idols was murdered. She was a very important friend, someone I could confide in about anything... Until I learned that her name, address, everything about her was a lie. Who was the murdered friend, Fujii Misuzu (a pseudonym)? Why did she have to be killed?

As Kiryu Kokoro is consumed by suspicion, he receives a direct message. The sender is...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 竜崎天音（または藤井美鈴）さんについて
title.romaji: Ryuuzaki Amane (Mata wa Fujii Misuzu)-san ni Tsuite

209452.description:
Yuka, who hasn't had a boyfriend for three years, joins a mountain climbing club on a trial basis in an attempt to find a husband. She expects to feel the stirrings of romance with the club president, Kitayama, and other male members, but...before she can fully enjoy the excitement, she's nearly killed by a grueling mountain climb! Constantly being tossed around by Kitayama's unpredictable words and actions, what will become of this turbulent romance!?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 山恋～山で恋は生まれるか～
title.romaji: Yama Koi: Yama de Koi wa Umareru ka

209453.description:
On her wedding day, the bride, Mai, gets lost inside the venue...! As she struggles to find her way back to the ceremony, what will she discover...?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: まっててダーリン!!!

209454.description:
Kanoko, the only daughter of the 160-year-old Kyoto confectionery shop "Aotsuki," dreams of sharing her beloved Japanese sweets with many people. She joins her grandfather's factory, where he is the foreman, to learn how to make Japanese sweets! Her relationship with her childhood friend, Souya, the second son of a tea family and three years her junior, is also a point of interest!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: 京＊かのこ
田舎の結婚

209456.description:
The story of Reo, who's aiming to be a musician, and Suzu, a student at a famous university. They're polar opposites, but due to mishap, they become roommates...?!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: そらのおと
片想いの終わり

209458.description:
1. Watashi ga Hoshii Koori no Otoko (私が欲しい氷の男)
2. Watashi wo Hossuru Honoo no Onna (私を欲する炎の女)
3. Journal ☆ Revolution (ジャーナル☆革命)
4. Shoku no Hana (蝕の華)

title.native: 私が欲しい氷の男
title.romaji: Watashi ga Hoshii Koori no Otoko

209459.description:
Aya Tsurunaka, a 30-year-old woman who's never had a boyfriend, is just an ordinary office worker who regrets her life so far. She often wonders what her life would have been like if she had mustered the courage to become a "gyaru" (a type of fashionable, often heavily made-up girl) in high school—the very thing she secretly admired and loved. Then, good fortune strikes Aya. She's transported back in time to 200X and given the chance to relive her life as a "Heisei gyaru" high school girl!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: 30-sai mo Onna, Heisei Gyaru ni Naru.

title.native: 30歳喪女、平成ギャルになる。

209460.description:
Chihiro, an office worker who absolutely hates remembering people's names, is transferred to a new department, and things take a turn for the worse! All her new colleagues are neat and tidy in suits, making it impossible to tell them apart... But then, a male colleague appears, offering her her favorite pudding as a helping hand! Chihiro calls him "Pudding Tanaka," and they become close friends. But then, one day, this usually gentlemanly man suddenly transforms—!?

(Source: Alpha Polis, translated)

title.native: プリンの田中さんはケダモノ。
今回の人生はメイドらしい
title.romaji: Konkai no Jinsei wa Maid Rashii

209462.description:
Despite being surrounded by wealthy relatives, Manami is extremely ordinary. She learns that, according to a long-standing agreement, someone in her family must marry the son of a wealthy company owner. However, she was relieved to be at the bottom of the list of candidates...but then she finds out that her potential fiancé is at the company where she started working, and of all things, she ends up becoming his subordinate! What's more, for some reason, he keeps paying attention to her at every turn, bringing them very close!?

(Source: Alpha Polis, translated)

title.native: 4番目の許婚候補
フェイク・スイートホーム

209465.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2026 May issue.

title.native: ガールズライブイン・ライブハウス

209466.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2026 May issue.

With Christmas right around the corner, university student Maki—who doesn't have a lover—decides to sign up for a dating app, but…?

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

title.romaji: Suki ja Nakute mo Bokura wa Koibito

209468.description: A heartwarming story of a young man and a boy who met in a certain abandoned building.

焼き祓え！　ネット巫女つむぎちゃん

209470.description:
What I obtained is the "Lightning Magic" that only I can wield!

So begins the adventure story of the the young man who was transmigrated as the one and only lightning mage and will become the strongest in another world!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Chapters 2 to 18 were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.

title.native: 雷帝の軌跡 ～俺だけ使える【雷魔術】で異世界最強に！～
title.romaji: Raitei no Kiseki: Ore dake Tsukaeru [Kaminari Majutsu] de Isekai Saikyou ni!

title.romaji: Shuuai Libido: Kizu wo Nameau Oretachi wa

Notes:
- All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.
- Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: How can I make you love me?

title.native: どうしたら好きになってくれますか？
title.romaji: Dou Shitara Suki ni Nattekuremasu ka?

title.romaji: Kojirase Pachinkasu wa, Kyou mo Ichizu

title.native: 戦国悲話

209476.description:
Ban Ga-I makes a living by exorcising monsters on the side. One day, a thread goblin suddenly appears and makes a request.

“I’m looking for someone to find my younger brother, the Forest Keeper.”

He accepts the request on the condition that his wish be granted, but the events that unfold during the search for the Forest Keeper begin to strangely overlap with Ban Ga-I’s childhood. Meanwhile, with the Forest Keeper’s absence, the gates to the underworld grow lax, and evil spirits begin to multiply on Earth, taking advantage of the opening…

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 땅의 기록

209477.description:
Beneath Tokyo lies “Ura-Tokyo,” a shadowed counterpart to the city we think we know. There, a secret academy trains exorcists to battle evil spirits. After entering the forbidden grove of Madara Shirazunomori Forest, Soma Kuroniwa is cursed to harbor a spirit of exceptional danger. Hiding his true nature, he enrolls in the academy and throws himself into its brutal training program—one with a graduation rate of only a few percent. When a powerful spirit draws near, the inhuman force sleeping inside him awakens. An action-driven exorcist academy story set in a dark, immersive world.

(Source: K MANGA)
209477.hashtag: #裏東京のオソロシドコロ #裏東京

title.native: 裏東京のオソロシドコロ
正しい恋とよこしまな愛
title.romaji: Tadashii Koi to Yokoshima na Ai

209479.description:
A "god-tier" idol group has suddenly appeared. With their overwhelming performances and devoted fan service, they bring happiness to all who watch them—but just who are they, really?

(Source: Kadocomi, translated)

title.native: 献身的偶像崇拝

209480.description:
Fifteen-year-old Shina lost her parents when her village was attacked by monsters when she was ten. She was taken in by a church where it was discovered that she was a rare user of holy magic and possessed extraordinary magical power. She was recognized as a saint of the Kingdom of Dido and became engaged to Prince Lector, but her engagement was broken off due to a false accusation. The shock of this event caused her to regain memories of her past life, and she gained a life of freedom! This is the success story of the banished strongest saint!

(Source: Shonen Gahosha, translated)

title.native: 追放聖女の勝ち上がりライフ

209481.description:
Eishal, the eldest son of a prestigious noble family, has reached adulthood and has been granted the profession of "Producer" by the gods. However, it is an extremely minor and unfortunate profession. His family is furious that he has tarnished their family name and banishes him to the frontier. But Eishal does not give up even in the face of such adversity. Using the skills of a "Producer" that he has unknowingly awakened, he transforms the remote area into a comfortable utopia with the help of his trusted companions! While he is enjoying this peaceful life, royalty, having heard rumors of the skilled Producer, comes to seek his help...!?

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: 最強の生産王は何がなんでもほのぼのしたいっっっ!
title.romaji: Saikyou no Seisan Ou wa Nani ga Nandemo Honobono Shitai!

title.native: 犯罪十字路
灯台鬼
嵐の波止場
奇襲突撃隊

209486.description:
Ren Natsume, who grew up on an island, loses his life after being swallowed by stormy waves while trying to save a child from the rough sea. After death, he meets the god who governs reincarnation and learns that he was never meant to be born on Earth in the first place. Instead, he is reincarnated as Lyle in the other world where he was originally supposed to be born.

Loved by his new family, Lyle spends his days in peace—until, around the time he turns three, he is reunited with Amon, the beloved dog from his past life! It turns out that Amon crossed the barrier between worlds in pursuit of Lyle, eventually arriving in this land and becoming a Holy Beast.

Lyle wants nothing more than to enjoy a laid-back life in another world with his beloved dog and his family, but one incident after another keeps dragging him in, making the road to a true slow life far harder than expected…?!

A wonderfully gentle otherworldly fantasy begins—with a boy and his beloved dog at its heart!

(Source: Alpha Manga)

title.english: A Slow Life in Another World Isn't So Easy: The Holy Beast's Master Grew Up on an Island
title.native: 異世界じゃスローライフはままならない～聖獣の主人は島育ち～
title.romaji: Isekai ja Slow Life wa Mamanaranai: Seijuu no Shujin wa Shima-sodachi

title.native: 陥落!パパ活男の娘

209488.description: Miyuki is a reliable woman who cares about her younger sister and is relied upon by everyone at work. However, her younger sister, Kyoko, becomes immobile immediately after a small shock or injury. But that's okay. Even if she breaks, she is regularly retrieved and returns in the exact same condition. That's right, she has a subscription to her younger sister.

title.native: 妹・サブスクリプション

209489.description:
Two completely opposite aides serving the "Demon King." One is Rio, a young and dedicated up-and-comer. The other is Virsh, a carefree slacker. During their glorious service in the Demon King's castle, aiming for human world conquest, these two aides chat it up when the Demon King isn't around...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 魔王城サイドウェイ

209490.description:
"Retired S-Rank Adventurer's Slow Life with a Black Dragon"
Lark, a retired S-rank adventurer, was introduced to a "wonderful village" where he could peacefully spend his later years by a friend. However, upon arrival, he finds himself in a deserted village with no one around.
Through an unexpected turn of events, Lark ends up rescuing a Black Dragon who was trapped in a snare. The following day, a black-haired beautiful girl appears before him.
"I am Dia, the dragon you saved the other day! I came to thank you, so please accept my gratitude!" This marks the beginning of Lark's somewhat unconventional and noisy slow life, as he finds himself entwined with a Black Dragon and the adventure that ensues.

title.native: 先日救っていただいたドラゴンです」～押しかけ女房してきた美少女と、隠居した元Sランクオッサン冒険者による辺境スローライフ～
title.romaji: "Senjitsu Sukutte Itadaita Dragon desu": Oshikakenyoubou shitekita Bishoujo to, Inkyo shita Moto S-Rank Ossan Boukensha ni Yoru Henkyou Slow Life

title.native: 処刑された最強の軍用魔術師、敗戦国のエルフ姫と国家再建す～祖国よ邪魔するのは勝手だが、その魔術作ったの俺なので効かないが?～
title.romaji: Shokei sareta Saikyou no Gunyou Majutsushi, Haisenkoku no Elf Hime to Kokka Saiken su: Sokoku yo Jama suru no wa Katte da ga, Sono Majutsu Tsukutta no Ore nanode Kikanai ga?

title.native: 冒険者ギルドの万能アドバイザー ～勇者パーティを追放されたけど、愛弟子達が代わりに魔王討伐してくれるそうです～
title.romaji: Boukensha Guild no Bannou Advisor: Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou sareta kedo, Manadeshi-tachi ga Kawari ni Maou Toubatsu shite Kureru Sou desu

209493.description:
Itaru is a normal salaryman, but his wife is a vampire! She may look cool and composed, but she loves her husband a lot and is the absolute cutest when she occasionally acts lovestruck.

A lovey-dovey, endearingly frustrating and heart-pounding romantic comedy between two newlyweds.

(Source: Comic Walker, translated)

title.native: ふつつかな吸血鬼ですが、末永くよろしくお願いします
title.romaji: Futsutsuka na Kyuuketsuki desu ga, Suenagaraku Yoroshiku Onegaishimasu

209494.description:
Disillusioned with modern society, cigsholic Igasa Ukira drifts through her days in a haze of lethargy. Secondhand smoking complaints, rising cigarette prices, the disappearance of smoking areas, and the relentless anti-smoking trend… What was once seen as cool has become the target of society’s growing hostility toward smokers. Feeling more and more suffocated under those harsh stares, Ukira one day finds herself suddenly summoned to another world—by a demon.

A new laid-back isekai comedy series—of cigsholics, by cigsholics, for cigsholics.

title.native: 異世界ヤニカス
おじさんで埋める穴 2つめ

209497.description: An autobiographical manga focusing on the creation of Great Mazinger.

title.native: 激マン!Z&グレート編
シムーン

209500.description:
We are in the Taishou Era (1912–1926). Sumie, the only daughter of a once-proud warrior clan now fallen from grace, is to marry into the respected Hikashi family, a union intended to restore the lost prestige of her own lineage, the Kanemoto clan.

Yet before even meeting her future husband, the naive and inexperienced Sumie must first test her resolve by immersing herself in the moral decay of her new home.
synonyms: A Taisho Night Romance - Friday's Bride -

title.native: 大正夜伽浪漫 －金曜日の花嫁－
title.romaji: Taishou Yotogi Roman: Kinyoubi no Hanayome

209501.description:
Jun is the greatest scientist among the current spacefaring humanity. As a member of the 17th generation of spacefaring humanity who abandoned Earth to roam the cosmos, he succeeds in developing a vaccine for space sickness. The sole purpose of his research was to awaken Kendrick, a first-generation space human from the 1st century who had been cryogenically frozen after dedicating his life to eradicating space sickness... but as Jun conducted his research, he secretly developed feelings for him. After the vaccine was developed and Kendrick finally awoke, something seemed a little off?!

“Jun, I’ve been waiting for you.”

A single sentence uttered by Kendrick, who had been cryogenically frozen 16 generations ago.

“How does Kendrick know my name?”

Even as He thought, “That can’t be possible…” her heart raced as Kendrick approached him without hesitation. Thus began a romance transcending time and space between the two of them.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: โปรเจกต์กาลาเทออส

title.native: 갈라테오스 프로젝트
응급 맞선

209505.description:
"Please, just give me a day off..."

Souma Hajime, the one and only dungeon explorer in the backwater town of Mifune, is forced to handle all the work by himself due to his guild's severe lack of manpower. In his private life, he is infamous as an annoying “backseat gamer” fan, sending high-value Super Chats to his favorite streamer along with unsolicited, hardcore advice. But his true identity is that of a genuine A-Rank Explorer, standing among the top 0.1% in the nation! This is the story of an overworked, seemingly unremarkable young man who, despite being stuck in a rural town, is about to make his name known across the globe.

title.native: 住んでる場所が田舎すぎて、ダンジョン探索者が俺一人なんだが？
title.romaji: Sunderu Basho ga Inaka Sugite, Dungeon Tansaku-sha ga Ore Hitori nan da ga?

209506.description:
A man with the power to "read" the gods, Miyato, and his younger brother, Kujiki. Their unusual journey leads them to a village abound in rumors that a sacred beast, the Arahabaki, has been devouring humans... From author Fibi Dori comes a spellbinding tale of the chronicles of an epic pilgrimage...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 神ヨムふたり

209507.description:
Notes:
- Chapters 2, 3 and 5 were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.
- Includes one extra chapter.
209507.hashtag: #ご褒美とお仕置きどっちにします
synonyms: Would you rather have a reward or a punishement?

title.native: ご褒美とお仕置きどっちにします？
title.romaji: Gohoubi to Oshioki Docchi ni Shimasu?

209508.description:
Betrayed by her emperor husband, her children slaughtered, and her noble family destroyed, Shen Miao dies with hatred in her heart, only to wake up as her 14-year-old self. This time, she'll rewrite her fate. Protect her family. Crush her enemies. And carve out her place in the empire. But she never expected him, the unruly young marquis who laughs at power and claims her with a smirk, "Take the world if you want… but you’re mine."

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Rebirth of the Malicious Queen of Military Lineage
皇帝に殺された私は愛を捨てて復讐する

title.native: 重生之将门毒后
title.romaji: Chongsheng Zhi Jiang Men Du Hou

title.native: 花ちゃんと玲くん
義姉さんはスキだらけ！？
秋隣
異世界チ♂ポ勇者
親の連れ子のカースト上位ギャルとヤりまくった話
title.romaji: Oya no Tsurego no Caste Joui Gal to Yarimakutta Hanashi

title.native: 据え膳すぎる幼馴染は××ですか？
title.romaji: Suezen Sugiru Osananajimi wa ×× desu ka?

209515.description:
Ryuk, a young man adopted into a noble family, receives a mysterious item called a "smartphone" during a once-in-a-lifetime ceremony where he is granted a gift by a god. Not knowing how to use it, Ryuk is treated as useless and disowned by his adoptive father. However, this smartphone is actually an extraordinary, super-powerful gift capable of anything from appraisal and ability copying to item duplication and equipment synthesis...!! With this immense power, Ryuk aims to become the strongest adventurer who can protect himself and others! A super-fast rise-to-power fantasy with a cheat item begins!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: 勘当貴族なオレのクズギフトが強すぎる!
title.romaji: Kandou Kizoku na Ore no Kuzu Gift ga Tsuyosugiru!

209516.description:
"I've never even touched this part of you... Has anyone else allowed you to?" My scheming ex-boyfriend is obsessively clinging to me!? Clumsy but hardworking office lady Satsuki Fumino can't forget her ex-boyfriend who traumatized her. But one day, her ex-boyfriend, Chiaki Iura, starts working at her company! Seeing how popular he is at the welcome party, Satsuki gets terribly drunk and is taken home by Iura. "I'm sorry. Satsuki, you're just too cute, I couldn't resist." She was supposed to have broken up with him, but he's exposing and sucking on her sensitive parts, and is obsessed with her... What should she do!?

(Source: Brite Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 隠れてないで出ておいで～執着系元カレにトラウマ乳首を狙われてます～
title.romaji: Kakuretenai de Deteoide: Shuuchaku-kei Motokare ni Trauma Chikubi wo Nerawaretemasu

209517.description:
"I wished to marry you from the bottom of my heart." It was supposed to be a loveless marriage to a rival...!

Iori, the daughter of the CEO of a large real estate conglomerate, is ordered to marry Takanari, the CEO of a rival conglomerate, in a marriage of convenience with a time limit. Their married life was full of days where she never saw her cool and collected husband, but Iori was doing her best through it since their divorce was already planned.

However, after he started showing Iori his true self and his kindness, she began thinking of him with a little more fondness. What if he really wasn't a cold person after all? Iori gathered her courage to ask him to help her with a specific problem, and after that, Takanari suddenly changed!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: My Doting Husband Won't Let Me Leave Our Marriage of Convenience!
title.native: 政略結婚のはずが、溺愛旦那様がご執心すぎて離婚を許してくれません
title.romaji: Seiryaku Kekkon no Hazu ga, Dekiai Danna-sama ga Goshuushin Sugite Rikon wo Yurushite Kuremasen

209518.description:
A villainess whose engagement was broken off summons a 4.5-tatami mat Japanese-style room with "desperate magic"?! Find solace in modern Japan! An isekai (another world) transfer comedy!

(Source: Saizensen, translated)

title.native: 悪役令嬢の四畳半
ゆる〜くガンバレ！中村くん!!

209520.description:
"I got a girlfriend."

Airi has been married to her husband, Eita, for a year, but is astonished to hear his sudden proclamation that he has been cheating. Thinking that their married life was hunky-dory, Airi falls apart. While going through her despair, Airi meets a skillful president named Rei Naruse at a cooking class. As a man who doesn't mince words, Naruse is set to help guide Airi to get her life back on track!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 成瀬社長は面倒見が良すぎる。
title.romaji: Naruse Shachou wa Mendoumi ga Yosugiru.

209521.description:
Shen Changjun is determined to change the tragic fate of the villainous disciple in the original story by crafting a perfect, radiant image of his virtuous master. Little does he know, after nine thousand nights, the disciple is reborn—and now vows to never let Shen Changjun escape his grasp.

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 今日も弟子に狙われている
A Rebellious Disciple Wants to Deceive His Master and Offend His Superiors Everyday

title.english: The Disciple’s Daily Plan: Seduce the Master
title.native: 逆徒每天都想欺师犯上
title.romaji: Nitu Meitian Du Xiang Qi Shi Fanshang

209522.description:
Rin Kaidou, the young heir to the world-renowned Kaidou family, has been living a lonely life, constantly targeted for assassination since the accidental death of his parents. Then, Nagase, a former SP bodyguard, appears before him. However, Nagase harbors a secret...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: 僕と死神＜ボディガード＞の黒い糸
Boku to Shinigami no Kuroi Ito

title.native: 僕と死神の黒い糸
title.romaji: Boku to Bodyguard no Kuroi Ito

209523.description: Note: Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv, was then licensed by Square Enix for commercial release.
synonyms: 敬語崩れちゃう系執事
Aru Shounen to Shitsuji no Hanashi

title.native: この国の不幸に仕えて
title.romaji: Kono Kuni no Fukou ni Tsukaete

title.native: しーくれっトラいふ！

209525.description:
"Where is my destined bride...?" Countess Seraphina, who lost her parents at a young age and has since taken on the duties of the lord in place of her younger brother, finds herself in a predicament at a ball when she saves Duke Maynard from a difficult situation. This leads to a contract marriage between the two. However, Maynard suddenly declares, "I have someone I love..."?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)
synonyms: My Husband Who Said He Has Someone Else to Love Won't Let Me Go

title.native: 愛する人は他にいると言った夫が、私を離してくれません
title.romaji: Ai suru Hito wa Hoka ni Iru to Itta Otto ga, Watashi wo Hanashite Kuremasen

209526.description:
Amane has taken a complete U-turn in his life, moving from Tokyo City back to the countryside after his grandmother left him her house. The night after moving in he decides to kill time by jerking off when two attractive and completely naked men suddenly appear before him! They turn out to be spirits that were sealed away in the house and are extremely curious when it comes to humans. And now they're both licking Amane all over...?!

This is a love story of two doting spirits and a gullible idiot as they learn how to live together.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ボクらの可愛いニンゲンさま
末端将軍の希なる花嫁 没落した姫君との幸せな政略結婚
title.romaji: Mattan Shougun no Mare Naru Hanayome: Botsuraku shita Himegimi to no Shiawase na Seiryaku Kekkon

209528.description:
Himari Niiyama had a secret she couldn't tell anyone: she could see beings that weren't human. One day, on her way home, Himari was attacked by a demon—a dead person who had turned into an evil spirit—and was saved by her gruff boss, Reiya Aizawa. Then he revealed a shocking truth: he was a half-demon, half-wolf god and half-human! "If things continue like this, the demons will target you again," Aizawa said to the frightened Himari, offering her a proposition in the name of a "contract." "I'll protect you. In return, become my bride."

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 今宵、狼神様と契約夫婦になりまして
title.romaji: Koyoi, Ookami Kamisama to Keiyaku Fuufu ni Narimashite

209529.description:
Tooru Orikasa is a shy college student and a closeted fudanshi. He has been quietly going through university life, but somehow, he catches the attention of Ao Hatori, a bright and outgoing student from another department. Thanks to Hatori's easygoing and thoughtful nature, Tooru finds himself going shopping and even to karaoke after class. Spending time with friends is unbelievably fun!! Then one day, after witnessing two male friends kissing, Tooru is left flustered. That is when Hatori leans in close and asks, "Want to try it?"—!?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: からかわないで、羽鳥くん。
最悪の人生

209531.description:
Having lost her parents at a young age, Miharu was treated like a housekeeper by her uncle's family, the Samejima family. One day, Kanato, the heir to the Kuronagi conglomerate, comes to visit the Samejima house for work. Upon learning of Miharu's circumstances, Kanato unexpectedly proposes to her...!? Taking Kanato's hand, Miharu decides to leave the Samejima house. From then on, her days are filled with luxurious dinners, beautiful dresses, and Kanato's kindness, and she is overwhelmed with boundless affection...

This marriage is filled with the highest level of love—the story of what happens after Cinderella marries her prince.

(Source: Starts Publishing, translated)

title.native: 君はシンデレラ～孤高な御曹司が絶え間なく愛を注ぐ理由～
title.romaji: Kimi wa Cinderella: Kokou na Onzoushi ga Taema Naku Ai wo Sosogu Riyuu

209532.description:
A manga adaptation of short stories depicting Japanese-style romance, from snow women to noble ladies! A happy-ending anthology containing all 5 stories♪

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title.native: 大和撫子は素敵な恋を夢見る 和風恋愛アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Yamato Nadeshiko wa Suteki na Koi wo Yumemiru: Wafuu Renai Anthology Comic

209533.description:
Countess Aurelia has been living in silence with her husband, Leclerc, whom she married at the age of 18, for two years. She has adored him ever since she first saw his portrait, but she discovers that Leclerc has a former lover with whom he broke up due to opposition from those around them. Troubled, Aurelia confides in a suspicious fortune teller she happens upon, and is given a mysterious ring...

A three-month story depicting how two people who keep missing each other end up becoming a real married couple!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)
synonyms: The strange three months between me and my husband who was supposed to have no interest in me.

title.native: 透明人間になったわたしと、わたしに興味がない（はずの）夫の奇妙な三か月間
title.romaji: Toumei Ningen ni Natta Watashi to, Watashi ni Kyoumi ga Nai (Hazu no) Otto no Kimyou na Sankagetsukan

209534.description:
Lonely young princess Leticia, a reincarnated princess, is married off to Diana, a kingdom blessed by dragons, as a way to get rid of her burden. Her husband is Prince Ferris, the brother of King Ferris, who is rumored to be cold and ruthless, but the two outcasts quickly hit it off! They form a secret alliance, sharing their struggles in life, enjoying rosewater afternoon tea together, bringing him late-night snacks because she worries about his small appetite, and finding solace in dreams of dragons resembling him... and unexpectedly, a fluffy and heartwarming everyday life begins!? However, the succession to the throne and the fate of Ferris, a descendant of the Dragon King, intertwined in the background of this marriage will soon lead them into the midst of a conflict. "I will definitely protect you," "I must protect His Highness."

(Source: Corona EX, translated)

title.native: 五歳で、竜の王弟殿下の花嫁になりました@COMIC
title.romaji: Gosai de, Ryuu no Outei Denka no Hanayome ni Narimashita @Comic

209535.description:
The story follows Chihiro, a high school girl determined to help her friend Yuzu achieve her first love. One day—sparked by the idea of a double date—Chihiro approaches Akamine, a boy who happens to be on good terms with the object of Yuzu's affection, and asks for his cooperation in bringing the two together. However, he flatly turns her down, retorting, "Why don't you just leave them alone?" and "You're such a busybody." The story follows the romance that unfolds between these two individuals, whose personalities and mindsets couldn't be more incompatible.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: The Villain Caught in a Trap

title.native: 罠にかかったヴィランくん

209536.description:
Falling for that tomboyish girl, or having her fall for you—!?

You too might fall for that girl crush girl, or that plain and quiet girl! A "tomboy x yuri" anthology featuring completely new illustrations by a stellar lineup of artists!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ボーイッシュな彼女に沼ってく!? 百合アンソロジー
title.romaji: Boyish na Anoko ni Numatteku!? Yuri Anthology

209537.description:
Mok Hwi-Young, a prominent merchant of the Central Plains, is killed in an attack by the Demon Sect one day. Just as he believes he has died, he finds himself transported back to his childhood—some thirty years earlier—when he was training as a lay disciple at the Wudang Sect. Then, a mysterious bamboo tablet appears before Hwi-Young, offering to buy and sell martial arts talents... What will Mok Hwi-Young be able to accomplish now that he has returned to the Wudang Sect?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 현질무신

209538.description:
Live and die by your fists!

High school student Park Ki-Hyun is more confident in his fighting skills than anyone else. He assumed he’d naturally become the center of attention at his new school after transferring—

“Huh? Knocking someone out in one hit was my specialty, wasn’t it…?”

The result? Just one match! Facing an overwhelming opponent, Ki-Hyun’s pride is shattered, and driven by a single-minded determination to win, he eventually steps onto the mat— Hey, let’s have a match!!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 나랑 한판

209539.description:
Seo-Hun, an unknown idol in his third year since debut. When illegal footage of his younger brother, Eloy, a successful idol in contrast to him, is leaked, Seo-Hun assaults another idol who insulted his brother during a live broadcast. Afterward, Eloy takes his own life, and Seo-Hun’s life also spirals into ruin.

Heart-Pounding Island, an extreme deserted island survival variety show featuring celebrities like Seo-Hun who have caused controversy and seen their lives plummet into ruin.

“The person who ruined Eloy’s life is there.”

Drawn in by a call from a mysterious figure, Seo-Hun participates in the 10-day show to uncover the truth behind his brother’s death.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 두근두근 아일랜드

209540.description:
On the day I was betrothed to the Crown Prince, I witnessed my father and the Empress in a compromising position. For my mother’s sake, I tried to pretend I hadn’t seen anything and endure it. But after my mother discovered the truth and took her own life, all that was left for me was revenge. To deal with these madmen, don’t I have to become a madwoman myself?

“Your Royal Highness, the Crown Prince, will you marry me?”

The day before the wedding, to take revenge on the Empress and my father, I proposed to my fiancé’s half-brother.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Beginning of Revenge Starts with Marriage

title.native: 복수의 시작은 결혼부터

209542.description:
A single family photograph. For Kano, it was a fleeting moment of happiness. Five-year-old Kano endured daily abuse from her mother, never allowed to leave her room. One day, her mother brought home a man, saying, "Here's your new daddy." Then, her younger sister, Rino, was born, but in addition to her mother's abuse, she also began to suffer violence from her father. Her father abandoned her mother, and her mother left, abandoning her two young children. With no one to turn to for help, the sisters faced a life-threatening situation due to hunger and loneliness.

From neglectful parents to a children's home. A story depicting the harsh fate of two young sisters!!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

title.native: サクラ色の傷痕
飛び勃ち

209544.description:
A strange horror flashing within a short panel. A horror cuttoon comic by artist Gompo that captures bizarre moments beyond reality.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

title.native: 곰포만화

209545.description:
Warden, a police officer dispatched to a remote island to investigate the disappearance of a colleague. While interviewing the island’s residents, he encounters “Skol,” an outsider in the village. Skol is despicable, completely lacking in consideration for others, and seems to look down on everyone except himself. Yet, despite his clumsiness—which betrays the fact that he knows something—Warden continues to seek him out. Then, at Skoll’s house, he discovers evidence suggesting his colleague may have been murdered...

“I wonder how you’re different from Baltran. If you sleep with me once, I’ll tell you everything.”

How much of Skoll’s words should Warden believe?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.native: 창백한 등대

209546.description:
Min-Seo is a long-term student on leave who, having left behind a childhood of privilege and parental love, is now struggling on his own. Upon reuniting with Chae-Hui, whom he had a crush on in elementary school, Min-Seo is forced to confront how much his circumstances have changed. Unable to read the stoic Chae-Hui’s true intentions, Hwan—disguised as a good friend—is quietly tightening the noose around Min-Seo without his knowledge...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title.native: 첫사랑넘버?

209547.description:
Seung-Tae, the executive with a gangster past whom everyone fears. His loyal secretary, Su-Ho, has secretly harbored a crush on Seung-Tae for a long time. One day, Su-Ho is summoned by Seung-Tae and receives a suggestive request.

“Su-Ho, hit me just once.”

Seung-Tae lies face-down on a chair, taking the blows to his buttocks, while Su-Ho grows increasingly aroused. The tension in the office continues to rise...

“Executive, are you satisfied with this?”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: 내가 사랑하는 보스
영혼이 타락하는 과정

209549.description:
In the pitch-black night, lit only by pale moonlight, Soon-jeong surrenders herself to Master Jin-hu. Forced to take the place of her delicate mistress, the young maid becomes the secret outlet for a lord’s dark, unbridled lust. Jin-hu is cold, arrogant, and ruthless, treating Soon-jeong as a mere physical relief rather than a human being. He warns her never to expect affection or softness. Yet as his hard touch and relentless desires push her to her limits, Soon-jeong finds herself bound to a master whose cold breath and burning dynamic threaten to destroy her completely.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 비첩
義兄かすみ35歳
雌ドレイ宣誓
色濃いあのコ
夏のかげり
早退した日

209555.description:
A young girl with the face of an angel but the spirit of a demon finds herself transported to a world of beasts, where she becomes a goddess desired by all. Every beastman dreams of being with her, but she has her own plans to tame them.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.native: 傲娇兽夫驯服计划

209556.description:
"Witch Evalina, be the consort of Prince Demetrio..."

Evalina, a rare witch, has succeeded in bringing the murdered prince back to life. However, to make the resurrection perfect, the prince and Evalina need to have sex!? Unable to let the prince she has brought back to life die, Evalina spends the night with him, just for that one night. But the next day, the prince declares that he will take responsibility and marry her! She refuses, but he presses on her with even greater intensity...

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: 魔女と王子の契約情事
title.romaji: Majo to Ouji no Keiyaku Jouji

209557.description:
Kokoro started working at a pastry shop owned by a famous "patissier" Haremichi. One day, she accidentally falls off from stairs...the next moment, found herself on a street that looks strange. She has traveled time--to the EDO era! She meets a man struggling to make a new type of sweets for Shogun Tsunayoshi's wife and helps him. The sweet was highly praised, and she gets a job at inner palace as a pastry chef. She didn't know there were other people who traveled time to this era... A time-travelling love story!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 大奥のパティシエール！

209558.description:
1. 19-Sai. Ai wo Tsuranuku Tame ni (19歳。愛をつらぬくために)
2. Deawanakereba Yokatta (出会わなければよかった)
3. Koe no Nai Message (声のないメッセージ)

title.native: 19歳。愛をつらぬくために

209559.description:
Cover Illustration: Taya Mugi
1. Oshi no Tame ni Shindekure (推しのために死んでくれ) [furu]
2. Anata no Tonari de Waraitai (あなたの隣で笑いたい) [Wamome Hamazono]
3. Oshi katsu Material Girl (推し活マテリアルガール) [Mikage Otsumeshi]
4. Mireba me no Doku, Kikeba Kinodoku (見れば目の毒、聞けば気の毒) [Zou Michikusa]
5. 0.5 no Zettai Fukashin Ryouiki (0.5の絶対不可侵領域) [Fumie Suzuki]

title.native: 一生ずっと私の推しはあなただけ アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Issho Zutto Watashi no Oshi wa Anata dake Anthology Comic

209560.description:
In the Kingdom of Calum, Iris, the daughter of the duke, suddenly has a rush of memories flood her mind. She remembers her past life as a 30 year old office worker and her current life is actually that of a video game! To make matters worse, she is the villainess! In the midst of a fateful event, she awakens her new ability, the "Power of Knowledge". Can she use her knowledge of her past life and her new found ability to avoid every flag that might lead to her execution?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: I'm the Villainess in This Story? Then I'll Use My Power to Change Everything!

title.english: The Villainess's Unique Ability: I Don't Wanna Die, So I'm Gonna Use the "Power of Knowledge" to Dodge Every Death Event
title.native: 悪役令嬢の意外な能力〜死にたくないのでチートスキル 「識る力」をつかってすべての破滅フラグを回避させていただきます〜ての破滅フラグを回避させていただきます〜
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou no Igai na Nouryoku: Shinitakunai no de Cheat Skill "Shiru Chikara" wo Tsukatte Subete no Hametsu Flag wo Kaihisasete Itadakimasu

209561.description:
"If I were to die, who would you drink tea with?"

Mitsuruko, a refined yet endearingly absent-minded young lady, opens her home to Ritsu, a practical vocational student newly arrived in Tokyo. What begins as a matter of convenience soon grows into a quiet companionship, shaped by shared laughter, small mishaps, and the comforting ritual of afternoon tea.

Long ago, Mitsuruko was told by her grandmother to find someone to share tea with. But after leaving home, she comes to understand just how lonely a solitary cup can be. Now, brought together by chance, the two begin to fill that quiet space in each other's lives. For Ritsu, life with Mitsuruko is anything but orderly—meals are burnt, bathwater is left running, and the rhythm of the household is delightfully unpredictable. She cannot help but question what lies ahead, yet gradually begins to see the quiet warmth beneath Mitsuruko's clumsy charm.

Bound by a promise whispered over teacups, they navigate the small, fleeting moments of daily life, discovering that even the most ordinary days can hold something quietly extraordinary.

(Source: Crossed Hearts)

Note: Released at COMITIA 144, 149 and 152.

title.native: ふたりでアフタヌーンティーを
元ヤン執事はワガママ主人をしつけたい
title.romaji: Motoyan Shitsuji wa Wagamama Shujin wo Shitsuketai

title.native: 俺の青春を返してくれっ！
title.romaji: Ore no Seishun wo Kaeshite Kure!

title.native: 神の手違いでイケメンに求愛されました！
title.romaji: Kami no Techigai de Ikemen ni Kyuuaisaremashita!

209566.description: Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, was then licensed and compiled by Kadokawa for commercial release.

title.native: 真面目メガネくんをオトしたい

synonyms: the wolf hiding its true nature and the lamb being deceived

title.native: 隠れ狼と流され子羊
まるで、恋愛小説のような
title.romaji: Marude, Renai Shousetsu no You na

209569.description:
Waka and her family are trembling with joy as she becomes pregnant with their long-awaited second child. But when she reaches eight months pregnant, something strange happens to Waka's body. As Waka blames herself for losing her precious child, someone gently reaches out to her...

A moving story that will bring tears to your eyes, dedicated to mothers who are working hard raising their children and to mothers of the future.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes the one-shot "Mahou no Yubisaki (魔法の指先)".

title.native: 8か月の天使: はじめてママになれた日
title.romaji: 8-kagetsu no Tenshi: Hajimete Mama ni Nareta Hi

209570.description:
In this world, there are mysterious spiritual beings called ayakashi. Several of them look after a young girl named Yoshino, who was abandoned at a local shrine, and life there is anything but boring. There are scuffles between cursed dolls, and even a ghost who’s training to become a ninja! But if Yoshino is intent on being the shrine’s next priestess, she’ll have to accept that not all ayakashi are so harmless. What valuable and bittersweet lessons about life and loss will her quirky spirit friends teach her?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: あやかしアラモード

209571.description:
Hey, the name’s Heresy! I was born and raised in a remote farming village, but it’s always been my dream to become a summoner. And thanks to the superspecial friend I made when I was little, I get to turn that dream into a reality! Isn’t that right, Happy?

"evfugwabkhenfjelwiasbdvl"

You took the words right out of my mouth! Because of you, I was deemed worthy to enter the Meilleur Royal Summoning Academy, and I can’t wait for my exciting high school life to begin! I bet we’ll make tons of new friends and share all sorts of precious moments together. In fact, why don’t you come on out and say hello to everyone?

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Why do you run away? Why? My summoned beast is very cute!

title.english: Why Run? My Summoned Beast Is Cute!
title.native: なぜ逃げるんだい？　僕の召喚獣は可愛いよ
title.romaji: Naze Nigerun dai? Boku no Shoukanjuu wa Kawaii yo

209572.description: Happy, whom Heresy summoned when he was little, is actually a sweet, kind-hearted girl. Even if her looks are a tiny bit grotesque! At the Summoner Academy, Heresy is treated like a total anomaly. Even though he's just trying to act "normal," he keeps unknowingly getting dragged into some absolutely insane situations...!?
synonyms: Why do you run away? Why? My summoned beast is very cute!

title.native: なぜ逃げるんだい？ 僕の召喚獣は可愛いよ
title.romaji: Naze Nigerun dai? Boku no Shoukanjuu wa Kawaii yo

209573.description:
Reina, the princess of the Kingdom of Fromesia, has always been looked down on as an illegitimate child amongst royalty. As part of an agreement to maintain peace between two kingdoms, Reina is sent in place of her stepsister to be married to the prince of the kingdom of Beastmen. On arrival, Reina expects to be welcomed by Prince Cain, rumored to be fearsome and almighty. However, the man who appears before her is anything but! With shining golden eyes, delicate charm, and an emotionally mature demeanor, Prince Cain welcomes Reina to his domain, and the wedding proceeds without a hitch. However, as they meet for their first night as husband and wife, Prince Cain states that this marriage is only for current circumstances and will only be temporary... what could he possibly mean...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Persecuted Princess Cherished by the Prudent Dragon Prince
title.native: 虐げられた花嫁は冷徹竜王様に溺愛される
title.romaji: Shiitagerareta Hanayome wa Reitetsu Ryou-sama ni Dekiaisareru

209574.description:
A collection of "girl meets girl" one-shots that earnestly portray the hope found in making a fresh start!

1. Glittering (グリッタリング); Feel Young 2024-06, 2024-07
Miri, a former child star, navigates her high school life holding onto the belief that her partner, Hano—who vanished at the height of their popularity—will one day return. Though she keeps everyone at arm's length, a faint hope lingers in Miri's heart: "If Hano comes back, everything will go back to the way it was." Then, a junior student named Hiyori appears before Miri—a self-proclaimed fan who dreams of becoming an idol herself. As Miri lends her support to Hiyori in pursuit of her dream, her own stagnant heart begins to stir once more...

2. Growing (グローイング); Feel Young 2025-08, 2025-09
A story depicting the struggles of Nagetsu, an aspiring idol who gave up on her dream to become a vocal coach instead.

(Source: Shodensha, translated and edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: グリッタリング

209575.description:
This is the first manga about menus by Sayaka Yamazaki, the creator of "Shimashima," "Siren," and "Andaz: Rina's Story." It features recipes you'll want to try and the daily life of a slightly goofy cohabiting couple.

Two people and one cat have a mysterious encounter. As a result, Shu-kun and Aya-chan start living together, and their pet cat, Mike, cooks dinner for them!?

(Source: Bungeishunju, translated)

title.native: にゃーの恩返し~2人と1匹のウチごはん~
title.romaji: Nyaa no Ongaeshi: Futari to Ichibiki no Uchi Gohan

209576.description:
Having given up his rebellious ways, Kazumi Hino's goals are "a normal girl and a bright youth!" Using a magazine as a guide, he invites his high school classmate, Kiyomi Harada, to go roller skating. Then, he boldly confesses his love on the screen at Alta...!? This is the marathon story of Kazumi, who suddenly gives up his rebellious ways and aims for a bright youth!!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: ブルー・ジーン

209577.description:
Long ago, there was a wooden gate at the entrance to the castle town, which opened at 5 a.m. and closed at 10 p.m. The person who opened and closed it was the live-in gatekeeper. The gatekeeper was like a civil servant in today's terms, but because of his meager salary, he was allowed to have a side job, and our gatekeeper, Bantaro, made ends meet by selling some food. And today, someone comes to Bantaro's place again...!? Enjoy seasonal delicacies in a rakugo (traditional Japanese storytelling) style!

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

title.native: 木戸番の番太郎　昔の噺と食の愉しみ
title.romaji: Kidoban no Bantarou: Mukashi no Hanashi to Shoku no Tanoshimi

209578.description:
Na-Hui, who has spent her entire life feeling discriminated against compared to her older brother, still longs for her mother’s love. When her brother brings home his fiancée, she is filled with hope that she might finally become her mother’s number one priority—but an unexpected person appears on the scene...

What choices will her mother, Na-Hui, and her new sister-in-law make, and what kind of family will they become?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 엄마는 남자만 좋아해

209579.description: Note: Part of Haewadal Studio's Saekya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Saekya Short Collection] Childhood Friend and a Hypnosis App

title.native: 소꿉친구와 최면어플

209580.description:
"How should I interact with my child?"

First-time mothers are always full of anxiety and worries. But don't worry. You're not alone in your struggles... This is an anthology of masterpieces supporting mothers who are working hard for their children's smiles. You'll surely find yourself in the stories of these six mothers who are working hard at raising their children.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 初めてママになるあなたへ～９.２％からの出発～
title.romaji: Hajimete Mama ni Naru Anatahe: 9.2% kara no Shuppatsu

209581.description:
A mother struggling with the education of her second child. A mother unable to stop her husband's abuse of their child. A mother raising a child while suffering from a memory disorder. A mother who has a child who is deaf. A mother who gave birth at the age of 15. A heartwarming and moving collection of short stories about mothers and their children facing various worries and hardships.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 初めてママになるあなたへ～９８.９％の真実～
title.romaji: Hajimete Mama ni Naru Anatahe: 98.9% no Shinjitsu

209582.description:
Meeting your baby, becoming a mother—it's a miracle. A life you longed for, a life you received unexpectedly. The 280 days with your unborn child are a precious time to deepen the bond between mother and child. This moving anthology supports mothers who want to share the joy and anticipation of pregnancy, and those who want the courage to face the fear of childbirth. It includes five stories on themes such as childbirth while battling cancer and infertility treatment. It also includes stories about sexual concerns during pregnancy.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 初めてママになるあなたへ　～８％の奇跡～
title.romaji: Hajimete Mama ni Naru Anatahe: 8% no Kiseki

title.native: グラスメイト
シュガーパニック
忘却のヨシオ

209586.description:
Sometimes it’s animals, sometimes it’s humans, but, today too, the person coming to Olivia’s restaurant holds painful memories in their heart.

Olivia, who runs a soup restaurant outside of town on the edge of the forest, has a secret she can’t tell anyone. She can hear animals’ and humans’ inner voices. This ability left her alienated from her family to the point that they sent her away to a convent when she was only five years old. After escaping while en route, she was brought to the restaurant by the people who would become her adoptive grandparents. Twenty years later, Olivia continues to live with her heart closed off to other humans, until, one day, a former mercenary by the name of Arthur stops by on a rainy morning, dripping wet. And what are those feelings he starts to develop for her?

Soup Forest is a place of meetings and partings, a place filled with the forest’s bounties, a place of gathering for both animals and humans. They come together, share a meal, go their separate ways, and continue on with their lives.

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

title.english: Soup Forest: The Story of the Woman Who Speaks with Animals and the Former Mercenary
title.native: スープの森~動物と会話するオリビアと元傭兵アーサーの物語~
title.romaji: Soup no Mori: Doubutsu to Kaiwa suru Olivia to Moto Yohei Arthur no Monogatari

209587.description: "Relay" essay published in Wings. Each chapter features a contribution from a different mangaka.

title.native: 犬が西向きゃ尾は東
title.romaji: Inu ga Nishi Muya O wa Higashi

209588.description: One page mangas drawn by mangakas in the magazine Wings - each chapter features a different mangaka

title.native: WINGS PAPER COLLECTION
東京シンデレラ

209590.description:
Minori Nashihara has the ability to hear the whispers of people's hearts when they come in within a certain range... in other words, she's a telepath. Because of this ability, she has had a difficult past, and has had to keep her distance from people to avoid reading their minds. One day, she is summoned by her uncle and CEO of the company she works for, Suzumiya, and ordered to marry Shishizuka, her capable but self-centered boss! Naturally, Minori and Shishizuka both refuse, but Shishizuka readily agrees when he hears that marriage will allow him to take charge of a project that could become the company's fortune. Caught in the middle of all this, they reluctantly begin life together in a fake marriage between boss and subordinate...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I'm Telepathic and I'm Marrying My Boss
title.native: エスパーな私が上司と結婚することになりまして
title.romaji: Esper na Watashi ga Joushi to Kekkon Suru Koto ni Narimashite

title.native: シンデレラの森

209592.description:
All Yuzuki wanted was to have a baby, but she suffered repeated miscarriages. Then, the life she conceived again was taken from her at eight months due to a congenital abnormality. Yuzuki continues to blame herself for not being able to give birth to her child. Who brought light into Yuzuki's life? Infertility treatment, prenatal diagnosis...

This is a moving story of love and rebirth of a real-life couple who overcame various difficulties.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

1. Tengoku no Sora e: Unde Agerare Nakatta Wagako ni (天国の空へ～産んであげられなかったわが子に～)
2. Mama, Dakko shite. (ママ、だっこして。)
3. 2-ji no Haha ni Narimashita (２児の母になりました)

title.native: 天国の空へ～産んであげられなかったわが子に～
title.romaji: Tengoku no Sora e: Unde Agerare Nakatta Wagako ni

209593.description:
Apparently, one in four couples getting married in Japan now have a "shotgun wedding"! A baby arrives unexpectedly, bringing joy but also a lot of anxiety. But there's also an extraordinary joy and emotion unique to "shotgun weddings"! This omnibus collection compiles the tear-jerking stories of these girls. It also includes a hilarious real-life birth story from a manga artist!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: ４人に１人はハッピーできちゃった婚

209594.description:
1. Haru ni Mau Yuki (春に舞う雪)
2. 5-nen me no Saikai: Konayuki no Tsugunai (5年目の再会～粉雪のつぐない～)
3. 92 Pon no Bara: 3-kagetsu no Koibito (92本のバラ～3か月の恋人～)

title.native: 春に舞う雪

209595.description:
Based on reader submissions to the Dessert magazine editorial department, this collection features five miraculous, true-to-life love stories. From a three-month-only romance to a seven-year-long first love, this is a collection of masterpieces guaranteed to bring you to tears.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

1. 92 Pon no Bara : 3-kagetsu no Koibito (92本のバラ～3か月の恋人～) [Yukari Kawachi]
2. Watayuki Letter (綿雪レター)
3. Sensei (先生)
4. Ayamachi (あやまち)
5. Ten no Anata e (天のあなたへ)

title.native: 本気泣き。－ケータイ小説より泣ける読者体験手記－
title.romaji: Honki Naki.: Ketai Shousetsu Yori Nakeru Dokusha Taiken Shuki

title.native: 忘れなくてよかった

209597.description:
1. Kusuri Yubi no Uso (くすり指の嘘)
2. Yasashii Kareshi no Tsukuri kata (やさしい彼氏のつくりかた)
3. Kimi wo Wasurenai (君を忘れない)
4. Waka tte Hoshii: 10-dai de Mama ni Natta Onnanoko (わかってほしい～１０代でママになった女の子)
5. Anata ni Aeta (あなたに逢えた)

Yuki, who works at a Japanese confectionery shop, has been cleaning up after her older sister's messes since childhood. Then one day, her sister messes up again. Just before a blind date with the son of a client company, she discovers she's pregnant! Begged by her sister, who relies on her for help in times of trouble, Yuki reluctantly agrees to go to the blind date in her place. Although she intends to refuse, the son, Tomoaki, is handsome but so expressionless that it's impossible to tell what he's thinking. He proposes marriage with unbelievably good conditions, but Yuki firmly and clearly refuses...or so she thought...but instead of giving up, she finds herself being tossed around by his unexpectedly sweet advances!?

As she drowns her sorrows at a bridge, she notices a young man with a weary look beside her. Imagining the worst, she instinctively lunges and grabs onto him. However, her legs give way, and she ends up falling into the river, losing her own life. When she awakes, she finds herself in the Divine World. The man she had just tried to save turns out to be a god! He offers Ria the chance to be reborn into the world of her choosing as compensation for playing a part in her untimely demise. Jumping with joy, Ria asks to be reincarnated as the protagonist of her favorite dating sim. However... things don't go as planned, and she becomes reborn as the female villain, Ashelias, instead! Worse, Ashelias is headed straight for her doom, and the protagonist's actions only seem to help ensure that it happens! Refusing to subject herself to the wretched fate written in the game's route, Ashelias decides to leave town. And thus, begins her journey with a handsome swordsman and a fluffy fairy!

Although Shinichi loves Mizuho, he cannot let go of his doubts for her. Riko tries to take advantage of his insecurities. Meanwhile, Uzaki comes back to Japan headquarters...! At this point, Minaho's patience has run thin, and she consults her male friend, Nanao, for advice. He tells her that she is too kind, and if she doesn't fight back, she'll be treated like a slave for the rest of her life. He then teaches her the secret to fighting in a marriage. Her only hope is to propose a marriage of convenience to the Beast of the Duchy, but a strange turn of events leaves the reluctant duke little choice but to accept the offer. 209644.description:
On a battlefield on the brink of annihilation, Gray Lee, a nameless foot soldier, lay with a spear piercing his chest, waiting for death. The most fearsome enemy—the [Executioner]—capable of burning the entire continent to the ground in a single day. The only ones capable of standing against him were the Sword Saint, the Divine Archer, the Grand Sage, and the Strongest Shield—the mightiest heroes of humanity. But even those heroes were falling one after another, and all hope seemed to be fading. —Or so it seemed.

“...You’re still alive after being shot through the heart?”

Death did not come for Gray. He was guided by Chronos, the “Ruler of Time.” The moment he was granted an unknown dark power, he unleashed a devastating blow against the Settler, shaking the very fabric of fate. But just as victory seemed within reach, a beam of light flashed once more, and Gray’s body vanished into mist. At that moment, Chronos’s voice boomed.

“I’m sending you back to the past. Save this world.”

The next place he awoke in was his hometown, which was supposed to have been destroyed. It was the starting point of his “loser’s life” and the stage for a do-over.

“This time, I’ll prove I can survive—”

Armed with the power to transcend time and memories of the future, Gray aims to become a warrior who surpasses even heroes. A revenge fantasy where past and future intersect now begins!

(Source: HykeComic, translated)

パ・ド・ドゥ
恋の忍術ABC!
ゆうわくっ! 保健室

209724.description:
A deep, unsettling love that transcends species! An original anthology comic where species barriers are irrelevant! You, with your huge body and overwhelming love, envelop me and never let go—you're so dangerous. In return for your overflowing love, I'll give you a kiss, so could you please bend down a little? An original anthology comic depicting a slightly frighteningly doting love by a stellar lineup of artists!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
