synonyms: Because I want to kiss you: My monster boyfriend's love is too heavy for me to handle Comic Anthology

title.native: キスしづらいからかがんでよ!~人外彼氏の溺愛が規格外で困っちゃう・~ コミックアンソロジー
title.romaji: Kiss Shizurai kara Kagande yo!: Jingai Kareshi no Dekiai ga Kikaku-gai de Komachauz: Comic Anthology

209725.description:
One day, Countess Rosalie witnesses her lover, Hayden, cheating on her. Heartbroken, Rosalie becomes timid about love. However, she is then proposed to by the dashing future Marquis, Rufus…!? A school romance story between a love-challenged young lady and a notoriously cold knight!

(Source: Flex Comics, translated)
synonyms: A Love-Distrusting Noble Lady Doesn't Notice the Cold Knight's Devotion

title.native: 恋愛不信な令嬢は冷酷騎士様の溺愛に気づかない
title.romaji: Renai Fushin na Reijou wa Reikoku Kishi-sama no Dekiai ni Kizukanai

209726.description:
"Could it be that we've been unknowingly going down different paths...?"

Saho Shintani, 32 years old. Married for three years. She had no visible complaints about her work or family life, and her husband, Shinichi, was always calm and kind. On their wedding anniversary, Saho casually brought up the topic of trying to conceive, but Shinichi responded with a distant, detached "Saho, you're the one who's going to have the baby, so you can decide..."

Saho longed to talk things through, but Shinichi wanted to avoid conflict. And as Saho struggled with the difference in their attitudes towards trying to conceive, another "unusual event" struck. Meanwhile, Shinichi's ex-girlfriend, whom he once had feelings for, reappeared... Where will the two of them go, wandering with unanswered questions?

A human drama depicting the realistic regeneration of a married couple.

(Source: CLLENN, translated)

title.native: さまよう夫婦～3年目のクライシス～

synonyms: Tier 1 Sisters: The Famous Four Sisters Can't Live Without Me

title.native: Tier1姉妹 有名四姉妹は僕なしでは生きられない
title.romaji: Tier 1 Shimai: Yuumei Yonshimai wa Boku nashi de wa Ikirarenai

title.native: チートスキルで異世界ハーレム

209729.description:
I was reincarnated as Diana, a villainess destined to be the final boss, and I was living with the Ice Duke, with whom I was already in a political marriage, and his daughter, who feared me. My fate was to one day be defeated by my daughter's heroic lover—but I refused! I'll shower my daughter with love, improve my relationship with my husband, and aim to avoid becoming the final boss!!

The story of a quirky duchess escaping her villainous status begins in grand style★

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 転生したらラスボス系悪女だった！
title.romaji: Tensei Shitara Last Boss Kei Akujo datta!

209730.description:
Demon Lord Yami, exhausted by the prolonged war, begs Hero Lux to "kill her." But the hero couldn't bring himself to kill the lonely girl. And Yami fell in love for the first time. Lux faked the Demon Lord's death and ended the war. However, their peaceful life together didn't last long, and Lux ​​died of illness.

In her despair, Yami delivered his ashes to his hometown, where she found his younger brother, Ray, who bore a striking resemblance to him. With nowhere else to go, Yami hides her true identity and takes up residence in the accessory workshop run by Ray. Eventually, she realizes that the Demon Lord's magic brings about mysterious miracles for the owners of the accessories—…

A story of rebirth unfolds in a world without a hero.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 魔王のアトリエ　奇跡のアクセサリの作り方
title.romaji: Maou no Atelier Kiseki no Accessory no Tsukurikata

209731.description:
"Apparently, a meteorite is going to hit soon, and the world is ending"... Are you serious!?

Shino Wakatsuki, 29 years old. A typical office worker in her late twenties, on the verge of marrying a colleague. Or so she thought... The morning after drinking with her boss, she woke up to find herself "imprisoned" under the guise of "protection." The reason? The world is ending soon.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 地球が終わるらしいので、いまからキミを監禁します。
title.romaji: Chikyuu ga Owarurashiinode, Ima kara Kimi wo Kankin Shimasu.

title.native: 魔王のアトリエ　奇跡のアクセサリの作り方
title.romaji: Maou no Atelier Kiseki no Accessory no Tsukurikata

209733.description:
I've been reincarnated as Duchess Diana, the final boss villain before her awakening. What's more, I'm already in a political marriage with the Ice Duke, my daughter is terrified of me, and our home is cold and distant. In the future, I'm destined to be consumed by negative emotions and awaken as the final boss, only to be defeated by my daughter's heroic lover—but I refuse! I want to live a harmonious, stress-free life, free from negative emotions! With that resolve, I decided to improve my relationship with my husband and shower my daughter with affection…!?

The story of a strangely behaved duchess escaping her final boss villainous ways begins in spectacular fashion!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 転生したらラスボス系悪女だった！
title.romaji: Tensei Shitara Last Boss Kei Akujo datta!

209734.description:
She hasn't even experienced first love yet, and now she's marrying the Emperor (her ex-boyfriend) she just met!? A miraculous reversal of fortune begins!

Saint Julietta is forced to marry Lukino, the new Emperor of the Izelta Empire, which is on the brink of defeat, after he brings up a 400-year-old vow. While working tirelessly to protect Lukino and the lives of his people after the defeat, Julietta comes to know the kindness of Lukino, who became Emperor knowing he might be executed!?

"We can still win this war."

Julietta's hidden power will create a miracle from here! A story of a great reversal between a saint and an Emperor!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 聖女と皇王の誓約結婚 1 恥ずかしいので聖女の自慢話はしないでくださいね…!
title.romaji: Seijo to Sumeragi Ou no Seiyaku Kekkon Hazukashii no de Seijo no Jiman Banashi wa Shinaide kudasai ne...!

209735.description:
Princess Lucia, heartbroken after the death of her fiancé, the crown prince of another country, returns to the Kingdom of Fortnato. There, she becomes embroiled in a power struggle for the throne among her four younger sisters, endures harassment, and is eventually driven out of the palace! However, encouraged by Felix, the duke's son, who is drawn to her nobility, Lucia displays her "royal qualities" in her new home!

She emerges as the leading candidate for queen—!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 第一王女ルシアの帰還と華麗なる快進撃　海の守護騎士との出逢い
title.romaji: Daiichi Oujo Lucia no Kikan to Kareinaru Kaishingeki Umi no Shugo Kishi to no Deai

209736.description:
Supporting her husband in mysterious incidents and battling her hateful mother-in-law at home!? A story of a demon-slaying working wife!

Due to unavoidable circumstances, Nozaki Seri loses her home and enters into a contract marriage with a passing onmyoji, Kitamikado Koga, to make ends meet. However, while Koga has cute turtle and tiger shikigami (spirit familiars), he's a dim-witted onmyoji with no magical powers whatsoever...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ぼんくら陰陽師の鬼嫁

209737.description:
Momoka is a capable worker who loves her job. But at home, she's completely devoid of glamour! Convenience store food is fine, and tracksuits are her everyday attire. In this state, she fatefully reunites with her childhood friend, who has grown into a handsome young man. He's opening a restaurant where he can make delicious, healthy, and beautiful dishes using his knowledge of medicinal cuisine. In fact, he's head over heels in love with Momoka, and he forcefully selects her to be his taste tester... Momoka's confused feelings, fatigue, and pre-illnesses are all resolved at once by the exquisite food and the effects of medicinal cuisine! A radiant smile blossoms within her.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 花咲くキッチン-再会には薬膳スープと桜を添えて-
title.romaji: Hanasaku Kitchen: Saikai ni wa Yakuzen Soup to Sakura wo Soete

209738.description:
"Will you make a contract with me?"

In a remote rural area of ​​19th-century France, Nini, a girl abandoned by her parents, was dying. At that moment, a beautiful demon appeared before her. His name was Dantalion. He was a thoughtful veterinarian specializing in magical beasts, with a sweet tooth. Nini made a contract with Dantalion and became a demon's familiar in the demon world—preparing herself for a harsh life. However, she was unexpectedly treated with great care and protection, and little by little, the frozen parts of her heart began to melt...

This is a twisted yet heartwarming master-servant story woven by the sweet demon Dantalion, the lazy houseguest demon Belphegor, the human Nini, and the magical beasts.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 魔獣医とわたし
千駄木ねこ茶房の文豪ごはん
title.romaji: Sendagi Neko Sabou no Bungou Gohan

209740.description:
Shougyoku Kan was renowned as the strongest female soldier. But, for some inexplicable reason, she, still single after turning 30, is chosen to become empress and enters the "Crimson Mist Palace," a harem swirling with female jealousy and desire—!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 紅霞後宮物語

209741.description:
Driven by a prophecy, the strongest and most beautiful girl, “Thunder Empress Nanaki,” decides to leave the empire... and in her new home, she changes careers to become a maid—her true calling (?)!! Featuring a smug grin and a peace sign—so cute!—this masterpiece of fantasy is packed with lightning-fast action and addictive comedy, depicting the daily life of Nanaki as she unleashes her ultimate power to the fullest for her master.

(Source: Earth Star Entertainment, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 雷帝のメイド

209742.description:
Shougyoku Kan. A military leader hailed as an unparalleled genius, and later a deified empress. However, there are few records of her life before entering the imperial harem. How did she live, become a soldier, and meet the emperor? Let us tell you the beginning of her legend...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 紅霞後宮物語　第零幕

209743.description:
A collection of exquisite short stories, including the stories of the supporting characters and the perfect conclusion of Kouka Koukyuu Monogatari.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 紅霞後宮物語　中幕　愛しき黄昏
title.romaji: Kouka Koukyuu Monogatari Nakamaku Itoshiki Tasogare

title.native: 僵尸X

209745.description:
Sumire was plain and unremarkable. Her extravagant and wasteful mother and sister forced her to handle everything, from earning money to managing the household, leaving her physically and mentally exhausted. One day, yakuza members showed up to collect her sister's debts... and instead of repayment, Sumire was sold to them.

For some reason, Kiriya, the underboss of the yakuza, treated the dejected Sumire kindly. Later, seeing Sumire dressed up for work, Kiriya made a firm decision:

"You don't have to work at the shop. Become my personal housekeeper."

And so begins the clumsy, doting life of two people who eventually marry and find happiness, as they discover their place in the world!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 意地悪な母と姉に売られた私。何故か若頭に溺愛されてます
title.romaji: Ijiwaru na Haha to Ane ni Urareta Watashi. Naze ka Wakagashira ni Dekiaisaretemasu

209746.description:
On her 16th birthday, Constantine becomes the devil's bride. In order to carry out the only way to divorce—"perform good deeds and break the wedding ring"—she defeats evil as the legendary saint, the "Black Sheep," but is pursued by priests as a heretic!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: シスター・ブラックシープ

209747.description:
High schooler Yohana Sakaki lives in a town full of ghosts, spirits, and other ethereal beings, where the eminent Yashiro family is tasked with keeping these beings in check. Yohana has distant ties to the family, but she lacks any abilities and has resigned herself to an ordinary life. When she falls into a pond at the Yashiro estate, she seems to catch the eye of a high-ranking member of the Yashiro hierarchy—only to be ignored in favor of another girl, who strangely had the same accident. Having apparently lost her golden opportunity, Yohana is instead aided by a mysterious young boy named Chitose, who has little status but quite a few secrets. And when she begins spending time with him and assisting in his spiritual work, she learns that her destiny may have changed more than she realized—but whether for good or ill, no one can yet say.

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: The Story of the Moon Waiting for the Evening
title.native: 宵を待つ月の物語
title.romaji: Yoi wo Matsu Tsuki no Monogatari

209748.description:
The town where high school student Yohana Sakaki lives is dominated by the Yashiro family, a family of Shinto priests who exterminate evil spirits. Having lost her parents and living with her grandmother, Yohana is summoned to a banquet held at the Yashiro family's estate at her grandmother's request, which leads her to meet a mysteriously beautiful boy, Chitose...!?

With the awakening of a new power and an encounter with a boy, the lonely girl enters a world of the supernatural.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 宵を待つ月の物語
title.romaji: Yoi wo Matsu Tsuki no Monogatari

209749.description:
Shinobu, who should have had a secure job at the ward office, is unfortunately transferred to the "Property with a History of Unfortunate Events" department, where he's constantly troubled by complaints. Even more daunting are the on-site property inspections. Yes, they're there.

Shinobu, who has the ability to see spirits, attracts them, and that's when Tendou, the real estate company president rumored to be ruthless, appears. He's also looking for properties with a history of unfortunate events and should be a business rival, but he suddenly picks up the immobile Shinobu and saves him.

Shinobu is confused by his unforgettable sweet voice, but eventually the two meet again. They become buddies solving the city's mysteries—!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 公務員で安泰のはずが、事故物件担当に異動します
title.romaji: Koumuin de Antai no Hazu ga, Jikobukken Tantou ni Idoushimasu

209750.description:
Shinobu, who should have had a secure job at the ward office, was unfortunately transferred to the "Haunted Properties Department," where he was constantly troubled by complaints. Even more daunting were the on-site property inspections. Yes, they were there. Whenever Shinobu, who has the ability to see spirits, attracts them, the notoriously ruthless real estate company president, Tendou, appears. He's also looking for haunted properties and should be a business rival, but he unexpectedly picks up the immobile Shinobu and saves himr.

Shinobu is confused by his unforgettable sweet voice, thinking, "What am I thinking?!" but eventually the two meet again. Will they become partners in solving the city's mysteries?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 公務員で安泰のはずが、事故物件担当に異動します
title.romaji: Koumuin de Antai no Hazu ga, Jikobukken Tantou ni Idoushimasu

synonyms: Yasashiku Sasete yo Ore no Omega
Let me be sweet to you my Omega

title.native: 優しくさせてよ俺のΩ
title.romaji: Yasashiku Sasete yo Ore no Ω

title.native: 愛に従順なけもの

209753.description:
Eighteen-year-old Shinya Fukazawa was depressed after failing his university entrance exams and suffering from an inferiority complex towards his accomplished older brother. One day, he is asked to help out at his beloved grandmother's donut shop in Kyoto. However, what awaited Shinya in Kyoto was not the simple donut shop he remembered, but a neon-lit, late-night donut shop perfect for social media. Furthermore, the shop manager had changed to Ren, a strikingly handsome, seemingly frivolous giant.

At first, Shinya was stubborn, but as he is spoiled by Ren and helps out at the donut shop, he gradually begins to change. A heartwarming story that fills both stomach and heart, brought to you by a late-night donut shop.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Night Musings at the Donut Shop

title.native: ドーナツ屋の夜のつれづれ

synonyms: Night Musings at the Donut Shop

title.native: ドーナツ屋の夜のつれづれ

209755.description:
"You're fired. Get out, Aya Yozumi!"

Suddenly banished, Aya, a rookie designer at a game development company, is accused by her boss of being a slow worker and a liar who steals overtime pay, and is transferred to the "outplacement room" to encourage voluntary resignation. Lost and bewildered, Aya's dream is to create works that uplift others. She and her colleague, Mayoi Manabu, hit it off and decide to create a new game project! Their project ends up competing against the project and budget of the very boss who fired her—?

That's right, her incompetent boss didn't understand. She was the god-tier artist who single-handedly sustained the company through a death march. Aya Yozumi's meteoric rise begins here!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: え、神絵師を追い出すんですか?
title.romaji: E, Kami Eshi wo Oidasun desu ka?

209756.description:
Aire, a lonely girl searching for her mother's keepsake, enters a masked auction house with an anonymous invitation in search of clues. Paintings, jewels, antiques… As various items are auctioned off, Aire, with her unique aesthetic eye, detects that forgeries have been mixed in among the merchandise. This leads to her talent being recognized by Bartraut, the young head of the Marquis family that runs the auction. She joins the auction group, "The House", as a member of the team, assisting them alongside the gentle fifth prince, Felix, and the cheerful second son of a baron, Joshua!

Initially, Aire dislikes Bartraut's condescending attitude. However, she gradually opens her heart to him as he sees through her inability to rely on others and, though clumsy, extends a helping hand. However, at the same time, she finds Bartrud's obsession with authenticity to an almost abnormal degree to be unsettling. It seems the reason for this is deeply connected to why he's hosting the auction...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 偽令嬢の訳ありオークションカタログ エメラルドは出会いを導く
title.romaji: Koumuin de Antai no Hazu ga, Jikobukken Tantou ni Idoushimasu

209757.description:
Aire, a working-class girl with a unique aesthetic sense, was making a living by delivering mail. Searching for a certain item, Aire attends an auction held at a nobleman's mansion, where she discovers that a forgery has been mixed in with the merchandise! This incident draws the attention of the young Marquis Bartrud and his family, who run the auction—!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 偽令嬢の訳ありオークションカタログ　エメラルドは出会いを導く
title.romaji: Koumuin de Antai no Hazu ga, Jikobukken Tantou ni Idoushimasu

209758.description:
Mei, the daughter of a family that exterminates malevolent supernatural beings, grew up neglected because she lacked the power to slay demons. Meanwhile, her arrogant younger brother violates a taboo, awakening Ryouga, the king of another world! Mei is left behind...

Mei finds herself in peril, but Ryouga is actually a gentle, intelligent, and handsome young man. He teaches her the value of her hidden, rare "healing power" and invites her to become his princess. In the other world ruled by Ryouga, Mei is able to use her powers and is respected, and she finds herself drawn to him, who has given her a place to belong. However, in the real world, her family has shifted the blame onto Ryouga and, unbelievably, is plotting an invasion of the other world—!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 夜叉王の最愛

209759.description:
Urabe, an exorcist known as "Mr. Stomachache" who suffers from stomachaches caused by spiritual disturbances, and his assistant, Kaname. The paranormal research center where the two awaits receives insidious and difficult cases that other places have given up on. A salaryman haunted by the ghost of his wife during divorce proceedings, a swimming instructor who became pregnant after working in the pool, a long-established inn with bizarre customs. To exorcise the deep-seated karma and desires of humanity, and the evil swirling within, Urabe and Kaname venture into the abyss.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 邪祓師の腹痛さん

synonyms: 절벽 위의 Sub를 파헤치는 법 -너의 마음을 녹이는 커맨드-

title.native: 高嶺のSubのあばき方 君の心をとかすコマンド
title.romaji: Takane no Sub no Abaki-kata: Kimi no Kokoro wo Tokasu Command

209761.description:
300 years in the future, Earth was enveloped in mana. I was a "Mana Reject," meaning mana is poisonous to me. One day, while I was awaiting my death without even awakening, I connected with another version of my soul from a different dimension— The Supreme Poison Demon Tang Gun-ak, the supreme master of the Jianghu.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Supreme Poison Demon Becomes a Pharma Chairman
The Chairman of Pharmaceutical Company is a Poison King

title.native: 제약회사 회장님은 절대독마
돌려먹는 산악회

209764.description:
Mia, a girl who "fell" into Finzel Magic School, the nation's top magic school, has lost all her memories. Absalon, the school nurse who took Mia in, suggests she infiltrate the school. If she can become a member of the top student group, the "Opera," she will gain access to the Royal Library. This should also solve the mystery of her amnesia.

Thinking, Mia is captivated by the magic of Bruno, an upperclassman in the Opera, and decides to study there. Bruno is wary of Mia's true identity, but his straightforwardness eventually convinces him to support her school life. However, her overwhelming magical power leads to a challenge to a duel by Katrina, a young lady from a noble family...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: トーアの魔法使い 魔法学校と呪いの少女
title.romaji: Toua no Mahoutsukai Mahou Gakkou to Noroi no Shoujo

209765.description:
"Maybe now that I'm Oichi, I can get my favorite ship, Mitsuhide and Nobunaga together!?"

Fujiyoshi Ichiko, a 30-something office worker and fujoshi who adores the Mitsuhide x Nobunaga pairing, collapses from overwork while playing a history game. When she wakes up, she finds herself in the game's Sengoku period, reincarnated as Nobunaga's sister, Oichi.

Ichiko is thrilled to be so close to her favorite pairing, Mitsuhide and Nobunaga, but in the near future, they will kill each other in the Honnoji Incident. So Ichiko uses her knowledge of the game and history to try and prevent the Honnoji Incident, but for some reason, handsome warlords keep vying for her affections...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 本能寺に萌ゆ　戦国一の姫君に転生した一般モブ子は、推し武将の寵愛を喜べない
title.romaji: Honnouji ni Moeyu Sengoku Ichi no Himegimi ni Tensei shita Ippan Mobuko wa, Oshi Bushou no Chouai wo Yorokobenai

209766.description:
A pragmatic woman and a god who has lived for a long time. A marriage story of misunderstandings between two people with vastly different perspectives.

Diligent and prioritizing stability above all else, Chika, who has no desire to marry, is lured by a silver-haired, blue-eyed man named Akisui at a shrine she visits before taking her local civil service exam. She finds herself abducted to the other world, "Tsukiyo." According to Akisui, Chika is a shrine maiden who cultivates the "Life Flower" that sustains the world. He asks her to marry him, the chief god, and make the flower bloom…

"If the flower is needed, I will help. But do I really need to become a bride?"

She declares that she will work as a shrine maiden as a job, on the condition that she can return to her original world!? Chika and Akisui are constantly at odds. Their differing feelings will eventually change Tsukiyo, and each of them…

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 花咲く神さまの花嫁

209767.description:
Mithril, a viscount's daughter, has her engagement broken off because she lacks feminine charm. With the financial support cut off as a result of the broken engagement, Mithril fears that her family's finances may be in jeopardy because of her, so she takes a job as a cleaning maid for the magic corps! Mithril is assigned to the Shisui, a magic corps full of filthy rooms known as the "den of evil." While the other servants show signs of revulsion, Mithril efficiently goes about her work, and Shisui quickly becomes clean. Mithril doesn't try to please anyone and devotes herself wholeheartedly to her work, but the smileless wizard Alfreed aggressively approaches her with sweet words—!?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 婚約破棄されたのでお掃除メイドになったら笑わない貴公子様に溺愛されました
title.romaji: Konyaku Haki Sareta node Osouji Maid ni Nattara Warawanai Kikoushi-sama ni Dekiai Saremashita

209768.description:
Having been deemed "magical-less" in her childhood and treated as an outcast ever since, young lady Lucia despairs at the thought that only her adopted daughter, Lisette, the daughter of a saint, receives all the love from her family, and runs away. Taken in by a magical tower inhabited by special wizards, along with her fluffy wolf beast, she is doted on by the supposedly cruel and misanthropic genius wizard, Serhi, and begins to blossom with her hidden talents. Meanwhile, her former family and those around her, who never loved her, react unexpectedly to her departure... A doting romantic comedy where the hero speaks his mind and never allows for misunderstandings begins here!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 落ちこぼれダメ令嬢は溺愛されて生まれ変わります!? 〜褒められるのが嬉しくて頑張っていたら規格外の才能が開花しました〜
title.romaji: Ochikobore Dame Reijou wa Dekiai Sarete Umare Kawarimasu!? Homerareru no ga Ureshikute Ganbatte Itara Kikaku-gai no Sainou ga Kaika Shimashita

209769.description:
Sae moved to a seaside town she had decided would be her permanent home. But that night, her house burned down completely. It was her neighbor, Katsuragi, who reached out to the distraught Sae. Sae is 30, Katsuragi is 50. Their cohabitation, despite a 20-year age difference, began. Sae had lived a rootless life, hiding her past. Katsuragi, with his beautiful looks and high abilities, constantly attracted the attention of others, and was exhausted by it all. That's why their cohabitation, maintaining a comfortable distance, was so pleasant. However, Sae receives a call from a detective in Tokyo...

A love story with an age gap begins in this town, filled with delicious food and where time flows slowly.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 海辺の町で間借り暮らし

209770.description:
Ginka, a beautiful and carefree lady-in-waiting, harbors a secret. She is a member of "Tenshoku," a spy organization directly under the Queen. Ginka, cold and calculating yet possessing exceptional interpersonal skills, is assigned a new mission: A long-term assignment to become the wife of a general in the suzerain state and go into hiding abroad.

After bidding farewell to her homeland, Ginka meets Tousei, a man of rough but gentle nature. Ginka, who harbors no romantic feelings, calmly fulfills her role as "wife," but Tousei unexpectedly becomes obsessed with her…?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 流蘇の花の物語 銀の秘めごと帳
title.romaji: Ryuuso no Hana no Monogatari Gin no Himegoto-chou

209771.description:
The story begins when a member of the royal family, ostracized by the emperor, and a beautiful young boy whose future is prophesied meet.

Royal Jie, while hunting, nearly freezes to death in the snow. A harmless bookworm, Jie has been ostracized by his older brother, the new emperor, and banished to a remote area with little food. However, the dying Jie is rescued by a beautiful boy from the Akenoboshi tribe. Jie enjoys peaceful times with his first friend, but these tranquil moments come to an end when eunuchs carrying the emperor's decree arrive.

Shortly after Jie departs for the capital, the Akenoboshi tribe accidentally obtains a letter that was meant for Jie. Learning of Jie's predicament, he rushes to find him...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 流蘇の花の物語 捨てられ皇子と冬の明星
title.romaji: Ryuuso no Hana no Monogatari Suterare Ouji to Fuyu no Myoujou

209772.description:
Xuan Xiang, the "Atonement Concubine," is imprisoned in the imperial harem due to the sins of her ancestors. One day, she finds the eunuch Hei Yao collapsed in front of her palace, a place rarely visited by anyone. After tending to him, Xuan Xiang asks for his help in obtaining the emperor's pardon and restoring her family's status. She is rejected outright, but Xuan Xiang deduces Hei Yao's "secret." Her basis? "Scent." Impressed by her extraordinary sense of smell, Hei Yao agrees to help.

The next day, Xuan Xiang suddenly becomes a candidate for Empress. This is Hei Yao's scheme, who claims that everything will be possible if she becomes Empress. However, a trial immediately arises. Xuan Xiang must identify scents in front of the four concubines, each a formidable competitor vying for the position of Empress...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 後宮の薫香妃

209773.description:
Sarah leaves the countryside to become a gardener, but her bag is snatched and she loses her letter of introduction. Wandering aimlessly, Sarah jumps at the chance to find a gardener position that, for some reason, has never been filled. The owner of the mansion is Aile, a beautiful but eccentric woman who dresses as a man.

Sarah overcomes the challenging employment test with her overflowing love for plants. As a gardener, Sarah is taken on tours of the garden by Aile. Incidents occur everywhere they go, but Aile's insight and Sarah's knowledge of plants help to unravel them. Eventually, Sarah notices the loneliness of Aile as she pursues the truth behind a certain flower and her father's death...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 女男爵の庭師

209774.description:
Plain-faced Linli transforms herself with makeup. She loves cosmetics, and her passion led her to develop her own products, which became popular in the capital. However, worried about Linli missing her chance at marriage, her father scheming to have her enter the imperial harem.

Meanwhile, the emperor wanted to dismantle the harem, a money-draining mess filled with strong-willed concubines. In this situation, the emperor takes a liking to Linli, who doesn't desire favor, and offers her a deal: "If you drive the other concubines out of the harem, I'll let you go."

Therefore, Linli decides to become a stunning beauty with makeup and play the role of the most wicked woman in the harem! A thrilling harem romance fantasy!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 後宮一番の悪女

209775.description:
Harunei, a fallen noblewoman who lost her mother, takes refuge in a baron's household. She is treated like a servant, and her mother's keepsake, an amethyst hairpin, is sold. Harunei visits Keishin, the art dealer rumored to be a demon, who bought the hairpin. The condition for getting it back is a "political marriage." He wanted to use Harunei's family background for his business.

"I, with the eyes of a demon, exist only to manage cursed items," Keishin says, closing himself off from the world. But his eyes shine like the amethyst in the hairpin, enveloping Harunei in warmth. Now it is Harunei's turn to sincerely wish to save him, a man who has never been loved by anyone...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 帝都鬼恋物語 煤かぶり令嬢の結婚
title.romaji: Teito Oni Koi Monogatari Susu Kaburi Reijou no Kekkon

209776.description:
Hu Linghua is the "evil princess" feared by everyone. Her true identity is the polar opposite of an evil woman, with a lovely face and pure personality. No one knows this... or so they thought. Until she received a secret mission from the Crown Prince, Hakuren. "Become my consort and my younger brother," Linghua ordered, and began living a double life as both the "favorite concubine" and the Crown Prince's "younger brother" --!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 悪姫の後宮華演

209777.description:
When did I first get caught up in this game that sets off a downward spiral? Strange things begin to happen to the unapproachable genius boy.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 스톤에이지

209778.description:
Won Do-Yun, a boy left alone in the most run-down neighborhood. Though he had talent, the world dragged him down. In a world controlled by a massive cartel, he realizes that the higher he climbs, the deeper he sinks. Won Do-Yun ultimately makes a choice: the abyss over the summit. And he stands at the very center of the cartel, determined to bring the massive organization crashing down.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 카르텔

209779.description:
The girl who had closed herself off from the world was greeted by a master art dealer whose face was hidden by a fox mask. "Welcome, my fiancée," said the young man, his face hidden by a fox mask, as he welcomed Ema.

Ema, having lost her grandfather, met Ritsu at a mansion in Daikanyama, which she had visited as instructed. He was not only her fiancé, but also the owner of the shop where her grandfather had supplied sweets. (Not a sweets shop, but an art gallery?) Ritsu's gallery receives inquiries about paintings that cause strange phenomena. It seems that the ability to solve these problems through confectionery making has been passed down from her grandfather to Ema...

A romantic fantasy about two people carrying emotional wounds and secrets, unraveling the memories embedded in paintings.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 代官山あやかし画廊の婚約者　ゆびさき宿りの娘と顔の見えない旦那様
title.romaji: Daikanyama Ayakashi Garou no Konyakusha: Yubisaki Yadori no Musume to Kao no Mienai Danna-sama

209780.description: Five years have passed since he left his beloved hometown for the city. With no one to depend on, Mihail wanders everywhere, ultimately unable to settle down anywhere and returns home. A remote mountain village where even a cart won't take him. Upon arriving in the village, he visits the cabin of his childhood friend, shepherd Caleb, and greets him warmly. However, all he gets in return is a warning to get out of the village immediately. Mihail tries to win Caleb's heart and settle down in his long-awaited return home, but things aren't as easy as he thought...

title.native: 즐거운 나의 집

209781.description:
Akito Jinguji, a soldier in the Imperial Army who hunts down supernatural beings, is feared by the people as a ruthless warrior. He receives an order to hunt down a demon known as the "Leader of a Thousand Demons"—Arashika. Arashika possesses unparalleled beauty and immense power, causing chaos throughout the Imperial Capital, yet she also whimsically helps people, making her somehow endearing. Akito finds himself unconsciously drawn to Arashika, and begins to agonize over whether hunting this demon is the right thing to do. While wavering, Akito tries to fulfill his duty as a soldier. But the method to defeat the demon requires Akito's own life…!?

A solitary soldier and a beautiful demon. The chase through the cherry blossom-filled Imperial Capital begins here!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 鬼はたまゆら、帝都に酔う
title.romaji: Oni wa Tamayura, Teito ni You

209782.description:
Reiko Tachibana, 27 years old, is a novel editor. What happens when she swaps bodies with her hated senior colleague?!

Reiko works as a novel editor, but her work goes awry, and her fiancé, whom she was about to marry, disappears without a trace. After venting her frustrations to Yamazaki, a colleague in the same editorial department, she gets drunk and wakes up to find their bodies have been swapped. Reluctantly, they decide to pretend to be each other to get through their work, but the sloppy and intuitive Reiko and the fastidious and efficiency-oriented Yamazaki are natural enemies. Even in their reluctant cohabitation, Yamazaki constantly keeps a watchful eye on them, warning them, "Don't do anything weird in my body." Meanwhile, the author that "Yamazaki" (with Reiko's body) is assigned to refuses to offer any opinions, and the new novel quickly hits a roadblock. Can the two overcome numerous challenges and return to their original bodies?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: あなたの代わりはできません。　ズボラ女と潔癖男の編集ノート
title.romaji: Anata no Kawari wa Dekimasen. Zubora Onna to Keppeki Otoko no Henshuu Note

209783.description:
Kaede Saimiya, a fourth-year university student, possesses the power to extract the memories of anyone she touches. However, unable to control her power, Kaede avoids interacting with people, resulting in constant failures in both part-time jobs and job hunting. One day, Kaede encounters an office worker on a train platform. Seeing the woman exhausted both physically and mentally from workplace harassment, Kaede uses her power to extract her memories. However, this is witnessed by her older childhood friend, Ao Kamishiro.

Six years later, Ao reunites with Kaede, but has no memory of her. This is because Kaede extracted his memories. But after learning about her ability and current situation, Ao proposes a job extracting people's memories…?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 忘れたい記憶、消します

209784.description:
The "Witch of the Forest of Death," rumored to be greedy and cruel, is actually Licorice, a young witch who succeeded her grandmother. One day, the King's brother comes to her in the forest seeking poison. She refuses, but the King's brother takes a liking to Licorice...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Witch of the Forest of the Death Does Not Know Love

title.native: 死の森の魔女は愛を知らない
title.romaji: Shi no Mori no Majo wa Ai wo Shiranai

title.native: 青鬼の正体

209786.description:
Misha, a boy struggling in poverty, is mistaken for a girl and bought by a handsome count. He thought he could finally escape poverty, but that joy was short-lived. The count actually makes a living by casting curses, and Misha was bought as a sacrifice! Misha is willing to die if it means saving his family. He offers his life, but the count, who has already sacrificed nine girls, sees Misha, his only boy, as a potential "undying sacrifice"...

"Become special to me."

"I want to be special to you, Count."

Two lonely souls eventually share even their destinies. An unconventional Cinderella story begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 十番目のユナス
title.romaji: Juubanme no Unus Noroi no Hakushaku to Shinanai Ikenie

209787.description:
Cudo was assigned to take care of Vert, a lazy incubus dropout. As the Demon King ordered him to make Vert remember the joys of sex, Cudo tried to get Vert motivated, but then...

(Source: DLsite)

Note: Released at J .GARDEN 53.
synonyms: 站不起來的淫魔的真面目是

title.english: The True Nature of the Impotent Incubus
title.native: 勃たない淫魔の正体は
贄の聖女と救済の契り　不良魔法士と綴る二度目の恋
title.romaji: Nie no Seijo to Kyuusai no Chigiri Furyou Mahouhi to Tsuzuru Nidome no Koi

209789.description:
One cold winter night, after losing yet another job, young Tama finds herself back on the streets of the Imperial capital. But this time, fate intervenes when she meets Ginichi, a man with striking hair and the proprietor of Job Broker Ginko. He offers a place as his live-in shop assistant. Due to circumstances in her past caused by her strange ability, she's unable to express her feelings well. But, as she spends her days with the "spirited" neighbors at Ginko, she begins to change, little by little.

(Source: Manga UP!, edited)
synonyms: Girl Meets Dragon: The Sacrificial Maiden's Happily Ever After

title.native: 龍に恋う　贄の乙女の幸福な身の上
title.romaji: Ryuu ni Kou Nie no Otome no Koufukuna Minoue

209790.description:
"This girl will one day harm the king."

Song Lingxue, having received this prophecy, was supposed to end her life in a quiet temple. However, her fate was turned upside down. She was forcibly taken to the capital by the king—and made queen. But Lingxue, bewildered and weeping uncontrollably, was banished to the detached palace. Time passed, and when she turned nineteen, rumors spread that the cause of the king's heir's death was a curse. To dispel the rumors and uncover the truth behind the series of deaths, Linxue is brought back to the harem. Thrown into a world swirling with intrigue, the beautiful and intelligent Linxue, who had been in the detached palace, finds herself in...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 雪花妃伝 ～藍帝後宮始末記～

209791.description:
It is time for Punishment [aka Reward]...

Roswell is a hired servant who has been tasked with handling his new master's unruly pervert of a son. He gets to the task at hand right away, and begins to administer his own special kind of disciplinary education...

(Source: DLsite)

title.english: Young Master, It's Time For Punishment.
title.native: 坊ちゃま、お仕置きの時間です。

209792.description:
Born into a lower-ranking noble family, Princess Kyouka is suddenly thrust into the imperial court to make up the numbers. In a court filled with candidates for empress from high-ranking noble families, she finds herself caught in the middle of a power struggle among the women vying for the young emperor's affection…

Princess Kyouka, who aspires to be a pharmacist despite being a woman, aims for a peaceful divorce from the emperor. She uses her medical knowledge to the fullest, incorporating it into her incense and clothing, employing every trick in the book to keep him at bay. However, this escalates into a power struggle among the noble families that engulfs the court—?

She fends off the falling sparks with medicine! A Heian-era court fantasy begins, featuring a princess aspiring to be a pharmacist who doesn't aim to become empress!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 暁花薬殿物語

209793.description:
Miyuki, a university student struggling with her career path, is introduced to a job by her professor. It's a position as a member of the "Community Safety Support Office," a national civil service organization specializing in slightly mysterious supernatural cases. Miyuki is suspicious, but then supernatural incidents start happening around her...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: くらし安心支援室は人材募集中 オーダーメイドのおまじない
title.romaji: Kurashi Anshin Shienshitsu wa Jinzai Boshuuchuu Oudaa Made no Omajinai

209794.description:
"Who would ever worry about you?!"

Rimmel used to be a noble, but after her family lost everything, she now lives as a commoner and works at a bar. Her childhood friend Hewitt, the heir to the Count Stan family, often visits, but only to make sarcastic comments. Ever since Hewitt declared he wanted to become a knight at age twelve, they've grown apart. Rimmel thinks Hewitt is coming to the bar just to see Heather, the baron's daughter who helps run the bar and is popular with the customers. One day, Rimmel spots the swindler who ruined her family's life. She asks Hewitt for help, but the man escapes. Later, the knights ask Rimmel to help with their investigation, by pretending to be Hewitt's lover to lure the criminal out. Now, caught up in something much bigger than she expected, Rimmel must face the past she tried to leave behind.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I'm a fallen heiress, but now I'm the hot and cold knight's fake girlfriend!
title.native: 没落令嬢ですが、この度ツンデレ騎士様の恋人役になりました
title.romaji: Botsuraku Reijou desu ga, Kono Tabi Tsundere Kishi-sama no Koibito Yaku ni narimashita

title.native: 셋이 하는 놀이

synonyms: My Brother-in-Law Acting as My Husband

title.native: 시동생의 남편 대행

209797.description:
Having been repeatedly rejected by Choi Jae-Heon, the older guardian who raised him, Ki Hae-Ohn is pushed to his breaking point when he accidentally spots him on a blind date. Consumed by a wave of jealousy, he notices a mysterious application called “Push to Start” suddenly installed on his phone. Although Hae-Ohn finds it impossible to believe, driven by a desperate curiosity, he decides to test the app, attempting to strip Choi Jae-Heon bare right in front of everyone during a company-wide meeting. Jae-Heon is used to Hae-Ohn pushing his buttons, but this is taking it a little too literal!

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Climax Training App - Humiliation Play Edition

title.native: 절정 조교 어플 - 수치플 편
삼귀는 사이
먼데이 블루스
女の子のとびら

209802.description:
Haruto, a university student, has one regret: his grandfather died before he could apologize. Since then, he has become averse to old objects like those his grandfather loved, and to deep connections with people.

However, immediately after accidentally breaking an old Imari vase, he begins to see tsukumogami in the form of animals. Pressed by Imari, the tsukumogami of the broken vase, Haruto decides to grant the wishes of the tsukumogami and collect "divine hearts" in order to regain Imari's power. He wants to meet the original owner, to be useful to someone just once, to hear the true feelings of the deceased owner's daughter. As he struggles, wishes begin to weave connections around Haruto...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 下町九十九心縁帖

209803.description:
Investigator Mikio loses a colleague in a case. In his heartbroken state, he encounters Timothy, a death row inmate and serial killer. To Mikio's surprise, he finds himself partnered with Timothy as part of the FBI's special investigation unit, EAT…?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: EAT 悪魔捜査顧問ティモシー・デイモン
title.romaji: EAT Akuma Sousa Komon Timothy Damon

synonyms: คุณหนูขอรับ กระผมยอมแล้ว

title.native: 아씨는 왜 덕쇠를 괴롭힐까

209805.description:
Oliver, a kind-hearted nerd attending high school in New York, is involved in a mysterious incident one day, leaving his mother seriously injured. Miraculously, he recovers, but something feels wrong with his body. Later, at a church he visits, Oliver is told he has become a vampire.

Confused but desperate to find a way to save his mother, Oliver is entrusted to a suspicious private detective named Yan. However, Yan is a vampire-specializing case-solver who doesn't shy away from violence and discipline! As a half-baked vampire, Oliver is untrained and sometimes finds his life in danger, but he finds himself working with Yan to investigate cases involving monsters…?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: BAT 吸血鬼探偵オリバー・サンシャイン
後宮の黒猫金庫番

209807.description:
A poignant love story unfolds as a human and a dragon meet and are drawn to each other.

Akane, a girl raised in a rural town, finds a mysterious stone by the river. A small dragon is born from it, which she names "Sora," and the two become family. However, a certain incident causes the dragon's powers to run wild, and a distraught Sora runs away. Akane chases after him to a place filled with memories, only to find the dragon gone, replaced by a young boy—Sora standing there.

Akane lives a simple but happy life with Sora until one day she encounters a dragon in the form of a black cat. The black cat's words, inviting her on a journey to find her homeland, make Akane realize something important. What is the secret resolve she harbors in her heart, as she thinks of Sora?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: サマー・ドラゴン・ラプソディー

209808.description:
Two magicians embark on a journey in a magical academy filled with fantasy. A story woven with love and redemption.

At the magical academy of Dracrow, filled with fantasy, Shalom, a genius girl who grew up loved and nurtured under a great master, suddenly loses her magical powers and is now a dropout at the academy. One morning, when Shalom is troubled by a fairy's prank, she is rescued by a boy. This foul-mouthed boy is Yuel, the most outstanding student at the academy, and for some reason, Shalom is chosen as his partner for the exam.

Hesitantly, they cooperate, and gradually their hearts grow closer. But Shalom learns a sad truth: she is cursed and can never return to being the "Rain Magician" she once was.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated) A story woven with love and redemption, as two magicians walk their paths, even as they drift apart.

title.native: 雨の魔術師　少女の恋と解けない呪い
title.romaji: Ame no Majutsushi Shoujo no Koi to Hodokenai Noroi

209809.description:
I'm from another world, so I'm not your target! But he won't listen to that. Princes, demon lords, heroes—you're loved to the point of drowning in the love of many "him"s. Their love is almost frightening. ASUKA's ultimate doting original anthology comic.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Why is he doting on me when I'm not even his intended route? Comic Anthology

title.native: ヤンデレ溺愛確定ルート！？ ～攻略対象は私じゃありません…！！～ コミックアンソロジー
title.romaji: Yandere Dekiai Kakutei Route!? Kouryaku Taishou wa Watashi ja Arimasen...!! Comic Anthology

209810.description:
Tsugumi is a 24-year-old porn comic artist... and yet, she's never had sex with a man, and is running out of ideas for her work. She's had absolutely no inspiration, even after watching porn. She complains to art student Sena, her younger assistant. He then proceeds to put her finger in his mouth, take off his clothes, and thoroughly teach her on where and how to touch herself...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 18禁のつくりかた

209811.description:
Bullying, intrigue, curses, hot pot parties, and a budding romance!? A headstrong, powerful struggle of a palace maid

Lin Xing was enjoying a pleasant life in the palace as the Empress's maid. During a banquet celebrating the Spring Festival, she stepped into a newly built tower and was instantly cursed, falling into a hundred-year sleep—awakening in the arms of a handsome man who looked exactly like her fiancé! She changes her name to Hongyu and begins serving as a palace maid again under the aunt of this man, Cai Chujun, a concubine of the harem. With the help of her fellow maids and low-ranking eunuchs, and even involving Chujun and the Emperor, she uses her past knowledge and innate survival skills to fight against a century-old conspiracy!

(Source: Futami Shobou, translated)

title.native: 目が覚めると百年後の後宮でした～後宮侍女紅玉～
title.romaji: Megasameru to Hyakunen-go no Koukyuu deshita: Koukyuu Jijo Kougyoku

209812.description:
I became my teacher's pet. Literally. Tonight too, I was given a choker to wear by my owner. Akane is deeply inspired by Todo, a fashion designer, and it so happens that she, his biggest fan, would work under him. Though Akane works for Todo, an aloof perfectionist, she's never had a conversation with him, let alone does he know she exists. Happy enough just to work near him, one day Akane happens upon a crying Todo on the roof of their company. What's more, Akane comes across a choker that was dropped and left behind on the roof where Todo was standing. After thinking it over to no end, Akane decides to return the choker, entering Todo's room to place it somewhere safely. Too late! "From today on, you'll be my pet", are the words Todo speaks over his new plaything as he points to a certain "area" of her body...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: My Flamboyant Boss Made me His Kinky Bedroom Pet
title.native: オネエ上司のくちゅくちゅペット契約
title.romaji: Onee Joushi no Kuchukuchu Pet Keiyaku

209813.description:
Tenkai Kaya is a hairdresser. She makes a living by styling and arranging her clients' hair, and tailoring their clothing as well. Though an orphan, she has relied on her skills to survive. However, she receives a marriage proposal bordering on blackmail, nearly losing her job. Just when all hope seems lost, a helping hand is extended to Umekage Sai, a man with whom her late mother had a marriage contract. He tells her that if she joins the Umenomiya family, where he serves, she can protect both her work and her personal life.

Desperate to break free from her current situation and understand her mother's intentions, Kaya resolves to marry Sai. And in the house she marries, she is told by the master, Miyuki, who claims to be a living god, to become his personal hairdresser…!?

(Source: Kadoakwa, translated)

title.native: 髪結い乙女の嫁入り　迎えに来た旦那様と、神様にお仕えします。
title.romaji: Kamiyui Otome no Yomeiri Mukae ni Kita Danna-sama to, Kamisama ni Otsukae shimasu.

209814.description:
Makoto Tanaka, an ordinary guy who passed the entrance exam for the regular course at a prestigious high school, bumps into the petite Kumi Okijo on the first day of school and apologizes in a panic...but she has animal ears on her head!? It turns out Kumi is a nine-tailed fox who came to learn about the "normal" way of life in the human world! The two become friends after she convinces him that it was a mistake as the ears vanish in an instant. For some reason, Makoto continues to attract "unusual" students! And then there's the existence of the advanced course, which doesn't think highly of the regular course—will Makoto be able to graduate "normally"!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: These Days Even AYAKASHI Goes to School

title.native: 普通ですが何か？　最近はあやかしだって高校に行くんです。
title.romaji: Futsuu desu ga Nani ka? Saikin wa Ayakashi Datte Koukou ni Ikun desu.

title.native: 种果无果

209816.description:
Crybaby Mermaid: Illustrated Memoir of Yumi Uotani is about the quiet difficulty of continuing when doubt never fully disappears. It follows Yumi Uotani, a professional mahjong player, through the uncertain early years of a public career, where each setback lingers, each success feels temporary, and the question of whether she truly belongs never quite goes away.

Rather than a story of sudden breakthrough, the story focuses on the emotional weight of performance: the pressure of expectations, the anxiety that follows setbacks, and the quiet effort required to continue despite uncertainty. Uotani's progress unfolds through everyday moments of practice, reflection, and gradual change, presenting achievement as something built over time rather than defined by sudden success.

Rendered in a restrained visual style that lingers on expression and silence, this is a portrait of a working life built in increments, and of the fragile, ongoing work of learning to stand in a role that still feels uncertain. Together, Suda and Junta create a character-driven account of how confidence develops slowly, and how a professional identity emerges through endurance, self-awareness, and time.

(Source: Mahjong Pros Publishing)

title.english: Crybaby Mermaid - Illustrated Memoir of Yuumi Uotani
title.native: 泣き虫マーメイド　魚谷侑未物語

209817.description:
One day, high school student Hayato is suddenly transported to another world. In this world, he is given a gift: a versatile skill known as the "Hero's Blessing," a skill only possessed by heroes. However, this skill comes with a certain "restriction"...

That means he can no longer masturbate! With no other way to satisfy his sexual desires than to have sex with girls, Hayato encounters various girls from another world. Will Hayato be able to satisfy his sexual urges?!

An alternate world x harem fantasy begins!!

(Source: MUGENUP, translated)

title.native: その異世界ハーレムは制約つき。～自慰行為を禁止された童貞勇者のスローライフ～
title.romaji: Sono Isekai Harem wa Seiyaku Tsuki. Jii Koui wo Kinshi Sareta Doutei Yuusha no Slow Life

209818.description:
"Princess" Renagia is a slave girl acting as the body double of Regnos, a prince masquerading as a princess for his safety in the Italos Kingdom. So when enemy soldiers from the Taringia Empire attack the royal palace, Renagia gets taken hostage immediately and is forced to sleep with Taringia's emperor, Godfrey. Knowing Regnos will come save her one day, Renagia decides to seduce the ruthless Godfrey and use him in order to survive. But that's easier said than done when their past connection resurfaces, blurring the line between revenge and attraction...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.
synonyms: Toutes les nuits de la princesse esclave
ทุกค่ำคืนของเจ้าหญิงทาส

title.native: 노예 공주는 밤마다
PAX 国民幸福管理局

209820.description:
Kaho, having entered her dream high school, is filled with anticipation for a fun-filled high school life. But she has a unique condition—she cannot distinguish people's faces or expressions—prosopagnosia (face blindness). A new class, club activities, friendships, and romance. She can't recognize the faces or expressions of her classmates, but Kaho faces forward with all her might to enjoy her sparkling youth! "People are more than just their faces, after all."

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: 香穂ちゃんは顔がわからない

209821.description:
We ended up at a concept bar on a whim for the afterparty, and it turned out to be full of seriously tall women.

It’s a manga where the customers have a casual conversation with the big ladies they meet at the bar. The conversations mostly revolve around appearances and the relationship dynamics between people.

Note: Originally released at COMITIA 146, 148, 150, 151 and 153.

title.native: ビジュアルブレイカーズ
スチームドリーム

209823.description:
An ambivalent love story between a sarcastic career officer and a rough non-career officer, two detectives who are at odds with each other. Subaru, a self-made detective in the Organized Crime Division, and Iwaya, a career officer in the National Police Agency, are at odds with each other, even their superiors can't handle them—or so it seems, but in reality, they are lovers living together. To deceive those around them, they cause arguments every time they see each other. "I'll protect Hii-kun's career advancement and our sweet life together!!" Burning with determination to keep their secret, Subaru volunteers to join a special investigation team to reduce contact as much as possible! However, contrary to Subaru's expectations, Iwaya is also assigned to the same team...!?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: ひーくんと昴さんは犬猿の仲
title.romaji: Hii-kun to Subaru-san wa Kenen no Naka

209824.description:
Legends foretell that there is a god known as Mr. Fukushuu enshrined in a small altar in the outskirts of the town. He will grant your wishes in exchange for a friendship with you. However, according to ominous rumors, whoever befriends him will eventually die.

Tadashi Satou suffers from violent bullying at high school everyday. The bullying reaches a critical point when his bullies raped and murdered his one and only living family, his older sister Haruka. In his despair, Tadashi prays to Mr. Fukushuu at his shrine, offering him a friendship and even his life in exchange for revenge. Suddenly, a strange man who identifies as Mr. Fukushuu appears before him, promising to aid with his desire for revenge. Who is this man, and what kind of revenge does he have up his sleeves?

title.native: ふくしゅうさん

209825.description:
Shin, who works as a "Ruins YouTuber" exploring abandoned buildings, is struggling to gain popularity. One day, he visits the "Meido Building," a place famous for being impossible to record. But what he finds there is a cute maid!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 冥土ビル

209826.description:
After betrayal ruins his family, Inmun Kim plans his revenge... and revenge is a dish best served cold, with no mercy.

(Source: Toomics)

title.native: 덫

209828.description:
Mei lost her mother, dumped by her boyfriend...and stabbed by a mysterious sword that fell from the sky. She thought she died, but when she opened her eyes, she was in another world. A world she had seen in the textbooks she was using to teach her students at cram school...ancient China. Everyone calls her "The War God Mei" and looks like she has to save the country by fighting the war! Mei decides to act like the War God, but the beautiful general who came to pick her up looks suspicious...

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: A Blossom in the Snow Stands as a War God

title.native: 雪中の花は、軍神を偽る
title.romaji: Sechuu no Hana wa, Gunshin wo Itsuwaru

title.native: 喜花坊の寵姫　恋と縁は宴より始めよ
title.romaji: Kihanabou no Chouki Koi to En wa Utage Yori Hajimeyo

209830.description: Renka (Lianhua), a merchant's daughter, possesses memories of her previous life. Born and raised in Osaka, she has now reincarnated into a world that closely resembles ancient China. Forced by her father. she enters into the imperial harem to undergo bridal training along with many other concubine candidates. However, troubles assail her one after another, as there are instances where she reverts to her Osaka dialect and is looked down on by upstart concubines overall. Driven by her strong merchant's spirit, she vows in her heart to survive in the imperial harem through commerce rather than her status as a concubine. One day, a single man visits her chambers. Naturally, the only man capable of entering is the emperor himself. He hands her a single order, which is to cooperate with him in stopping the empress dowager from obtaining political power.

title.native: 大阪マダム、後宮妃になる！

209831.description:
Aisha, a doctor working on the battlefield, is shot and falls—and when she wakes up, she finds herself as Princess Padma, 400 years in the past! Padma, the first female doctor, was executed during the turmoil of war. The turning point in her downfall was the sudden death of Crown Prince Edward from illness. Aisha is determined to prevent his death, but for some reason, Edward is wary of "Padma"...?

"I need you just the way you are now."

A love story that transcends time and defies fate!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 王太子妃パドマの転生医療　「戦場の天使」は救国の夢を見る
title.romaji: Outaishihi Padma no Tensei Iryou "Senjou no Tenshi" wa Kyuukoku no Yume wo Miru

209832.description:
Lane, who lives in a small village far from the capital, hears that her fiancé, who left five years ago, is marrying a saint. She had already given up hope, so she doesn't feel anything. For some reason, he seems to want to invite his childhood friends to the wedding. Unable to refuse the invitation from the royal castle, Lane finds herself attending the wedding of her fiancé and the saint. In the capital, where she travels with a heavy heart, she meets someone, and her fate changes dramatically.

A happy-ending romance in which Lane, who was living in misfortune, finds true love.

(Source: Tsugikuru, translated)

title.native: 婚約者が明日、結婚するそうです。
title.romaji: Konyakusha ga Asu, Kekkon suru Sou desu.

title.native: ワンモアタイムラバー！
100万分の1ルクス
すりむけハートの行末

209836.hashtag: #アポカリプスの星を抱いて

title.native: アポカリプスの星を抱いて

209837.description:
Ruri Orio, known as the Aloof Prince on campus, is the center of attention no matter where he goes thanks to his beauty. He also has a secret. He's a hardcore BL fan! He's serious about his hobby and doesn't want to be laughed at about it. But his precious, secret hobby gets found out by the playboy on campus, Takumi. Takumi sweetly melts Ruri's twisted psyche, body and soul. But Takumi has ulterior motives...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: When a BL Fan Falls in Love
title.native: 腐男子も歩けば恋に沼る
title.romaji: Fudanshi mo Arukeba Koi ni Numaru

209838.description:
“I want to reach the top—in basketball.”

Sou Kamino, who led his high school team to the national championship, heads to a U.S. university to become an NBA player. He continues to excel after enrolling, but... Two years later—a Japanese man is playing in a gambling basketball game in New York. It’s Kamino, now fallen from grace. Having dropped out of college for a certain reason, Kamino has hit rock bottom, scraping by day to day through gambling basketball. There’s no trace left of the shining star he once was. One day, after a gambling basketball game, a Socio (mafia member) approaches him with a proposal: “Why don’t you make some money with your basketball skills?” He is handed an invitation that reads [Ranker Game ~BASKETBALL SHOW~], indicating a 3x3 match where something is at stake. Kamino was taken to the venue and given a mission: “Lose by fixing the game.”

The match began, and he successfully made mistakes to put his team in a tight spot, but suddenly a man burst onto the court and whispered in Kamino’s ear.

“You’re being set up. The loser of this match will be killed to silence them. You’ll be killed whether you lose or win. If you make a deal with me, I’ll save you.”

What decision will Kamino make... and where will his journey lead him?

(Source: Amuse, translated)

title.native: ランカーゲーム～BASKETBALL SHOW～

synonyms: Saying you love me now isn't even funny.

title.native: 今さら好きとか笑えへん

209840.description:
An adaptation of the SILENT HILL f video game with a new ending written by the original scenario writer, Ryukishi07. It will be published on Kadokawa's web manga site, Young Ace UP.

(Source: Official Silent Hill Twitter account, translated)

title.native: サイレントヒルf

209841.description:
Lyra, a consort later spoken of in legend, was originally a princess of the Wa Kingdom. Captured through a conspiracy, she was forced into the harem of the Daryl Empire. However, in this harem, there was a path to release if she refrained from bearing children for several years! She found hope and resolved to avoid getting close to the Sultan, aiming for her term of service to end.

But she was immediately tested by the Empress and provoked by arrogant consort candidates. Lyra overcame numerous predicaments, demonstrating the intelligence and innate cheerfulness cultivated by her parents. Gradually, she became beloved by those around her, even showing glimpses of her potential as a wise ruler… But as a result—why did she end up rising to the top and being treated as a favorite concubine?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: アラベスク後宮の和国姫

209842.description:
Raid, a dragon tamer with exceptional skills, had single-handedly managed the dragons, the empire's main fighting force. However, one day, the emperor fires him.
It is then that Luna, the dragon princess whom Raid had previously saved, appears before him. Following her suggestion, Raid sets off for the dragon kingdom, a hidden land…

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

title.native: 神竜帝国のドラゴンテイマー

209843.description:
Kaede, a young man struggling to find a job after graduation, nearly drowns in a river while trying to save an elementary school student. While unconscious, he dreams of meeting a man named who calls himself the "Grim Reaper." When he regains consciousness, the man's business card is left in his possession…!?

(Soruce: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: ご旅行はあの世まで? 死神は上野にいる
title.romaji: Go Ryokou wa Anoyo Made? Shinigami wa Ueno ni Iru

209844.description:
Emilia, a failed saint lacking the power of healing, is banished from the capital after a true saint appears, and forced to live in the frontier! Despite constantly bickering with Logan, a handsome but foul-mouthed knight who inexplicably followed her, she uses her past life as a pharmacist to open a pharmacy... and the medicines she creates possess healing powers! Furthermore, miasma begins to erupt in the capital where the "true" saint resides...?

Will the medicines I create hold the key to saving the country—!? A miraculous reversal fantasy of a discarded saint!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 追放された聖女ですが、どうやら私が本物です 前世薬師は“癒し”の薬で救いたい!
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Seijo desu ga, Douyara Watashi ga Honmono desu Zense Kusushi wa "Iyashi" no Kusuri de Sukuitai!

209845.description:
Takayuki Shinohara (32), a librarian, gets caught in an earthquake, and finds himself in another world Apparently, he's now the son of a high-ranking noble, and he awakens just at the moment his own engagement being called off...!? With his mind-reading skill, he aims to leave his mark! A reincarnated-noble fantasy full of intrigue and adventure!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 読心貴族～男女比1：99世界の悪役令息～
title.romaji: Dokushin Kizoku: Danjohi 1:99 Sekai no Akuyaku Reisoku

synonyms: The Misfortune Follows the Unlucky Lady

title.native: 災厄令嬢の不条理な事情　婚約者に私以外のお相手がいると聞いてしまったのですが！
title.romaji: Saiyaku Reijou no Fujouri na Jijou Konyakusha ni Watashi Igai no Oaite ga Iru to Kiite shimatta no desu ga!

209847.description:
Yuuna, a college student who was reincarnated into another world, is hailed as a saint and forced to embark on a perilous journey!? Furthermore, the veil she was given to conceal her face leads to a misunderstanding, and Yuuna is branded as an ugly saint.

She seems to trust only Brigadier General Lang, who is accompanying her on her journey... Yuuna's tumultuous journey begins here!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: ヴェールの聖女 ～醜いと誤解された聖女、イケメン護衛騎士に溺愛される～
title.romaji: Veil no Seijo: Minikui to Gokai sareta Seijo, Ikemen Goei kishi ni Dekiai sareru

title.native: 捨てられ才女は家族とのんびり生きることにします
title.romaji: Suterare Saijo wa Kazoku to Nonbiri Ikiru Koto ni Shimasu

title.native: 姉の身代わりで嫁いだ残りカス令嬢ですが、幸せすぎる腐敗生活を送ります
title.romaji: Ane no Migawari de Totsuida Nokorikasu Reijou desu ga, Shiawase Sugiru Fuhai Seikatsu wo Okurimasu

209850.description:
They call Harriet Listerwell the Scandal Maker, but the reputation was carefully crafted by her cousin Bella. At an imperial banquet, another of Bella’s schemes unfolds—framing Harriet in a way which insults the handsome and formidable Duke Cedric Kailas. Disgraced, Harriet is sent to a convent. In exile, she discovers a troubling truth: Bella’s family may have been behind the death of her parents. Now Harriet is returning to the glittering society that condemned her. The Scandal Maker is back—and this time, she intends to live up to the name.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.native: 스캔들 메이커가 돌아왔다
虚無ねーちゃんは構ってほしい

209852.description:
Shun, a university student, gets a part-time job at a magazine editorial department through a senior's introduction. The description was vague, something like "investigating rumors and stuff like that," but when he visits out of curiosity, he finds himself at the editorial department of "Twilight," an occult magazine that introduces cryptids and urban legends! He starts working there on impulse, but perhaps because Shun has some kind of psychic ability, he keeps getting involved in strange situations?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 怪奇編集部『トワイライト』

209853.description:
Tsugumi, the granddaughter of Masayoshi Azuma, a highly skilled but greedy lawyer, is a high school girl with a special ability: when people lie, she sees their faces become distorted. The cases that come to Masayoshi are all difficult. "A stepmother forced to renounce her inheritance," "An investment consultant accused of being a con artist," "A high school girl who wants to change her ridiculous name," "The son of a criminal pressured by his neighbors to move"—she and her childhood friend Soji take on the truth hidden behind the "lies" of their clients and plaintiffs!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 法律は嘘とお金の味方です。　京都御所南、吾妻法律事務所の法廷日誌
title.romaji: Houritsu wa Uso to Okane no Mikata desu. Kyoto Gosho Minami, Azuma Houritsu Jimusho no Houtei Nisshi

209854.description:
A small bath additive research lab was located within a cosmetics development laboratory in Sakura City, I Prefecture. The only full-time researcher was Mizuki, who had been with the company for three years. Adding Yuimi, the receptionist, and Kakuma, the heir to a wealthy family who for some reason has an obsession with bath additives, a surprisingly compatible team was formed…?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 風呂ソムリエ 天天コーポレーション入浴剤開発室
title.romaji: Furo Sommelier Tenten Corporation Nyuuyokuzai Kaihatsushitsu

209856.description:
Sanako Moriwaka, 27 years old, single. She's been dedicated to accounting since joining the company. Diligent work and a fair salary. She seemed to be living a perfect life, neither too much nor too little. Recently, however, a colleague who showed no signs of having a boyfriend has found one, leaving her a little confused. One day, Taiyo Yamada, the ace of the sales department, brings in a receipt for "4800 yen, takoyaki." Does accounting offer a glimpse into the inner workings of the company?

(Source: Sheuisha, translated)

title.native: これは経費で落ちません！ ～経理部の森若さん～
title.romaji: Kore wa Keihi de Ochimasen!: Keiribu no Morikawa-san

synonyms: 음란하게 나를 꽃피우는 건 그와 닮은 후배였습니다

title.native: 淫らに私を咲かすのは彼にそっくりな後輩でした
title.romaji: Midara ni Watashi wo Sakatsu no wa Kare ni Sokkurina Kouhai deshita

209858.description:
"I'll teach you what a man is, so be my woman."

Becoming a yakuza's woman... And raising a child together!? Starting an exciting life of child-rearing to protect my family!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: A (Fake) Wedding With a Loving Yakuza
title.native: 溺愛ヤクザと授かり婚（仮）はじめます
極悪女帝の後宮

synonyms: 불행한 명기 양과 절륜 엘리트 군 - 탐욕스러운 섹스가 너무 달콤해
幸薄ＯＬちゃんと絶愛エリートくん むさぼりエッチが甘すぎる

title.native: 幸薄名器ちゃんと絶倫エリートくん むさぼりエッチが甘すぎる
title.romaji: Kohaku Meiki-chan to Zetsurin Elite-kun Musabori H ga Amasugiru

209861.description:
The story centers on Ruri Takizawa, the daughter of a long-established clan of diviners. After her parents die in an accident, the family gets overtaken and Ruri spends her days working as a servant. With a great desire to escape her miserable life, Ruri is willing to be used even as a tool for a political marriage. However, her matchmaking sessions continue to fail, with her father's spirit always staying by her side. Until she meets Izumi Toshida, who claims to be a sorcerer, but cannot see spirits. Izumi seems suspicious, but he could be a good opportunity for Ruri to leave her situation.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 帝都の隠し巫女

209862.description:
A burst water pipe, skyrocketing rent, and a cheating boyfriend. Not a single thing is going right. On a whim, Yi-Seon brings a drunk man sleeping on the street back to her place to let him sleep over. It turns out he’s a junior in his department at university, comes from a wealthy family, and has a secret crush on him…?!

“We’ve been living together, and now you’re suddenly regretting that you never got to sleep with me?”

“Yeah.”

A mysterious man bursts into the daily life of college student “Na Yi-seon,” whose life motto is “Safety First”!! A crazy romance between a psycho beauty and a junk car collector!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.native: 화기엄금

209863.description:
High schooler Miko, who thought he'd be inheriting his grandfather's mountain, has lost his crush to his friend and is at the bottom of his school's hierarchy. His one solace was the mountain, but now a mysterious masked man is building a small cabin there....

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 山劇

209864.description:
Dilluk received a useless skill known as "Ancient Summoning," but he managed to work his way up to be the king's advisor anyway. But then he was demoted to be the lord of a village in ruin in the middle of nowhere, all because of a co-worker's scheme. When he witnesses the sorry state of his new territory, "Ancient Summoning" awakens! He summoned a hero from 4000 years ago! The heroes have unbelievable powers and he will work with them to create the greatest territory!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)
synonyms: The Banished Noble Uses the Trash Skill "Ancient Summoning" to Summon Heroes and Bring Life to the Borderlands: When I Summoned the Heroes, They Adored Me, So They Made My Territory the Strongest
Tsuihou Kizoku wa, Hazure Skill [Kodai Shoukan] de Eirei-tachi to Henkyou Ryouchi wo Saikou Suru: Eirei-tachi wo Shoukan Shitara Shitawareta node, Saikyou Ryouchi wo Tsukuriagemasu

title.native: 追放貴族は、外れスキル【古代召喚】で英霊たちと辺境領地を再興する～英霊たちを召喚したら慕われたので、最強領地を作り上げます～
title.romaji: Tsuihou Kizoku wa, Hazure Skill [Kodai Shoukan] de Eireitachi to Henkyou Ryouchi wo Saikou Suru: Eireitachi wo Shoukan Shitara Shitawareta node, Saikyou Ryouchi wo Tsukuriagemasu

209865.description:
The girl I fell in love with is small, cool, kind, and of a different species— carnivorous, herbivorous, mammalian, bird, reptile… Depending on the species, the average height can be 150cm or 2m. Though their species and body shapes may differ, this world inhabited by various beastmen is free from any particularly noticeable conflicts. Just an ordinary life exists here.

In this world lives Kiji, a tiger high school girl, who has fallen in love with Inasa, a cat with a personality completely opposite to hers and of a different species. The closer they become, the more she wants to tell her how she feels. But she doesn't want to ruin their good friendship...! Because Inasa's romantic interests aren't necessarily limited to girls like hers—

A romantic comedy depicting the love of beastmen girls, sure to bring back nostalgic memories of youth!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: It initially appeared at Comitia 152. It was later acquired by Kadokawa, who released the first volume on March 26, 2026.

title.native: キジとイナサ

209866.description:
Cosplayers, idols, elves, and a wide variety of sassy girls are forced to perform naked dogeza (bowing with their hands on the ground) using every trick in the book! Please enjoy this unprecedented and controversial work by a lineup of talented artists!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: ナマイキ女子を全裸土下座させて理解らせちゃうアンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Namaiki Joshi wo Zenra Dogeza Sasete Rikairasechau Anthology Comic

title.native: 訳あり聖女でも幸せになれる!~信じるものは救われるってこと~アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Wakeari Seijo demo Shiawase ni nareru! Shinjiru Mono wa Sukuwarerutte Koto Anthology Comic

209868.description:
Don't you understand that I'm putting my life on the line?

Self-centered, using your favorite character as a shield to do whatever you want. Causing trouble for others is absolutely unacceptable. "I" am not an otaku with half-hearted feelings.

An anthology comic where deepened love clashes.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Don't Lump Me in with You

title.native: お前と一緒にすんな オタク同族嫌悪アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Omae to Issho ni Sun na Otaku Douzoku Ken wo Anthology Comic

title.native: 恋に臆病な僕が純情ドSにぐちゃぐちゃに愛されるまで
title.romaji: Koi ni Okubyou na Boku ga Junjou Do-S ni Guchagucha ni Aisareru made

title.native: おさな、なじめば。
恋文ふぶき

209874.description:
Jihye has been able to see beings she was never supposed to see since childhood, and even now as an adult working an office job, she lives through precarious days, never knowing when danger might strike. Then one day, on her way home after catching her boyfriend of nine years cheating and breaking up with him, Jihye happens to meet a dokkaebi who is wandering in search of the Mountain Spirit. The dokkaebi makes her an offer: if she helps him find the Mountain Spirit, he will fix her eyes. With the hope of finally being able to live the ordinary life and enjoy the normal everyday moments she has always longed for, Jihye makes a deal with the dokkaebi. But there are beings watching the two of them from afar and from close by. What is the story tying together the dokkaebi and the Mountain Spirit, and was the meeting between Jihye and the dokkaebi really just a coincidence?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

title.native: 도깨비

209875.description:
For as long as Heeji could remember, Woohak was nothing more than a reliable best friend. That safe, platonic dynamic shatters overnight when he unexpectedly sends her an explicit photo of himself. Before she can even process the shock, Heeji finds herself face-to-face with Woohak as he boldly exposes himself right in front of her. Teasingly asking if she came to make a purchase, he leaves her completely mesmerized and utterly unable to look away. Leaning in with a seductive proposition, Woohak makes it clear that this exclusive offer is currently free of charge. Will Heeji really be able to pass up a limited time deal this tempting?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 소꿉친구는 싯가예요

209877.description:
The novels, set in the Meiji era over a century ago, follow Shino Nakamura, a young girl who is tricked into becoming live bait for the fearsome Tengu creatures who dwell in the mountains. The white Tengu who appears before her, however, offers to save her instead of eating her.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

title.native: 白天狗の贄嫁

209878.description:
Chizuru Masaoka, a former viscount's daughter who lost her family and home, is now an orphan. She works as a servant at the Sanjo family's residence in Koishikawa, the imperial capital. The Sanjo family, a newly established noble family that succeeded in the textile industry, owns a factory in Koishikawa and holds a leading position in the community.
