However, they continue to treat Chizuru, a member of the former noble family with superior status, cruelly. Chizuru is constantly subjected to sarcasm and contempt, but she vows to never forget her pride as a noblewoman.

Around this time, an epidemic rages through the city, causing people to fall ill one after another. Eerily, those who die reportedly say that the Grim Reaper stood by their bedside. People in panic flock to the Sanjo residence, and in order to appease the Grim Reaper's anger, Chizuru is chosen as the sacrificial bride.

The Grim Reaper's bride—that means death. However, determined to help those in need, Chizuru resolves to accept the task and, dressed in her wedding gown, passes through the torii gate of the shrine where the Grim Reaper is enshrined in the darkness of night. But the Grim Reaper, Yakumo, who appears before her, coldly tells her, "I do not take wives." With nowhere else to go and unable to back down for the sake of the townspeople, Chizuru finds herself living as a sacrificial bride under the Grim Reaper, who knows no love…!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 死神の初恋

209879.description:
The ayakashi, once driven out of the public world by the exploits of Onmyoji (exorcists), now live hidden among humans. The Hasumi family, who run the long-established restaurant "Hanamushiro," are also a clan of fox spirits skilled in shapeshifting. A marriage proposal has been made to the Hasumi family. Moreover, the woman they wish to marry is not the younger sister, the child of the legitimate wife, but Sena, the eldest daughter born to a concubine. The prospective groom is Kedoin Itsuki, the head of a prestigious family that enjoys the trust of the government in the imperial capital. Her father is delighted at the prospect of a connection with a noble family, but this marriage has a major problem. The Kedoin family is a lineage of Onmyoji, the sworn enemies of ayakashi! If her true identity is revealed, she will be exterminated!? A tense newlywed life has begun!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: あやかし華族の妖狐令嬢、陰陽師と政略結婚する
title.romaji: Ayakashi Kazoku no Youko Reijou, Onmyouji to Seiryaku Kekkon suru

209880.description:
Kisaragi Chiyo was offered as a sacrifice to a raging god. To protect her younger brother, she wanted to be eaten along with the poison that would seal the god's power. As Chiyo awaited that moment, the handsome dragon god, Ginrei, appeared before her. The dragon god, feared by all, treated Chiyo with the utmost respect as a bride—but refused to eat her! While comforted by Ginrei's kindness, Chiyo worked hard to improve herself in order to be eaten. Meanwhile, Ginrei tried to resolve Chiyo's unfortunate situation with the power of a god. As the two lived together, their paths constantly crossing, they eventually began to confront each other through their secrets—and so began the fateful wedding story of a sacrificial maiden and a dragon god.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 生贄乙女の婚礼　龍神様に食べられたいのに愛されています。
title.romaji: Ikenie Otome no Konrei Ryuujin-sama ni Taberaretai no ni Dekiai sarete Imasu.

title.native: 注文の多い魔法使い　契約花嫁はおねだり上手な最強魔術師に溺愛されています!?
title.romaji: Chuumon no Ooi Mahoutsukai: Keiyaku Hanayome wa Onedari Jouzu na Saikyou Majutsushi ni Dekiai sareteimasu!?

title.native: 成金令嬢の幸せな結婚　～金の亡者と罵られた令嬢は父親に売られて辺境の豚公爵と幸せになる～
title.romaji: Narikin Reijou no Shiawase na Kekkon: Kin no Mouja to Nonoshirareta Reijou wa Chichi Oya ni Urarete Henkyou no Buta Koushaku to Shiawase ni Naru

title.native: 梟と番様
王と后
聖女失格
花菱夫妻の退魔帖

209887.description:
Mutsumi, a girl who engages in "sugar dating," leads a double life as a student and sugar baby to support her family, who have fallen into ruin after their business failed. On June 27th, when she turned 18, Mutsumi returns home to find her parents murdered. Her classmate, Takashi, appears before the distraught Mutsumi. Takashi stabs Mutsumi with a knife, claiming that she stole his family's happiness— and then Mutsumi wakes up in her room eight years earlier. She has returned to June 27th, when she was 10 years old...

As she travels back in time and unravels the events surrounding her own death, can Mutsumi, the sugar baby girl, overcome the repeating tragedies and survive beyond June 27th, when she turned 18? A nonstop time-leap suspense.

(Source: Comipo, translated)

title.native: 汚れた私でも幸せになれますか？
title.romaji: Yogoreta Watashi demo Shiawase ni Naremasu ka?

title.native: クリームナイトベイビー

209889.description:
"Will you marry me?" Don't misconstrue his kind words and expressions... After all, it's fake. When Haruna, who works for a major advertising firm, was cheated on by her coworker, she decided to leave the company. When she went to inform her client, Ayase Real Estate, she came face to face with the scion of the company, Rihito Ayase. Even though she thought he disliked her, she was offered to work for him as a housekeeper. Now, he's even proposing a contract marriage!? He's a bit aggressive, but he's honest and mindful of others. Though she can't quite get a grasp on him... Even though they got married knowing they would divorce, Haruna's heart is gradually beginning to change.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: A Fake Love: My Contractual Husband is Too Sweet
title.native: いつわりの愛～契約婚の旦那さまは甘すぎる～
title.romaji: Itsuwari no Ai: Keiyaku-kon no Danna-sama wa Amasugiru

209890.description:
Kyoto, Shimogamo. High school student Kano is the daughter of the Nonomiya family, a former aristocratic family. Having lost her parents at a young age, she lives in an old Western-style house with her brother, who runs an antique art business, and their lodger, Kei. On her days off, she usually wears kimonos handed down from her grandmother. Kano loves antique kimonos. Then one day, she opens a storehouse that she had been told "never to open." And then, strange things begin to happen one after another…!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 下鴨アンティーク

209891.description:
"I will never accept you. Never."

As a mysterious illness and relentless monsters push the sunless kingdom of Noimont to the brink of ruin, Princess Hermine-known as the "Cursed Princess"-resolves to save her homeland through a political marriage with the grand and prosperous kingdom of Grantia. Her intended groom, Prince Dietrich, is known as the Sun Prince for his brilliant mind and striking beauty. But their engagement comes with one condition: Hermine must open his heart within one year.

Cold and distant, Dietrich rejects her from the very start, and Hermine quickly realizes just how difficult that task will be. But with warmth and unwavering determination, she sets out to melt the frozen heart of the lonely prince.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Cursed Princess and the Sun Prince: I Will Melt Your Frozen Heart
title.native: 夜の国の呪い姫、引きこもり太陽王子の心を溶かす
title.romaji: Yoru no Kuni no Noroi Hime, Hikikomori Taiyou Ouji no Kokoro wo Tokasu

209892.description:
Wonhyo, the great magician who saved the world. It has been a full ten years since he went missing. Ara, who had always looked up to Wonhyo, encounters him now transformed into a drunken vagabond. What could have happened to Wonhyo over the past ten years? Will Wonhyo truly be able to rise again as the great magician he once was?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 가장 위대한 마술사

209893.description:
The wedding of my ex-boyfriend and my former best friend. Instead of offering my blessings, I decided to give them a devastating downfall. But the bride’s younger brother catches on to my plan and starts throwing a wrench in the works, and as the truth hidden behind a veil is revealed, my revenge takes an unexpected turn...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 너의 파혼 플래너

209894.description:
This doujinshi is a spinoff from the officially released Jackal & Pomeranian series.
Akane Shimose is all fired up to give her grumpy senpai, Gen Inomata, the best date ever! Too bad everything that can go wrong, does. But if there's one thing these horn dogs excel at, it's raunchy romance—even if it means fogging up the windows of a parked car!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.english: Jackals & Pomeranians & Sex in a Car
title.native: ジャッカルとポメラニアンのカーセックスする本
title.romaji: Jackal to Pomeranian no Car Sex Suru Hon

209896.description:
Located in Kotobuki-cho is the house commonly known as "Tsubaki Yashiki." Shuichi lives there, and because he's retired at a young age, he's known as the "Young Retired." Nineteen-year-old Kasumi has married him. But there's a secret. They're a fake couple, married out of mutual benefit. Shuichi, the town's advisor, is often approached by neighbors seeking advice—a story of people with hidden secrets, told through the lens of the house.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 契約結婚はじめました。 ~椿屋敷の偽夫婦~
title.romaji: Keiyaku Kekkon Hajimemashita.: Tsubaki Yashiki no Nise Fuufu

209897.description:
A Japanese-style fantasy about a girl with a secret about her birth and a lonely second prince!

"No one must ever find out..." Following a promise to her mother, Hotaru lives hiding the fact that she is descended from the previous emperor. She was treated like a servant in her uncle's house, but one day she is chosen to become Shukahime, a shrine maiden serving the inner god. Shukahime lives in the emperor's palace, and the second prince becomes her attendant, caring for and guarding her. Hotaru is bewildered by her unfamiliar life, being doted on by the coldly beautiful prince, Hiiragi, but she is forced to confront an unexpected secret...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 朱華姫の御召人 かくて愛しき、ニセモノ巫女
title.romaji: Shukahime no Omeshi Hito Kakute Itoshiki, Nisemono Miko

209898.description:
Mio, a high school girl raised in a family of sorcerers who exorcise evil spirits, is forbidden from leaving her hometown of Nagano, but secretly goes to Kyoto without telling her family. There, she is attacked by an evil spirit but is rescued by a high school student named Takara, who for some reason already knows Mio...

A magical fantasy in which a thousand-year-old curse and destiny intertwine!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 京都くれなゐ荘奇譚
title.romaji: Kyoto Kure na wi Sou kitan

title.native: 龍女の嫁入り　張家楼怪異譚
朱華姫の御召人 かくて恋しき、花咲ける巫女
title.romaji: Shukahime no Omeshi Hito Kakute Itoshiki, Hanasakikeru Miko

209901.description:
Eliane, who fled her homeland at the age of 13 due to certain circumstances, has been a lady-in-waiting at court for four years. She has lived by the motto of "inconspicuous, plain, and modest," but suddenly, she is tricked into marriage by the second prince, Claude!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 黄金の淑女わたしは犬じゃありません
title.romaji: Kogane no Shukujo Watashi wa Inu ja Arimasen

title.native: 若奥様、ときどき魔法使い。

209903.description:
Yuka, a careerwoman, is in love with Jamil, the prince of a desert kingdom, Izdihar. When the two meet again on a work related project, he suddenly asks Yuka to marry him, saying "Be my queen!" At every chance he gets, Jamil passionately embraces Yuka in intense romance...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Proposed to By An Arrogant Sheikh: I Gave My Virginity to a Prince
title.native: 傲慢シークのプロポーズ ～処女を捧げた彼は王子様でした～
title.romaji: Gouman Sheikh no Propose: Shojo wo Sasageta Kare wa Oujisama deshita

209904.description:
"Do you want to be kissed?" "Push me away if you don't like it."

To avoid moving overseas for her second year of high school, Koko decides to live with her younger childhood friend, Shuri, whom she suddenly reunites with after two years of being apart. Until now, she had only considered him a cute little brother, but once they start living together, Shuri's behavior does a 180. He approaches her as if he's in love with her, whispers tenderly in her ear, and pins her down on the couch?! What is Shuri up to?! Who knows...but there seems to be no way to hold back his dangerously sweet advances!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Living With My Childhood Friend Who Can't Hold Back His Love
title.native: 同居した幼なじみは、溺愛を我慢できない。
title.romaji: Doukyo shita Osananajimi wa, Dekiai wo Gaman Dekinai.

title.native: 문과 문 사이
가든 플로라

209907.description:
Amid relentless debt collection and the grueling daily grind of delivery work, in a land where gratitude has vanished, rider Park Ki-Byul’s sole goal is to “escape Korea.” At the depths of despair, guided by the AI Cockatoo, he encounters the mysterious group known as the “Escape Club.” Behind their sweet offer of financial support lies a strange condition.

“If you want to leave, change first.”

A dangerous partnership begins with the Escape Club, which dreams not of “Escape” from the country, but of “Change” to transform the world.

Will Ki-Byeol truly be able to break through this era of hatred and reach true happiness?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: 탈조클럽

209908.description:
At the end of the day, it’s time for a glass of whiskey at a small bar. With a glass of whiskey handed by the bartender between us, our stories quietly unfold. Someone offers comfort, while another silently tips their glass and sheds a tear alone. Life sometimes leaves a bitter, stinging taste like a lemon, but as the glass of whiskey is slowly emptied, the heart grows a little lighter. One thing is certain: even on a heart-wrenching night, the buzz eventually turns to warmth.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: 인생이 레몬을 건네면 위스키를 더하라

synonyms: A Marriage Which Starts From the Interview

title.native: 결혼은 면접부터

209910.description:
A great sage has dedicated his entire life to magic, solely for the purpose of defeating the Demon King. But when they finally meet, the Demon King escapes to the future using reincarnation magic...! The great sage follows suit and is reborn 500 years later as Ren Strain, only to find that magic in the future has declined to an astonishing degree—!?

(Source: Starts Publishing, translated)

title.native: 転生賢者のやり直し～俺だけ使える規格外魔法で二度目の人生を無双する～
title.romaji: Tensei Kenja no Yarinaoshi: Ore Dake Tsukaeru Kikaku-gai Mahou de Nidome no Jinsei wo Musou suru

209911.description:
With this guy... I'm sure I can find happiness.

Even though she's gorgeous on the outside, Hana is a 26-year-old girl with a timid nature. Each time she fantasizes about having a bright future with the person she's with, she ends up being betrayed and having her heart severely broken. It's as if Hana's heart is a black hole that keeps attracting another "horrid" person who approaches Hana disguised as her "one true love".

From a lack of self-confidence, Hana is dependent on others and addicted to love. This is an omnibus love series that stylishly depicts the stories of a single girl falling deeper into hell as she's being taken advantage of by different men and women.

At the end of this torment, will Hana ever find real "happiness"...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

AV授業はじめるよっ
ヒーロー

209927.description: Shigu, a slime alien girl who fled to Earth after her home planet became uninhabitable. Abandoned by her parents, she ends up living together with Amane, a lonely human girl, through a twist of fate. A “girl meets girl” story that transcends the galaxy.

title.native: あまねくシグナル

209928.description:
“Otokonoko” refers to a 2D cross-dressing boy who is as cute as a girl. Essentially, he is a creature that cannot exist in the 3D world. This book tells the story of a man in his late twenties—who still avidly reads Shonen Jump—as he recklessly strives every day to cross that dimensional barrier. Nanami Igarashi is the son of Yumiko Igarashi, the manga artist behind Candy Candy. Having inherited his mother’s genes and become a full-fledged otaku, he used to secretly borrow his live-in girlfriend’s (a cosplayer) clothes and makeup while she was out to enjoy cross-dressing on his own—but eventually, she discovered his hobby…!!

(Source: Jitsugyou Nihon-sha, machine translated)

title.native: わが輩は「男の娘」である！
手のひらの天国
週末の悪魔
週末の悪魔 second

209932.description:
As a young boy, Ains tragically witnessed his village being burnt to the ground by enemy forces. By the time rescue arrived, he lost his right arm, left leg, and right eye. Despite such misfortune, his only concern was the magic he saw for the first time among the debris. In order to study it, he withdrew from society and secluded himself in a cabin in the woods for two thousand years. When he finally emerges as an all-powerful mage, his childhood village has transformed into a sprawling city. But that's not all! The scribbled notes he left behind have become the “Original Scripture,” and he's infamously known as the “Demon God.” Can Ains find his place in the world after millennia have passed?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: 隻眼・隻腕・隻脚の魔術師@COMIC～森の小屋に籠っていたら早2000年。気づけば魔神と呼ばれていた。僕はただ魔術の探求をしたいだけなのに～

title.native: かわいい顔、みせて
惚れっぽシンメのしつけ方
最近、友だちが変かもしれない。
title.romaji: Saikin, Tomodachi ga Hen kamo Shirenai.

209938.description:
A man who has always been looked down on by women becomes obsessed with becoming someone they respect and submit to. To transform himself, he seeks guidance from a powerful man who embodies everything he wants to become.

(Source: Toomics)

title.native: 존경받는 남자

1. Change as you Love
2-5. Miracle Maid Pamela x Louisa (ミラクルメイド パメラ×ルイーザ)

synonyms: ミラクルメイド パメラ×ルイーザ

title.native: チェリー・ボム

209942.description:
My mother’s desperate hands, the finish line and the medal I longed for. Hyun-Yeo’s love is never reciprocated. In a life filled with unrequited love, the one person she could rely on was Han Yo-Jun. When even he inevitably became the object of her desperate unrequited love, she could no longer bear it. Whether it’s reciprocated or rejected, she’s done with unrequited love once and for all.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 짝사랑 사생결단
残光再撮
ふしだら
きょうはなにしよう？
Dolls Nest: ORPHANS
彗星、ロック・ユー

209948.description: Note: Part of Playtoon's Play Danpyeonseon (플래이 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: The Young Lady Wants to "Have" Her Bodyguard!

title.native: 아가씨는 경호원이 먹고 싶어!

209949.description:
Who did you kill?

Hinata Yoshizumi, pregnant and without a job or home, collapses in front of the house of a woman named Asumi Inogai and ends up stowed away inside. Hinata begins to trust the kind Asumi, but then Asumi confesses, "I've killed someone..."

A story of two women with no way out, and their struggle over a child.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 灯火

209950.description:
A proper marriage, a proper life. To achieve that, one must first start with love. As his peers and younger brother get married, Iida solidifies his resolve and, exhausted by the process of finding a partner, meets a woman. He tries to arrange a second date with Nagashima, with whom he has a pleasant conversation, but she tells him, "I'm not good with men, so please wait before you touch me"...?

A powerful work depicting one way of being for men and women, who wander in search of a way out while trapped in invisible templates.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 見えないテンプレート

209951.description:
"I'll teach your body everything I've learned in the last 10 years—" Wakabayashi Yu, an elite police superintendent on the career track, decides to enter into a fake marriage with her colleague Mikoshiba in order to get promoted. Mikoshiba is just a colleague and rival. That's what she thought, but she never imagined that things would turn out like this from the very first day of living together—!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 偽装結婚したライバルにどうやら１０年前から愛されていたらしい
title.romaji: Gisou Kekkon Shita Rival ni Douyara 10-nen Mae kara Aisarete Itarashii

209952.description:
Roberia, despite being the eldest daughter of a wealthy house, is called a "demon" by her family and locked away in an underground prison. She is chosen to take the place of her younger sister in an arranged marriage, but on the way to her new home she gets into an accident and loses all her memories. She then meets a man who claims to be her fiancé, Cecil. Cecil's kind and reassures Roberia that there's no need for her to recall her memories, but he strangely keeps calling her "Lily"... The mystery of her imprisonment by her family still remains, as well as what kind of love Roberia will find...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 忘却の花嫁～ロベリア～

209953.description:
"Why not press the reset button on your life?" Due to her hideous appearance, Moeko had been hated by both her peers and her family ever since she was a small child. Even as an adult nothing changed, so Moeko resolved to change herself instead. While saving for plastic surgery, she wound up lending money to Ijima, a colleague who had treated her kindly. However, after falling into a physical relationship with him, Moeko learns that Ijima was only using her for her money, and she kills him. She is carted off to prison for her crimes... Then one day, a chance to start over in life arrives: full-body plastic surgery through the "Reset Program." She is offered the choice to cast off her current appearance and live as another, completely different person!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: リセット～囚われの全身整形～

209954.description:
I want to make a good-looking man feel good. I never knew I had such a desire... Yoshino Otsuka (27 years old) loves seeing the look on people's faces when they beg. One day, she witnesses an embarrassing scene involving her proud, high-achieving junior colleague, Momose. When he asks her to keep quiet, the not-so-honest Momose gives in to her desires...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: かじっていいの、桃瀬くん？

209955.description:
Earnest and meek looking Hasumi has been working at a customer support center for a month now. Having to deal with customer complaints and inquires day in and day out has caused some pent-up stress, and in order to relieve said stress, some intense bullying has started in the office. Unfortunately for Hasumi, she has become a target, and is reaching her limit...or is she?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Hasumi and Her "Normal" Life: A Psychopath Wants to Know Love
title.native: ニセ真面目女子はすみ～サイコパスは愛を知りたい～
title.romaji: Nise Majime Joshi Hasumi: Psychopath wa Ai wo Shiritai

209956.description:
Rino is a 34-year-old housewife married to her kind husband, Takumi. She basically has a picture-perfect marriage. However, one night, the topic of having kids is brought up again by Takumi. Rino has a secret that's holding her back from getting pregnant... In the past, she left her infant daughter at an orphanage's doorstep. Her mother-in-law is laying on the pressure to have a baby, and Takumi is irritated with her. Not only that, Takumi goes drinking with the new part-timer, Hina...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Flowers of Fate: The Vengeful Mistress and Sinful Wife
title.native: 因果の花～復讐の不倫女と罪だらけのサレ妻～
title.romaji: Inga no Hana: Fukushuu Furin Onna to Tsumi Darake no Sarezuma

title.native: 今宵、狼神様と契約夫婦になりまして
title.romaji: Koyoi, Ookami Kamisama to Keiyaku Fuufu ni Narimashite

title.native: 今宵、狼神様の契約花嫁が身籠りまして
title.romaji: Koyoi, Ookami Kamisama no Keiyaku Hanayome ga mi Komorimashite

title.native: 末端将軍の希なる花嫁 没落した姫君との幸せな政略結婚
title.romaji: Mattan Shougun no Mare Naru Hanayome: Botsuraku shita Himegimi to no Shiawase na Seiryaku Kekkon

209960.description:
Miku, an office worker who's terrible at romance, is rescued from a difficult situation at a company drinking party by her ex-boyfriend, Kosei Sugiura...!? What's more, they end up becoming closely involved with each other both at work and outside of it!? He's mean, but sometimes sweet, and it's all very confusing! A second chance at love with an ex-boyfriend boss!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 初夜カレ ー意地悪で甘いひとー

209964.description:
Eun-Seol Jeong and Yu-Sin Ma have been inseparable since they were children, but lately, something has shifted. Returning from his army service, Yu-Sin is often sought after by girls in Eun-Seol’s orbit, all while he has been quietly shielding Eun-Seol from guys interested in her. When their families go on vacation together, Eun-Seol and Yu-Sin find the boundary of their friendship tested. Together, they’ll have to decide – what if their relationship was never just friendship?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: คืนเร่าร้อนของมิตรภาพ 19 ปี
One Night of a 19 Year Old Friendship

title.native: 19년지기의 하룻밤

209965.description:
Yomisaka, a young boy, runs a hardware store selling pots and kettles. He inherited the shop from his predecessor, who passed away last year. He also inherited another business: a "spell shop." Reluctantly, this one is more successful. One day, Yomisaka is taken to the mansion of Baron Kagawa by a man claiming to be his steward, and the Baron orders him to break a curse placed on his son, Chihiro. Yomisaka visits Chihiro, who has taken time off from university and is confined to his annex...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 金物屋夜見坂少年の怪しい副業
title.romaji: Kanamonoya Yoru Mizaka no Shounen no Ayashii Fukugyou

209966.description:
Hae-Su and Jin-Heon are childhood friends, but Hae-Su has a boyfriend and Jin-Heon is a gruff star athlete who just loves to tease her. After Hae-Su is dumped by her boyfriend Jeong-Un because she just doesn’t do it for him anymore, Hae-Su is understandably distraught and turns to Jin-Heon for a man’s perspective. Little does she know that her tearful bid for validation will spark a flame that could threaten their 13-year friendship…

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: เพื่อนเล่น(อยาก)เล่นเพื่อน

title.native: 친구 실격
神招きの庭

209968.description:
After living the same life 12 times, Joo Gong-Hyuk has perfected the method for conquering the Tower of Babel. His only problem is that no matter how many times he climbs it, he is unable to stop the destruction of the world. But not this time! His 13th return is going to be his last, and he'll stop at nothing to save his friends and stop the apocalypse. Will his knowledge from climbing the tower 12 times be enough? Or will Gong-Hyuk be forced to watch as the world meets its end once again?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Honestly, This 13th Regression is Getting Tough

title.native: 回帰も13回目となると正直しんどい
title.romaji: Kaiki mo 13-kaime to Naru to Shoujiki Shindoi

209969.description:
Born into a fallen noble family, Sakurako is arranged to marry the heir to the powerful snake god family. However, on the day of her wedding, Sakurako foresees that she will be brutally murdered by her husband, Touya... Protected by the bird god, Sakurako has awakened a precognitive ability limited to dangerous futures, just like a "coal mine canary." Determined to avoid death, Sakurako involves her family and tries every trick in the book to break the death flags, starting with breaking off her engagement, but Touya dotes on her, finding her "interesting woman"...? Breaking one flag only creates a new one elsewhere.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: かなりや異類婚姻譚　蛇神さまの花嫁御寮
title.romaji: Kanariya Irui Konin Tan Hebi Kamisama no Hanayome Goryou

209970.description:
Born into a fallen aristocratic family, Sakurako is forced into a political marriage with Karasukada Touya, a powerful member of the Serpent God clan. However, on the day of her wedding in the spring when she turns 18, Sakurako has a premonitory dream in which she is brutally murdered by her husband, Touya. At this moment, Sakurako awakens to an extraordinary ability to foresee "dangerous futures" through the manifestation of the spirit beast "Kanariya." Knowing that the contents of her dream contain the cause of her future misfortune and hold a clue to avoiding death, Sakurako...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: かなりや異類婚姻譚

209971.description:
Trapped behind her noble title and pristine reputation, Mia Trianne harbors a secret passion for the taboo. But because of her intimidating background and icy demeanor, no suitor dares to indulge her desires, leaving her stuck in a cycle of rejecting shallow flirtations and cursing her own high standards.

Determined to break free, Mia seeks out Claude, a dangerously charming merchant renowned among high-society women. Confident in her abilities, Mia vows to bring the famous Claude to his knees. But in this game of temptation and misdirection, conquering a master schemer means risking her heart and her body to a night where boundaries completely dissolve.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 깨우는 밤

209972.description:
When the boss of an assassin organization suddenly dies, a battle erupts for the "List of the Dead" he left behind. The List of the Dead is a client list detailing who has assassinated whom, a list that could potentially change the course of world affairs. Only the boss's son, Mitsuya (4 years old), knows its location. Asahi and Taka, former loyal subordinates of the boss, devise a plan to win Mitsuya over by living with him as a makeshift family, but... these two actually hate each other. Furthermore, having entered the assassin world at a young age, they don't know what normal life is like. From Mitsuya's refusal to change clothes and his picky eating habits to neighborhood troubles...?

Normal life is harder than assassination... World peace rests on a 4-year-old. Can these two assassins complete this mission!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 殺し屋ダディ
殺し屋ダディ

209974.description:
Just before her wedding, her fiancé eloped. Betrayed and humiliated when the incident was reported in the social newspapers, Erika, the daughter of a prestigious family, secretly worked at the Royal Library. One day, a plain-looking young man with glasses came looking for the "legendary grimoire." While helping him, Erika fainted the moment she touched the book he was looking for, and woke up in his house! He was none other than Mircea Antonescu, the legendary, stunningly beautiful wizard. However, Erika had been cursed with a "dragon transformation curse" related to the grimoire, and small horns began to grow on her head...

A draconic fantasy of love and curses between a cursed young lady and a legendary wizard!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 竜の国の魔導書
너와의 세 번째 썸
竜の国の魔導書 ～婚約破棄された上に呪われて角が生えたので、イケメン魔法使いと解呪に奔走しています～
title.romaji: Ryuu no Kuni no Madousho: Konyaku Haki Sareta Ue ni Norowarete Tsuno ga Haetanode, Ikemen Mahoutsukai to Kaiju ni Honsou Shiteimasu

synonyms: Idakikata wa Kore de Attemasu ka?

title.native: 抱き方はこれで合ってますか？
title.romaji: Dakikata wa Kore de Attemasu ka?

209978.hashtag: #遭難は残業扱いになりますか

title.native: 遭難は残業扱いになりますか？
title.romaji: Sounan na Zangyou Atsukai ni Narimasu ka?

synonyms: 키요스미 군, 슬슬 젖 떼지 않을래요?

title.native: 雪澄くん、いいかげんミルク離れしませんか？
title.romaji: Yukisumi-kun, Iikagen Milk Hanare Shimasen ka?

209985.description:
"He's grinding his hips into me. I can't take it anymore...! But my body says yes..." I, Yuriko, am a plain, strict office worker. After work, I dress up and transform into a gorgeous, confident woman of the night. During my nightly adventures, I met my prince, Makoto Inoue! But the day after we slept together for the first time, I find out that a cop called Mr. Yamamoto is investigating him. After I lose contact with Mr. Inoue, Mr. Yamamoto clumsily tries to console me... Before I know it, he's making his move... "Even a cop can be a beast in bed." What do I do!?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Beast, the Prince, and I - Obscene Love Triangle
title.native: 獣と王子と私～淫らなトライアングル～
title.romaji: Kemono to Ouji to Watashi: Midara na Triangle

209986.description:
“This is your punishment... for having these dirty thoughts." In the marketing department of an advertising agency, Komaki Musashi, who works there, is tasked with participating in a major competition alongside their boss, Toru Arikawa. During overtime in the empty office late at night, Komaki feels uneasy being alone with Arikawa. Sensing her suspicious behavior, Arikawa asks, "Hey, are you... perhaps seducing me?" Then, Arikawa suddenly kisses her...!! Their hot tongues entwine, clothes are taken off... and Komaki opens her legs on her own. Their lewd breaths and sweat mixing together... “Don't... make a sound......" Komaki is at the mercy of his relentless caresses. The two, who had a boss-subordinate relationship, what lies ahead for them...?! The popular Ear-Candy Situation Drama CD label, Queen Lily is back with its long-awaited second comic adaptation for “Late-Night Overtime"!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Late-Night Overtime -My Sadist Boss's Erotic Guidance
title.native: 深夜残業～ドS上司が淫らに狂わすエロ指導
title.romaji: Shinya Zangyou: Do S Joushi ga Midara ni Kuruwasu Ero Shidou

209987.description:
"Variant Entity Driven Appetite"—beings also known as VEDA. Supervisor Sasaki, in charge of surveilling VEDA collaborators, is one day tasked with watching over the VEDA, Eli. An appointment requested by Eli herself. Without knowing why, Sasaki finds himself working alongside her...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: by heart
お隣パニック!

209989.description:
"Ms. Kumakawa, you're my 'fave'." A dental hygienist, Satomi Kumakawa, is stressed from her poor work environment and has developed insomnia. What helps her sleep at night is listening to the story-reading streams by her fave, "Koki". She spends her days happily supporting him by sending Super Chats to him. One day, she is assigned to a patient named Koki Machida, who turns out to be her fave in the flesh. She swears to keep her Super Chats a secret and is determined to protect her fave's oral health as a professional...! But somehow, Satomi becomes his "fave"?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: No One Told Me I'd Be Koki's Fave
title.native: 洸生くんに推されるなんて聞いてません
選ばれなかった令嬢には、本命の彼が待っています!アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Erabarenakatta Reijou ni wa, Honmei no Kare ga Mattemasu! Anthology Comic

209991.description:
Legendary handball player Han Gangsan, who retired due to an ankle injury, teams up with his nemesis Shintaro—the man responsible for his injury—and embarks on a reckless challenge to lead the troublemakers of Gangsan Technical High School, the worst-ranked school in the country, to a top finish at the national tournament.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 7m

209992.description:
Through a political marriage with an enemy nation, Elfreda has become the queen of the kingdom. The only one welcoming the queen of barbarian descent is the assassin sent to kill her. In that life-or-death moment, Elfreda falls in love at first sight with her husband, Ainar, who saved her, and gradually becomes deeply enamored with him. Meanwhile, Ainar, who had married Elfreda from the start solely to use her as the granddaughter of his enemy, also finds himself unwittingly falling for the pure and lovely Elfreda...

Even though she knows she is not loved by him, and even though he knows he must not love her, the two are drawn to each other. Will this love end in ruin?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.native: 더럽혀 마땅할 왕비여

209993.description:
A reincarnation fantasy where you challenge the ultimate leveling with the fastest cheat!

Masaki Yuzuru, who used his cheat abilities to defeat an evil god in another world, chose to return to his original world to be reunited with his family and regain his peaceful days—or so he thought. However, one day, monsters suddenly appear all over the world and begin attacking humanity. With his seal broken and his abilities restored, Yuzuru rises up once again with his former hero party comrades to stop the evil god's resurrection.

(Source: Firecross, translated)
synonyms: Returnee from Another World with Infinite Magical Power

title.native: 無限魔力の異世界帰還者

209994.description:
The Fastest and Strongest Dungeon Conquest by a Returnee from Another World Begins!!

Yuzuru Masaki, a young man who was swept up in a mass summoning to another world, made a tremendous contribution to the five-year campaign to defeat the Evil God. Once everything was over and he wished to return to Japan from that other world, he returned to a peaceful daily life alongside his comrades who also wished to return—or so he thought. However, a few months after their return, monsters and dungeons from the other world suddenly appeared on Earth! Amidst the chaos and screams, Jo realized that the unique skills he had acquired in the other world—[Infinite Magic Power] and [Magic Power Transfer]—could still be used in the modern world…!?

A fantasy tale of unstoppable dominance in modern-day dungeons, powered by the fastest and strongest leveling!

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title.native: 無限魔力の異世界帰還者

209995.description:
The One-Eyed Underachiever Explorer Turns the Tables and Rises to Become the World’s First Alchemy Swordsman!

It has been five years since dungeons suddenly appeared on Earth. Yasui Yagami, a highly skilled explorer who had been tackling dungeons from the very beginning and was expected to have a bright future, was attacked by an irregular “Trial Monster.” In order to save his team members, he sacrificed his vision in one eye, leaving him one-eyed. As a result, Yai was branded a failure, but he had no intention of giving up on his life as an explorer!

“No matter what happens, I have no intention of quitting as an explorer. And I certainly have no intention of ending up a loser.”

The path Yai chose was a new fighting style that compensates for his lost combat power by utilizing various items found in dungeons!? Will Yai prove his true worth in a rematch against the Trial Monster—

The man who was thought to be unable to fight after losing an eye—the power he attained through sheer determination is that of an Alchemy Swordsman! A dungeon-dominating fantasy where a one-of-a-kind power mounts a counterattack from the very bottom!

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title.native: 隻眼錬金剣士のやり直し奇譚
title.romaji: Sekigan Renkin Kenshi no Yarinaoshi Kitan

209996.description:
For 300 years, knights have formed units and competed by shattering the life stones attached to each other's helmets—combat competitions have replaced war as the destiny of nations. Born in a village that produced many excellent knights, Nina, who couldn't handle a sword like the girls around her, had been ridiculed as a "failure." However, Licht, who saw Nina participate in a regional competition, discovered her talent with a bow and invited her to join the Knights' Order...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: リーリエ国騎士団とシンデレラの弓音
title.romaji: Lily Koku Kishidan to Cinderella no Yumine

209997.description:
“So, would you like me to check your breasts?”

Yun-Hui, who was diagnosed with breast cancer at the young age of twenty-eight. Despairing over the unexpected diagnosis, Yun-Hui drank more than usual and mistook a suspicious-looking man passing by for a molester.

“Want me to check it for you? I’m a pro at that.”

‘What the hell is this pervert saying?!’ She gave the man—who looked perfectly normal but was clearly a pervert—a bloody beating and stormed off… only to run into him again in the most unexpected place…! What kind of crappy fate is this?

“I told you, touching is my specialty.”

“I’ll take responsibility for you, Sa Yun-Hui.”

After that disastrous first meeting, will they actually manage to finish the XX construction project without incident?

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

title.native: XX 공사중

209998.description:
Three hundred years have passed since "combat competitions" replaced "war" as the destiny of nations. Nina, considered a "failure," has her talent for archery discovered and becomes a member of the Lillie Kingdom Knights. At the annual Western Region Cup, Nina encounters a female knight suffering from the after-effects of an injury. In their first match, Licht sacrifices his own victory to protect Nina. Nina, however, struggles with the desire to be an equal knight, rather than just being protected...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: リーリエ国騎士団とシンデレラの弓音　―綺羅星の覚悟―
title.romaji: Lily Koku Kishidan to Cinderella no Yumine: Kiraboshi no Kakugo

title.native: リーリエ国騎士団とシンデレラの弓音 ― 鳥が遺した勲章 ―
title.romaji: Lily Koku Kishidan to Cinderella no Yumine: Tori ga Nokoshita Kunshou
